<?php

namespace App\Console\Commands;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Console\Command;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;

class CreateAdmin extends Command
{
    protected $signature = 'admin:create {email} {--name=Admin}';

    protected $description = 'Buat satu admin melalui prompt password tersembunyi';

    public function handle(): int
    {
        if (User::exists()) {
            $this->error('Admin sudah tersedia. Tidak dapat membuat akun kedua.');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }
        $data = ['name' => $this->option('name'), 'email' => trim($this->argument('email')),
            'password' => $this->secret('Password admin (minimal 12 karakter)'),
            'password_confirmation' => $this->secret('Ulangi password')];
        $validator = Validator::make($data, ['name' => 'required|string|max:255', 'email' => 'required|email|max:255', 'password' => 'required|string|min:12|confirmed']);
        if ($validator->fails()) {
            $this->error('Nama/email tidak valid atau password kurang dari 12 karakter/tidak cocok.');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }
        try {
            User::create(collect($data)->only('name', 'email', 'password')->all());
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            if ($e->getCode() !== '23505') {
                throw $e;
            }
            $this->error('Admin sudah dibuat oleh proses lain.');

            return self::FAILURE;
        }
        $this->info('Admin berhasil dibuat.');

        return self::SUCCESS;
    }
}


================================================================================
FILE: .\app\Data\ProgressPayload.php
================================================================================
<?php

namespace App\Data;

use App\Models\Attachment;
use App\Models\CorrectiveAction;
use App\Models\Feedback;
use App\Models\NextAction;
use App\Models\Problem;
use App\Models\Progress;
use App\Models\ProgressDraft;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

final readonly class ProgressPayload
{
    public const VERSION = 1;

    public const ACTIVITIES = ['Trial', 'Sent Sample', 'Send Document', 'Audit', 'Others'];

    public const TEXT_FIELDS = ['description', 'pic_customer', 'process_trial', 'machine', 'die_high_raw', 'material_actual_trial', 'qty_material_raw', 'qty_process_raw', 'qty_sample_raw', 'event_note', 'remark'];

    private function __construct(public array $data) {}

    public static function fromArray(array $input, bool $final = false, ?Progress $progress = null, ?ProgressDraft $draft = null, ?User $admin = null): self
    {
        $input = self::emptyDatesToNull($input);
        $input['schema_version'] ??= self::VERSION;
        self::knownKeys($input, ['schema_version', 'project_id', 'activity_date', 'activity', ...self::TEXT_FIELDS, 'problems', 'next_actions', 'feedbacks', 'attachment_refs'], 'payload');
        $rules = [
            'schema_version' => ['required', 'integer', Rule::in([self::VERSION])],
            'project_id' => [$final ? 'required' : 'nullable', 'integer', 'exists:projects,id'],
            'activity_date' => [$final ? 'required' : 'nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d'],
            'activity' => [$final ? 'required' : 'nullable', Rule::in(self::ACTIVITIES)],
        ];
        foreach (self::TEXT_FIELDS as $field) {
            $rules[$field] = ['nullable', 'string'];
        }
        foreach (['problems', 'next_actions', 'feedbacks', 'attachment_refs'] as $list) {
            $rules[$list] = ['sometimes', 'array', 'list'];
        }
        $rules['attachment_refs.*'] = ['required', 'uuid', 'distinct'];
        foreach (['problems', 'problems.*.corrective_actions', 'next_actions', 'feedbacks'] as $path) {
            $rules[$path] = ['sometimes', 'array', 'list'];
            $row = $path.'.*';
            $rules[$row] = ['required', 'array'];
            $rules[$row.'.id'] = ['nullable', 'integer', 'min:1'];
            $rules[$row.'.client_id'] = ['required', 'uuid'];
            $rules[$row.'.position'] = ['sometimes', 'integer', 'min:0'];
            $isFeedback = $path === 'feedbacks';
            $rules[$row.'.'.($isFeedback ? 'content' : 'description')] = ['nullable', 'string'];
            if ($path !== 'problems') {
                $rules[$row.'.pic'] = ['nullable', 'string'];
                $rules[$row.'.'.($isFeedback ? 'feedback_date' : 'actual_date')] = ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d'];
            }
            if (in_array($path, ['problems', 'feedbacks'])) {
                $refs = $row.'.'.($isFeedback ? 'document_refs' : 'photo_refs');
                $rules[$refs] = ['sometimes', 'array', 'list'];
                $rules[$refs.'.*'] = ['required', 'uuid', 'distinct'];
            }
        }
        Validator::make($input, $rules, [
            'project_id.required' => 'Pilih JO No.', 'activity_date.required' => 'Isi tanggal aktivitas.',
            'activity.required' => 'Pilih Activity.', 'activity.in' => 'Activity tidak tersedia.',
        ])->validate();

        $seen = [];
        $seenRefs = [];
        $validateRow = function (array $row, string $path, string $model, ?int $parent, string $parentKey, array $keys) use (&$seen): void {
            self::knownKeys($row, ['id', 'client_id', 'position', ...$keys], $path);
            $client = strtolower($row['client_id']);
            if (isset($seen[$client])) {
                self::invalid($path.'.client_id', 'ID baris harus unik dan stabil.');
            }
            $seen[$client] = true;
            if (isset($row['id'])) {
                $stored = $parent === null ? null : $model::whereKey($row['id'])->where($parentKey, $parent)->first();
                if (! $stored || strtolower($stored->client_id) !== $client) {
                    self::invalid($path.'.id', 'Baris bukan milik induk ini atau client_id berubah.');
                }
            } elseif ($parent !== null && $model::where($parentKey, $parent)->where('client_id', $client)->exists()) {
                self::invalid($path.'.id', 'Baris tersimpan harus menyertakan ID database.');
            }
        };
        foreach ($input['problems'] ?? [] as $i => $problem) {
            $path = "problems.$i";
            $validateRow($problem, $path, Problem::class, $progress?->id, 'progress_id', ['description', 'corrective_actions', 'photo_refs']);
            self::validateRefs($problem['photo_refs'] ?? [], $path.'.photo_refs', 'problem', $problem['id'] ?? null, $problem['client_id'], 'photo', $draft, $admin, $seenRefs);
            foreach ($problem['corrective_actions'] ?? [] as $j => $action) {
                $validateRow($action, "$path.corrective_actions.$j", CorrectiveAction::class, $problem['id'] ?? null, 'problem_id', ['description', 'pic', 'actual_date']);
            }
        }
        foreach (['next_actions' => NextAction::class, 'feedbacks' => Feedback::class] as $key => $class) {
            foreach ($input[$key] ?? [] as $i => $row) {
                $fields = $key === 'feedbacks' ? ['content', 'pic', 'feedback_date', 'document_refs'] : ['description', 'pic', 'actual_date'];
                $validateRow($row, "$key.$i", $class, $progress?->id, 'progress_id', $fields);
                if ($key === 'feedbacks') {
                    self::validateRefs($row['document_refs'] ?? [], "$key.$i.document_refs", 'feedback', $row['id'] ?? null, $row['client_id'], 'document', $draft, $admin, $seenRefs);
                }
            }
        }
        self::validateRefs($input['attachment_refs'] ?? [], 'attachment_refs', 'progress', $progress?->id, null, null, $draft, $admin, $seenRefs);

        return new self($input);
    }

    private static function validateRefs(array $refs, string $path, string $owner, ?int $storedId, ?string $clientId, ?string $kind, ?ProgressDraft $draft, ?User $admin, array &$seen): void
    {
        foreach ($refs as $i => $id) {
            $id = strtolower($id);
            $file = Attachment::find($id);
            $valid = ! isset($seen[$id]) && $admin?->admin_slot === true && $file && (int) $file->uploaded_by === (int) $admin->id;
            if ($valid) {
                $valid = $file->owner_kind === $owner && ($kind === null || $file->kind === $kind);
                if ($file->state === 'staging') {
                    $valid = $valid && $draft && $draft->state === 'active' && (int) $draft->admin_id === (int) $admin->id
                        && $file->draft_id === $draft->id && $file->owner_client_id === $clientId;
                } else {
                    $valid = $valid && $storedId !== null && (int) $file->{$owner.'_id'} === $storedId;
                }
            }
            if (! $valid) {
                self::invalid("$path.$i", 'Lampiran bukan milik baris atau draft ini.');
            }
            $seen[$id] = true;
        }
    }

    private static function knownKeys(array $input, array $keys, string $path): void
    {
        if ($unknown = array_diff(array_keys($input), $keys)) {
            self::invalid($path, 'Field tidak dikenal: '.implode(', ', $unknown));
        }
    }

    private static function emptyDatesToNull(array $input): array
    {
        foreach ($input as $key => &$value) {
            if (is_array($value)) {
                $value = self::emptyDatesToNull($value);
            } elseif (in_array($key, ['activity_date', 'actual_date', 'feedback_date']) && $value === '') {
                $value = null;
            }
        }

        return $input;
    }

    private static function invalid(string $path, string $message): never
    {
        throw ValidationException::withMessages([$path => $message]);
    }
}

FILE: .\app\Data\ProjectPayload.php

<?php

namespace App\Data;

use App\Models\Project;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;
use Illuminate\Validation\Rule;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

final readonly class ProjectPayload
{
    public const DATES = ['date_receive', 't0_target', 't0_actual', 'plan_start', 'plan_finish', 'actual_start', 'actual_finish', 'event_1', 'event_2', 'event_3'];

    public const TEXT = ['part_name', 'customer', 'model', 'no_doc', 'material', 'spec', 'material_thickness_raw', 'material_width_raw', 'process', 'remark'];

    private function __construct(public array $data) {}

    public static function fromArray(array $input, ?Project $project = null): self
    {
        if ($unknown = array_diff(array_keys($input), ['jo_no', 'part_no', ...self::TEXT, ...self::DATES])) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['payload' => 'Field tidak dikenal: '.implode(', ', $unknown)]);
        }
        $rules = [];
        foreach (['jo_no', 'part_no'] as $key) {
            if (isset($input[$key]) && is_string($input[$key])) {
                $input[$key] = trim($input[$key]);
            }
            $rules[$key] = ['required', 'string', 'max:255', Rule::unique('projects', $key)->ignore($project?->id)];
        }
        foreach (self::TEXT as $field) {
            $rules[$field] = [$field === 'part_name' ? 'required' : 'nullable', 'string'];
        }
        foreach (self::DATES as $field) {
            if (array_key_exists($field, $input) && $input[$field] === '') {
                $input[$field] = null;
            }
            $rules[$field] = ['nullable', 'date_format:Y-m-d'];
        }
        Validator::make($input, $rules)->validate();

        return new self($input);
    }
}

        ]);

FILE: .\app\Http\Controllers\AuthController.php
================================================================================
<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Auth;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\RateLimiter;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class AuthController extends Controller
{
    public function create()
    {
        return view('auth.login');
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $data = $request->validate(['email' => 'required|email|max:255', 'password' => 'required|string|max:4096']);
        $key = 'login:'.hash('sha256', mb_strtolower($data['email']).'|'.$request->ip());
        if (RateLimiter::tooManyAttempts($key, 5)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['email' => 'Terlalu banyak percobaan. Coba lagi setelah satu menit.']);
        }
        if (! Auth::attempt([...$data, 'admin_slot' => true])) {
            RateLimiter::hit($key, 60);
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['email' => 'Email atau password tidak sesuai.']);
        }
        RateLimiter::clear($key);
        $request->session()->regenerate();

        return redirect()->route('app');
    }

    public function destroy(Request $request)
    {
        Auth::logout();
        $request->session()->invalidate();
        $request->session()->regenerateToken();

        return redirect()->route('login');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Components;

use App\Models\Project;
use App\Queries\ProjectLookup;
use Livewire\Component;

class ProjectPicker extends Component
{
    public ?int $selectedId = null;

    public ?Project $project = null;

    public bool $readOnly = false;

    public ?string $name = 'projectId';

    public function mount(?int $selectedId = null, bool $readOnly = false, ?string $name = 'projectId'): void
    {
        $this->selectedId = $selectedId;
        $this->readOnly = $readOnly;
        $this->name = $name;
        $this->loadSelectedProject();
    }

    public function updatedSelectedId($value): void
    {
        $this->selectedId = $value ? (int) $value : null;
        $this->loadSelectedProject();
        $this->dispatch('project-selected', projectId: $this->selectedId, project: $this->project?->toArray());
    }

    public function loadSelectedProject(): void
    {
        $lookup = app(ProjectLookup::class);
        $this->project = $lookup->find($this->selectedId);
    }

    public function render()
    {
        $lookup = app(ProjectLookup::class);
        $projects = $lookup->allForPicker();

        return view('livewire.components.project-picker', [
            'projects' => $projects,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Forms;

use App\Data\ProgressPayload;
use App\Models\Progress;
use App\Models\ProgressDraft;
use App\Models\User;
use Livewire\Form;

class ProgressFormData extends Form
{
    public array $payload = ['schema_version' => ProgressPayload::VERSION];

    public function toPayload(bool $final, ?Progress $progress = null, ?ProgressDraft $draft = null, ?User $admin = null): ProgressPayload
    {
        return ProgressPayload::fromArray($this->payload, $final, $progress, $draft, $admin);
    }

    /**
     * Map database payload validation errors to Livewire component property names.
     */
    public static function mapValidationErrors(array $errors): array
    {
        $mapped = [];
        $propertyMap = [
            'project_id' => 'projectId',
            'activity_date' => 'activityDate',
            'pic_customer' => 'picCustomer',
            'process_trial' => 'processTrial',
            'die_high_raw' => 'dieHighRaw',
            'material_actual_trial' => 'materialActualTrial',
            'qty_material_raw' => 'qtyMaterialRaw',
            'qty_process_raw' => 'qtyProcessRaw',
            'qty_sample_raw' => 'qtySampleRaw',
            'event_note' => 'eventNote',
        ];

        foreach ($errors as $field => $messages) {
            $mapped[$field] = $messages;
            if (isset($propertyMap[$field])) {
                $mapped[$propertyMap[$field]] = $messages;
            }
        }

        return $mapped;
    }

    /**
     * Check if a progress model is marked as legacy incomplete.
     */
    public static function isLegacyIncomplete(?Progress $progress): bool
    {
        return (bool) ($progress?->legacy_incomplete ?? false);
    }

    /**
     * Return display label for missing legacy date or text without saving it as business value.
     */
    public static function legacyPlaceholder(?string $value, string $default = 'Data belum tersedia'): string
    {
        return filled($value) ? $value : $default;
    }
}

FILE: .\app\Livewire\Progresses\ProgressEditor.php

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Progresses;

use App\Actions\SaveProgress;
use App\Livewire\Forms\ProgressFormData;
use App\Models\Progress;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Livewire\Component;

class ProgressEditor extends Component
{
    public ?int $progressId = null;

    public ?Progress $progress = null;

    public ?int $projectId = null;

    // Aktivitas
    public ?string $activityDate = null;

    public string $activity = 'Trial';

    public ?string $picCustomer = '';

    public ?string $description = '';

    // Rincian Trial
    public ?string $processTrial = '';

    public ?string $machine = '';

    public ?string $dieHighRaw = '';

    public ?string $materialActualTrial = '';

    public ?string $qtyMaterialRaw = '';

    public ?string $qtyProcessRaw = '';

    public ?string $qtySampleRaw = '';

    public ?string $eventNote = '';

    // Catatan
    public ?string $remark = '';

    public bool $isClosed = false;

    protected $listeners = [
        'project-selected' => 'onProjectSelected',
    ];

    public function mount(?int $projectId = null, ?int $progressId = null): void
    {
        $this->projectId = $projectId;
        $this->progressId = $progressId;

        if ($this->progressId) {
            $this->progress = Progress::with('project')->find($this->progressId);
            if ($this->progress) {
                $this->projectId = $this->progress->project_id;
                $this->activityDate = $this->progress->activity_date?->format('Y-m-d');
                $this->activity = $this->progress->activity ?? 'Trial';
                $this->picCustomer = $this->progress->pic_customer ?? '';
                $this->description = $this->progress->description ?? '';
                $this->processTrial = $this->progress->process_trial ?? '';
                $this->machine = $this->progress->machine ?? '';
                $this->dieHighRaw = $this->progress->die_high_raw ?? '';
                $this->materialActualTrial = $this->progress->material_actual_trial ?? '';
                $this->qtyMaterialRaw = $this->progress->qty_material_raw ?? '';
                $this->qtyProcessRaw = $this->progress->qty_process_raw ?? '';
                $this->qtySampleRaw = $this->progress->qty_sample_raw ?? '';
                $this->eventNote = $this->progress->event_note ?? '';
                $this->remark = $this->progress->remark ?? '';
                $this->isClosed = ($this->progress->status === 'Closed');
            }
        }
    }

    public function onProjectSelected(?int $projectId): void
    {
        $this->projectId = $projectId;
    }

    public function save(SaveProgress $action)
    {
        $this->resetErrorBag();

        if ($this->isClosed) {
            $this->addError('save', 'Progress berstatus Closed tidak dapat diedit langsung. Silakan Reopen terlebih dahulu.');

            return;
        }

        $payload = [
            'project_id' => $this->projectId,
            'activity_date' => $this->activityDate,
            'activity' => $this->activity,
            'pic_customer' => $this->picCustomer,
            'description' => $this->description,
            'process_trial' => $this->processTrial,
            'machine' => $this->machine,
            'die_high_raw' => $this->dieHighRaw,
            'material_actual_trial' => $this->materialActualTrial,
            'qty_material_raw' => $this->qtyMaterialRaw,
            'qty_process_raw' => $this->qtyProcessRaw,
            'qty_sample_raw' => $this->qtySampleRaw,
            'event_note' => $this->eventNote,
            'remark' => $this->remark,
        ];

        try {
            $admin = auth()->user();
            $saved = $action->saveBasic($admin, $payload, $this->progress);
            $this->progress = $saved;
            $this->progressId = $saved->id;

            session()->flash('ui-toast', 'Progress berhasil disimpan.');

            return redirect()->to('?tab=progresses&detail='.$saved->id);
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $mapped = ProgressFormData::mapValidationErrors($e->errors());
            foreach ($mapped as $field => $messages) {
                foreach ($messages as $msg) {
                    $this->addError($field, $msg);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.progresses.progress-editor');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Progresses;

use App\Models\Progress;
use App\Models\Project;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithPagination;

class ProgressIndex extends Component
{
    use WithPagination;

    public string $search = '';

    public string $status = 'all'; // 'Open', 'Closed', 'all'

    public string $activity = '';

    public string $customer = '';

    public string $pic = '';

    public string $sort = 'newest'; // 'newest', 'oldest'

    public bool $advanced = false;

    public ?string $from = null;

    public ?string $to = null;

    public int $perPage = 15;

    protected $queryString = [
        'search' => ['except' => ''],
        'status' => ['except' => 'all'],
        'activity' => ['except' => ''],
        'customer' => ['except' => ''],
        'pic' => ['except' => ''],
        'sort' => ['except' => 'newest'],
        'from' => ['except' => null],
        'to' => ['except' => null],
        'page' => ['except' => 1],
    ];

    public function updatingSearch(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function updatingStatus(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function updatingActivity(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function updatingCustomer(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function updatingPic(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function updatingFrom(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function updatingTo(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function setStatusFilter(string $status): void
    {
        $this->status = ($status === 'Semua') ? 'all' : $status;
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function toggleSort(): void
    {
        $this->sort = ($this->sort === 'newest') ? 'oldest' : 'newest';
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function toggleAdvanced(): void
    {
        $this->advanced = ! $this->advanced;
    }

    public function clearFilters(): void
    {
        $this->search = '';
        $this->status = 'all';
        $this->activity = '';
        $this->customer = '';
        $this->pic = '';
        $this->from = null;
        $this->to = null;
        $this->sort = 'newest';
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function render()
    {
        $totalDbCount = Progress::count();

        $statusCounts = [
            'all' => $totalDbCount,
            'Open' => Progress::where('status', 'Open')->count(),
            'Closed' => Progress::where('status', 'Closed')->count(),
        ];

        $query = Progress::query()->with([
            'project',
            'nextActions' => fn ($q) => $q->orderBy('position')->orderBy('id'),
        ]);

        if ($this->status === 'Open') {
            $query->where('status', 'Open');
        } elseif ($this->status === 'Closed') {
            $query->where('status', 'Closed');
        }

        if (filled($this->search)) {
            $term = '%'.strtolower(trim($this->search)).'%';
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($term) {
                $q->whereHas('project', function ($pq) use ($term) {
                    $pq->whereRaw('LOWER(jo_no) LIKE ?', [$term])
                        ->orWhereRaw('LOWER(part_no) LIKE ?', [$term])
                        ->orWhereRaw('LOWER(part_name) LIKE ?', [$term]);
                })->orWhereRaw('LOWER(description) LIKE ?', [$term]);
            });
        }

        if (filled($this->activity)) {
            $query->where('activity', $this->activity);
        }

        if (filled($this->customer)) {
            $query->whereHas('project', fn ($q) => $q->where('customer', $this->customer));
        }

        if (filled($this->pic)) {
            $picTerm = '%'.strtolower(trim($this->pic)).'%';
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($picTerm) {
                $q->whereRaw('LOWER(pic_customer) LIKE ?', [$picTerm])
                    ->orWhereHas('nextActions', fn ($nq) => $nq->whereRaw('LOWER(pic) LIKE ?', [$picTerm]))
                    ->orWhereHas('feedbacks', fn ($fq) => $fq->whereRaw('LOWER(pic) LIKE ?', [$picTerm]))
                    ->orWhereHas('problems.correctiveActions', fn ($caq) => $caq->whereRaw('LOWER(pic) LIKE ?', [$picTerm]));
            });
        }

        if (filled($this->from)) {
            $query->whereDate('activity_date', '>=', $this->from);
        }

        if (filled($this->to)) {
            $query->whereDate('activity_date', '<=', $this->to);
        }

        if ($this->sort === 'oldest') {
            $query->orderBy('activity_date', 'asc')->orderBy('id', 'asc');
        } else {
            $query->orderBy('activity_date', 'desc')->orderBy('id', 'desc');
        }

        $progresses = $query->paginate($this->perPage);

        $customers = Project::whereNotNull('customer')
            ->where('customer', '!=', '')
            ->distinct()
            ->orderBy('customer')
            ->pluck('customer');

        return view('livewire.progresses.progress-index', [
            'progresses' => $progresses,
            'customers' => $customers,
            'statusCounts' => $statusCounts,
            'totalDbCount' => $totalDbCount,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Projects;

use App\Actions\SaveProject;
use App\Models\Project;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Livewire\Component;

class ProjectForm extends Component
{
    public ?int $projectId = null;

    public ?Project $project = null;

    // Identitas Wajib & Unik (FR01, AT01, AT02)
    public string $jo_no = '';

    public string $part_no = '';

    public string $part_name = '';

    // Identitas Opsional
    public ?string $customer = '';

    public ?string $model = '';

    public ?string $no_doc = '';

    public ?string $date_receive = null;

    // Spesifikasi & Proses (D15 raw text)
    public ?string $material = '';

    public ?string $material_thickness_raw = '';

    public ?string $material_width_raw = '';

    public ?string $process = '';

    // Jadwal Master Manual (FR03, AT04, D14)
    public ?string $t0_target = null;

    public ?string $t0_actual = null;

    public ?string $plan_start = null;

    public ?string $plan_finish = null;

    public ?string $actual_start = null;

    public ?string $actual_finish = null;

    public ?string $event_1 = null;

    public ?string $event_2 = null;

    public ?string $event_3 = null;

    // Catatan Project
    public ?string $remark = '';

    public ?string $successMessage = null;

    public bool $returnToDetail = false;

    public function mount(?int $projectId = null): void
    {
        $this->projectId = $projectId;
        $this->returnToDetail = filled(request()->query('detail'));

        if ($this->projectId) {
            $this->project = Project::find($this->projectId);
            if ($this->project) {
                $this->jo_no = (string) ($this->project->jo_no ?? '');
                $this->part_no = (string) ($this->project->part_no ?? '');
                $this->part_name = (string) ($this->project->part_name ?? '');
                $this->customer = $this->project->customer ?? '';
                $this->model = $this->project->model ?? '';
                $this->no_doc = $this->project->no_doc ?? '';
                $this->date_receive = $this->project->date_receive?->format('Y-m-d');
                $this->material = $this->project->material ?? '';
                $this->material_thickness_raw = $this->project->material_thickness_raw ?? '';
                $this->material_width_raw = $this->project->material_width_raw ?? '';
                $this->process = $this->project->process ?? '';
                $this->t0_target = $this->project->t0_target?->format('Y-m-d');
                $this->t0_actual = $this->project->t0_actual?->format('Y-m-d');
                $this->plan_start = $this->project->plan_start?->format('Y-m-d');
                $this->plan_finish = $this->project->plan_finish?->format('Y-m-d');
                $this->actual_start = $this->project->actual_start?->format('Y-m-d');
                $this->actual_finish = $this->project->actual_finish?->format('Y-m-d');
                $this->event_1 = $this->project->event_1?->format('Y-m-d');
                $this->event_2 = $this->project->event_2?->format('Y-m-d');
                $this->event_3 = $this->project->event_3?->format('Y-m-d');
                $this->remark = $this->project->remark ?? '';
            }
        }
    }

    public function save(SaveProject $action)
    {
        $this->resetErrorBag();

        $payload = [
            'jo_no' => $this->jo_no,
            'part_no' => $this->part_no,
            'part_name' => $this->part_name,
            'customer' => $this->customer,
            'model' => $this->model,
            'no_doc' => $this->no_doc,
            'date_receive' => $this->date_receive ?: null,
            'material' => $this->material,
            'material_thickness_raw' => $this->material_thickness_raw,
            'material_width_raw' => $this->material_width_raw,
            'process' => $this->process,
            't0_target' => $this->t0_target ?: null,
            't0_actual' => $this->t0_actual ?: null,
            'plan_start' => $this->plan_start ?: null,
            'plan_finish' => $this->plan_finish ?: null,
            'actual_start' => $this->actual_start ?: null,
            'actual_finish' => $this->actual_finish ?: null,
            'event_1' => $this->event_1 ?: null,
            'event_2' => $this->event_2 ?: null,
            'event_3' => $this->event_3 ?: null,
            'remark' => $this->remark,
        ];

        try {
            $saved = $action->handle($payload, $this->project);
            $this->project = $saved;
            $this->projectId = $saved->id;
            $this->successMessage = 'Data Master Project berhasil disimpan.';
            $this->dispatch('project-saved', projectId: $saved->id);
            $this->dispatch('close-project-dialog', projectId: $saved->id);

            session()->flash('ui-toast', 'Project tersimpan. Identitas seluruh progress mengikuti data terbaru.');

            return $saved;
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            foreach ($e->errors() as $field => $messages) {
                foreach ($messages as $msg) {
                    $this->addError($field, $msg);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function cancel(): void
    {
        $this->dispatch('close-project-dialog');
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.projects.project-form');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Projects;

use App\Models\Project;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\WithPagination;

class ProjectIndex extends Component
{
    use WithPagination;

    public string $search = '';

    public string $customer = '';

    public string $model = '';

    public int $perPage = 15;

    public ?int $editingProjectId = null;

    public bool $showFormModal = false;

    protected $queryString = [
        'search' => ['except' => ''],
        'customer' => ['except' => ''],
        'model' => ['except' => ''],
        'page' => ['except' => 1],
    ];

    protected $listeners = [
        'project-saved' => '$refresh',
        'close-project-dialog' => 'closeFormModal',
    ];

    public function updatingSearch(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function updatingCustomer(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function updatingModel(): void
    {
        $this->resetPage();
    }

    public function openCreate(): void
    {
        $this->editingProjectId = null;
        $this->showFormModal = true;
    }

    public function openEdit(int $id): void
    {
        $this->editingProjectId = $id;
        $this->showFormModal = true;
    }

    public function closeFormModal(): void
    {
        $this->showFormModal = false;
        $this->editingProjectId = null;
    }

    public function render()
    {
        $query = Project::query()->withCount('progresses');

        if (filled($this->search)) {
            $term = '%'.strtolower(trim($this->search)).'%';
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($term) {
                $q->whereRaw('LOWER(jo_no) LIKE ?', [$term])
                    ->orWhereRaw('LOWER(part_no) LIKE ?', [$term])
                    ->orWhereRaw('LOWER(part_name) LIKE ?', [$term]);
            });
        }

        if (filled($this->customer)) {
            $query->where('customer', $this->customer);
        }

        if (filled($this->model)) {
            $query->where('model', $this->model);
        }

        $projects = $query->orderBy('jo_no')->paginate($this->perPage);

        $customers = Project::whereNotNull('customer')
            ->where('customer', '!=', '')
            ->distinct()
            ->orderBy('customer')
            ->pluck('customer');

        $models = Project::whereNotNull('model')
            ->where('model', '!=', '')
            ->distinct()
            ->orderBy('model')
            ->pluck('model');

        return view('livewire.projects.project-index', [
            'projects' => $projects,
            'customers' => $customers,
            'models' => $models,
        ]);
    }
}

        $this->projectId = $projectId;

            'progresses' => $this->project?->progresses ?? collect(),
        ]);
    }

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Prototype;

use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Livewire\Component;

class Dashboard extends PreviewComponent
{
    /**
     * Search text filter across JO, Part, Customer, Notes, Problems.
     */
    public string $search = '';

    /**
     * Status filter: 'Open' (default), 'Closed', or 'all'.
     */
    public string $status = 'Open';

    /**
     * Activity filter: '', 'Trial', 'Sent Sample', 'Send Document', 'Audit', 'Others'.
     */
    public string $activity = '';

    /**
     * Customer filter: exact customer name or empty for all.
     */
    public string $customer = '';

    /**
     * Free text search for PIC name.
     */
    public string $pic = '';

    /**
     * Role of the PIC to search: 'progress' (default), 'corrective_action', 'next_action', 'feedback', 'all'.
     */
    public string $picRole = 'all';

    /**
     * Sort order: 'oldest' (default) or 'newest'.
     */
    public string $sort = 'oldest';

    /**
     * Start date filter (from date).
     */
    public string $from = '';

    /**
     * End date filter (to date).
     */
    public string $to = '';

    /**
     * Toggle visibility of advanced filters (PIC, role, date range).
     */
    public bool $advanced = false;

    /**
     * Distinguish Dashboard mode vs Semua Progress mode.
     */
    public bool $isDashboard = true;

    /**
     * Initial status to load if status query param not present.
     */
    public string $initialStatus = 'Open';

    /**
     * Optional custom year-month override for global stats testing (e.g. '2026-10').
     */
    public ?string $yearMonth = null;

    protected $queryString = [
        'search' => ['except' => ''],
        'status' => ['except' => 'Open'],
        'activity' => ['except' => ''],
        'customer' => ['except' => ''],
        'pic' => ['except' => ''],
        'picRole' => ['except' => 'all'],
        'sort' => ['except' => 'oldest'],
        'from' => ['except' => ''],
        'to' => ['except' => ''],
    ];

    public function mount(?bool $isDashboard = null, ?string $initialStatus = null): void
    {
        if ($isDashboard !== null) {
            $this->isDashboard = $isDashboard;
        }

        if ($initialStatus !== null) {
            $this->initialStatus = $initialStatus;
        }

        foreach (session('prototype_ui_filters', []) as $key => $value) {
            if (in_array($key, ['search', 'status', 'activity', 'customer', 'pic', 'picRole', 'sort', 'from', 'to', 'advanced'], true)
                && ! request()->has($key)) {
                $this->{$key} = $value;
            }
        }
        if (! $this->isDashboard && ! request()->has('status')) $this->status = 'all';
        $this->rememberFilters();
    }

    /**
     * Toggle advanced filter drawer.
     */
    public function toggleAdvanced(): void
    {
        $this->advanced = ! $this->advanced;
        $this->rememberFilters();
    }

    /**
     * Toggle sort order between oldest and newest.
     */
    public function toggleSort(): void
    {
        $this->sort = $this->sort === 'oldest' ? 'newest' : 'oldest';
        $this->rememberFilters();
    }

    /**
     * Set active status filter tab (Open, Closed, or Semua/all).
     */
    public function setStatusFilter(string $status): void
    {
        $this->status = match ($status) {
            'Open' => 'Open',
            'Closed' => 'Closed',
            default => 'all',
        };
        $this->rememberFilters();
    }

    /**
     * Reset all filters back to default state (FR18, AT24).
     */
    public function clearFilters(): void
    {
        $this->search = '';
        $this->status = $this->isDashboard ? 'Open' : 'all';
        $this->activity = '';
        $this->customer = '';
        $this->pic = '';
        $this->picRole = 'all';
        $this->sort = 'oldest';
        $this->from = '';
        $this->to = '';
        $this->rememberFilters();
    }

    /**
     * Determine if current filter differs from default state.
     */
    public function isFiltered(): bool
    {
        $defaultStatus = $this->isDashboard ? 'Open' : 'all';

        return $this->search !== ''
            || $this->status !== $defaultStatus
            || $this->activity !== ''
            || $this->customer !== ''
            || $this->pic !== ''
            || $this->picRole !== 'all'
            || $this->sort !== 'oldest'
            || $this->from !== ''
            || $this->to !== '';
    }

    public function updated($property): void
    {
        if (in_array($property, ['search', 'status', 'activity', 'customer', 'pic', 'picRole', 'sort', 'from', 'to'], true)) {
            $this->rememberFilters();
        }
    }

    private function rememberFilters(): void
    {
        session()->put('prototype_ui_filters', [
            'search' => $this->search, 'status' => $this->status,
            'activity' => $this->activity, 'customer' => $this->customer,
            'pic' => $this->pic, 'picRole' => $this->picRole, 'sort' => $this->sort,
            'from' => $this->from, 'to' => $this->to, 'advanced' => $this->advanced,
        ]);
    }

    public function render()
    {
        // 3 Global summary numbers - immune to table filters (FR17 & AT23)
        $globalStats = FakeStore::getGlobalStats($this->yearMonth);

        // Status counts for tabs (unfiltered totals)
        $statusCounts = [
            'Open' => count(FakeStore::getProgresses(['status' => 'Open'])),
            'Closed' => count(FakeStore::getProgresses(['status' => 'Closed'])),
            'all' => count(FakeStore::getProgresses(['status' => 'all'])),
        ];

        // Filter options
        $customers = FakeStore::getCustomers();

        // Filtered work list
        $filters = [
            'search' => $this->search,
            'identity_only' => true,
            'status' => $this->status,
            'activity' => $this->activity,
            'customer' => $this->customer,
            'pic' => $this->pic,
            'pic_role' => $this->picRole,
            'sort' => $this->sort,
            'from' => $this->from,
            'to' => $this->to,
        ];

        $progresses = FakeStore::getProgresses($filters);
        $drafts = FakeStore::getDrafts();

        return view('livewire.prototype.dashboard', [
            'globalStats' => $globalStats,
            'statusCounts' => $statusCounts,
            'customers' => $customers,
            'progresses' => $progresses,
            'drafts' => $drafts,
            'isFiltered' => $this->isFiltered(),
            'isDashboard' => $this->isDashboard,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Prototype;

use App\Prototype\FakeDraftStore;
use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Livewire\Component;

class DraftList extends PreviewComponent
{
    public ?string $confirmingDiscardUuid = null;
    public ?string $flashMessage = null;

    public function promptDiscard(string $uuid): void
    {
        $this->confirmingDiscardUuid = $uuid;
    }

    public function cancelDiscard(): void
    {
        $this->confirmingDiscardUuid = null;
    }

    public function confirmDiscard(): void
    {
        if ($this->confirmingDiscardUuid) {
            $this->discardDraft($this->confirmingDiscardUuid);
        }
    }

    public function discardDraft(string $uuid): void
    {
        FakeDraftStore::discard($uuid);
        $this->confirmingDiscardUuid = null;
        $this->dispatch('ui-toast', message: 'Draft dibuang.');
        $this->dispatch('draft-discarded', uuid: $uuid);
    }

    public function dismissFlash(): void
    {
        $this->flashMessage = null;
    }

    public function render()
    {
        $rawDrafts = FakeDraftStore::all();

        // Urutkan draft terbaru di atas
        usort($rawDrafts, function ($a, $b) {
            $ta = $a['updated_at'] ?? '';
            $tb = $b['updated_at'] ?? '';
            return strcmp($tb, $ta);
        });

        $drafts = [];
        foreach ($rawDrafts as $d) {
            $project = ! empty($d['project_id']) ? FakeStore::findProject($d['project_id']) : null;
            $isClosed = false;
            if (! empty($d['progress_id'])) {
                $linked = FakeStore::findProgress($d['progress_id']);
                $isClosed = strtolower($linked['status'] ?? 'open') === 'closed';
            }

            $drafts[] = array_merge($d, [
                'project' => $project,
                'is_closed' => $isClosed,
            ]);
        }

        return view('livewire.prototype.draft-list', [
            'drafts' => $drafts,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Prototype;

use App\Prototype\PrototypeManager;
use Illuminate\Auth\AuthenticationException;
use Livewire\Component;

abstract class PreviewComponent extends Component
{
    // Boot runs on initial render AND every Livewire message, including direct actions.
    public function boot(): void
    {
        if (! auth()->check()) {
            throw new AuthenticationException;
        }
        abort_unless(auth()->user()->admin_slot === true, 403);
        abort_unless(PrototypeManager::isEnabled(), 404);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Prototype;

use App\Prototype\FakeDraftStore;
use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Livewire\Component;

class ProgressDetail extends PreviewComponent
{
    public ?string $progressId = '';
    public ?array $progress = null;
    public ?array $project = null;
    public bool $hasDraft = false;
    public bool $confirmingClose = false;
    public ?array $activePhoto = null;
    public ?string $flashMessage = null;

    public function mount(?string $progressId = null): void
    {
        $this->progressId = $progressId ?? request()->query('detail') ?? request()->query('id') ?? '';
        $this->loadData();
    }

    public function loadData(): void
    {
        if (! empty($this->progressId)) {
            $this->progress = FakeStore::findProgress($this->progressId);
            if ($this->progress && ! empty($this->progress['project_id'])) {
                $this->project = FakeStore::findProject($this->progress['project_id']);
            }

            // Cek apakah ada draft perubahan untuk progress ini
            $drafts = FakeDraftStore::all();
            $this->hasDraft = false;
            foreach ($drafts as $d) {
                if (($d['progress_id'] ?? '') === $this->progressId) {
                    $this->hasDraft = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public function openConfirmClose(): void
    {
        $this->confirmingClose = true;
    }

    public function cancelConfirmClose(): void
    {
        $this->confirmingClose = false;
    }

    /**
     * Tutup progress secara manual (FR16, AT20, D10).
     * Tanpa syarat tanggal action atau feedback.
     */
    public function confirmCloseProgress(): void
    {
        $this->closeProgress();
    }

    /**
     * Tutup progress secara manual (FR16, AT20, D10).
     * Tanpa syarat tanggal action atau feedback.
     */
    public function closeProgress(): void
    {
        if ($this->progressId) {
            $updated = FakeStore::closeProgress($this->progressId);
            if ($updated) {
                $this->progress = $updated;
                $this->dispatch('ui-toast', message: 'Progress ditutup. Reopen tersedia jika perlu dilanjutkan.');
                $this->dispatch('progress-closed', progressId: $this->progressId);
            }
        }
        $this->confirmingClose = false;
    }

    /**
     * Buka kembali progress yang berstatus Closed (FR16, AT22, D10).
     * Menjaga seluruh isi data tanpa reset.
     */
    public function reopenProgress(): void
    {
        if ($this->progressId) {
            $updated = FakeStore::reopenProgress($this->progressId);
            if ($updated) {
                $this->progress = $updated;
                $this->dispatch('ui-toast', message: 'Progress kembali Open. Seluruh catatan tetap tersimpan.');
                $this->dispatch('progress-reopened', progressId: $this->progressId);
            }
        }
    }

    public function openPhoto(string $src, string $name): void
    {
        $this->activePhoto = [
            'src' => $src,
            'name' => $name,
        ];
    }

    public function openPhotoById(string $problemId, string $photoId): void
    {
        foreach ($this->progress['problems'] ?? [] as $problem) {
            if (($problem['id'] ?? '') !== $problemId) continue;
            foreach ($problem['photos'] ?? [] as $photo) {
                if (($photo['id'] ?? '') !== $photoId) continue;
                $this->openPhoto($photo['path'] ?? $photo['src'] ?? '', $photo['filename'] ?? $photo['name'] ?? 'Foto problem');
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    public function closePhoto(): void
    {
        $this->activePhoto = null;
    }

    public function dismissFlash(): void
    {
        $this->flashMessage = null;
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.prototype.progress-detail', [
            'progress' => $this->progress,
            'project' => $this->project,
            'hasDraft' => $this->hasDraft,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Prototype;

use App\Prototype\FakeDraftStore;
use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use App\Support\UiFormat;

class ProgressForm extends PreviewComponent
{
    public ?string $progressId = null;

    // Field Wajib Progress (FR04, AT05)
    public ?string $projectId = '';
    public string $activityDate = '';
    public string $activity = '';

    // Field Utama & PIC Teks Bebas (FR05, AT06)
    public string $notes = '';

    public ?string $picCustomer = '';

    // Field Rincian Parameter Trial (D15 Raw Text - Tersedia untuk semua Activity)
    public ?string $processTrial = '';
    public ?string $machine = '';
    public ?string $dieHighRaw = '';
    public ?string $materialActualTrial = '';
    public ?string $qtyMaterialRaw = '';
    public ?string $qtyProcessRaw = '';
    public ?string $qtySampleRaw = '';
    public ?string $eventNote = '';
    public ?string $remark = '';

    // Bagian Form Aktif (UI05, UI06)
    public string $activeSection = 'activity';

    // Data Identitas Terkini (FR02, AT03)
    public ?array $selectedProject = null;

    // Nested items collections (FR04, AT05)
    public array $problems = [];
    public array $nextActions = [];
    public array $feedbacks = [];
    public array $attachments = [];

    // Draft & Autosave State (PRD D11, UI07)
    public ?string $draftUuid = null;
    public string $autosaveStatus = 'unsaved'; // unsaved, saving, saved, error
    public ?string $lastSavedTime = null;
    public bool $simulateSaveError = false; // Mode simulasi kegagalan simpan untuk pengujian UI07 / AT37
    public bool $isClosed = false; // Closed memblokir edit langsung (D10, AT21)

    // Konfirmasi Penghapusan Baris Baru (UI-06)
    public ?array $pendingRemoval = null;

    public ?string $successMessage = null;
    public ?string $pendingUrl = null;
    public ?array $activePhoto = null;

    #[Locked]
    public string $draftFingerprint = '';

    public function mount(?string $progressId = null, ?string $projectId = null): void
    {
        $this->progressId = $progressId ?? request()->query('id');
        $draftId = request()->query('draft');
        $draft = $draftId ? FakeStore::findDraft($draftId) : null;
        abort_if($draftId && ! $draft, 404);

        if ($draft) {
            $this->progressId = $draft['progress_id'] ?? null;
        }
        $progress = $this->progressId ? FakeStore::findProgress($this->progressId) : null;
        abort_if($this->progressId && ! $progress, 404);

        if (strtolower($progress['status'] ?? '') === 'closed') {
            $this->isClosed = true;
            $this->redirectRoute('prototype.index', ['tab' => 'progresses', 'detail' => $this->progressId]);
            return;
        }

        // Opening an existing progress must resume its latest draft, if present.
        if (! $draft && $this->progressId) {
            $drafts = array_values(array_filter(FakeDraftStore::all(),
                fn ($d) => ($d['progress_id'] ?? null) === $this->progressId));
            usort($drafts, fn ($a, $b) => strtotime($b['updated_at'] ?? '') <=> strtotime($a['updated_at'] ?? ''));
            $draft = $drafts[0] ?? null;
        }
        $row = array_replace($progress ?? [], $draft ?? []);
        $this->projectId = $row['project_id'] ?? $projectId ?? request()->query('project_id') ?? '';
        $this->activity = (string) ($row['activity'] ?? '');
        $this->activityDate = (string) ($row['activity_date'] ?? '');
        $this->notes = (string) ($row['notes'] ?? $row['description'] ?? '');
        foreach ([
            'picCustomer' => 'pic_customer', 'processTrial' => 'process_trial',
            'machine' => 'machine', 'dieHighRaw' => 'die_high_raw',
            'materialActualTrial' => 'material_actual_trial', 'qtyMaterialRaw' => 'qty_material_raw',
            'qtyProcessRaw' => 'qty_process_raw', 'qtySampleRaw' => 'qty_sample_raw',
            'eventNote' => 'event_note', 'remark' => 'remark',
        ] as $property => $key) {
            $this->{$property} = (string) ($row[$key] ?? ($key === 'die_high_raw' ? ($row['dh'] ?? '') : ''));
        }
        $this->problems = $row['problems'] ?? [];
        $this->nextActions = $row['next_actions'] ?? [];
        $this->feedbacks = $row['feedbacks'] ?? [];
        $this->attachments = $row['attachments'] ?? [];
        if ($draft) {
            $this->draftUuid = $draft['uuid'];
            $this->autosaveStatus = 'saved';
            $this->lastSavedTime = UiFormat::time($draft['updated_at'] ?? null);
        }
        $this->selectedProject = filled($this->projectId) ? FakeStore::findProject($this->projectId) : null;
        $this->ensureInitialRows();
        $this->draftFingerprint = $this->payloadFingerprint();
    }

    /**
     * Sediakan kerangka awal 1 problem + 1 CA, 1 next action, 1 feedback (UI-05, FR04).
     */
    public function ensureInitialRows(): void
    {
        if (empty($this->problems)) {
            $newId = 'prob-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5));
            $this->problems[] = [
                'id' => $newId,
                'description' => '',
                'order' => 1,
                'photos' => [],
                'corrective_actions' => [
                    [
                        'id' => 'act-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
                        'description' => '',
                        'pic' => '',
                        'actual_date' => null,
                        'order' => 1,
                    ],
                ],
            ];
        } else {
            foreach ($this->problems as &$prob) {
                if (empty($prob['corrective_actions'])) {
                    $prob['corrective_actions'][] = [
                        'id' => 'act-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
                        'description' => '',
                        'pic' => '',
                        'actual_date' => null,
                        'order' => 1,
                    ];
                }
            }
            unset($prob);
        }

        if (empty($this->nextActions)) {
            $this->nextActions[] = [
                'id' => 'next-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
                'description' => '',
                'pic' => '',
                'actual_date' => null,
                'order' => 1,
            ];
        }

        if (empty($this->feedbacks)) {
            $this->feedbacks[] = [
                'id' => 'fb-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
                'date' => '',
                'pic' => '',
                'content' => '',
                'order' => 1,
                'files' => [],
            ];
        }
    }

    public function updatedProjectId(?string $value): void
    {
        $this->projectId = $value ?? '';
        $this->selectedProject = ! empty($value) ? FakeStore::findProject($value) : null;
    }

    /**
     * Ganti Activity (FR04, AT05):
     * Nilai form dan rincian parameter trial tidak boleh hilang atau dihapus saat berganti Activity.
     */
    public function setActivity(string $activity): void
    {
        $allowed = ['Trial', 'Sent Sample', 'Send Document', 'Audit', 'Others'];
        if (in_array($activity, $allowed, true)) {
            $this->activity = $activity;
        }
    }

    public function setSection(string $section): void
    {
        $this->activeSection = $section;
    }

    public function save()
    {
        $this->resetErrorBag();

        // Validasi final Simpan Baru: Hanya 3 field wajib
        $errors = [];
        if (empty(trim((string) $this->projectId))) {
            $errors['projectId'] = 'JO No wajib dipilih.';
        }
        if (empty(trim((string) $this->activityDate))) {
            $errors['activityDate'] = 'Tanggal Aktivitas wajib diisi.';
        }
        $allowed = ['Trial', 'Sent Sample', 'Send Document', 'Audit', 'Others'];
        if (! in_array($this->activity, $allowed, true)) {
            $errors['activity'] = 'Pilihan Activity tidak valid.';
        }

        if ($this->progressId) {
            $latest = FakeStore::findProgress($this->progressId);
            if ($latest && strtolower($latest['status'] ?? 'open') === 'closed') {
                $this->isClosed = true;
            }
        }

        if ($this->isClosed) {
            $this->addError('save', 'Progress berstatus Closed tidak dapat diedit secara langsung. Klik tombol Reopen terlebih dahulu (D10, AT21).');
            return;
        }

        if (! empty($errors)) {
            $this->persistDraft();
            foreach ($errors as $field => $msg) {
                $this->addError($field, $msg);
            }
            $this->dispatch('focus-first-error');
            return;
        }

        $payload = [
            'id' => $this->progressId,
            'project_id' => $this->projectId,
            'activity' => $this->activity,
            'activity_date' => $this->activityDate,
            'notes' => $this->notes,
            'description' => $this->notes,
            'pic_customer' => $this->picCustomer,
            'process_trial' => $this->processTrial,
            'machine' => $this->machine,
            'die_high_raw' => $this->dieHighRaw,
            'material_actual_trial' => $this->materialActualTrial,
            'qty_material_raw' => $this->qtyMaterialRaw,
            'qty_process_raw' => $this->qtyProcessRaw,
            'qty_sample_raw' => $this->qtySampleRaw,
            'event_note' => $this->eventNote,
            'remark' => $this->remark,
            'problems' => $this->problems,
            'next_actions' => $this->nextActions,
            'feedbacks' => $this->feedbacks,
            'attachments' => $this->attachments,
        ];

        $payload = $this->cleanProgressPayload($payload);

        try {
            $saved = FakeStore::saveProgress($payload);
            if ($this->draftUuid) {
                FakeStore::deleteDraft($this->draftUuid);
            }
            $this->progressId = $saved['id'];
            $this->successMessage = 'Progress kegiatan berhasil disimpan.';
            $this->dispatch('progress-saved', progressId: $saved['id']);
            return redirect()->to(route('prototype.index', ['tab' => 'progresses', 'detail' => $saved['id']]))->with('ui-toast', 'Progress tersimpan.');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            foreach ($e->errors() as $field => $messages) {
                foreach ($messages as $msg) {
                    $this->addError($field, $msg);
                }
            }
            $this->dispatch('focus-first-error');
        }
    }

    /**
     * Normalisasi baris kosong sesuai aturan handoff (UI-06):
     * - Action dengan deskripsi/pic/tanggal tetap disimpan.
     * - Problem dengan deskripsi/foto/action tetap disimpan.
     * - Next Action dengan deskripsi/pic/tanggal tetap disimpan.
     * - Feedback dengan teks/pic/tanggal/file tetap disimpan.
     * - Record tersimpan dari DB tidak pernah terhapus otomatis saat dikosongkan.
     */
    public function cleanProgressPayload(array $payload): array
    {
        $current = $this->progressId ? FakeStore::findProgress($this->progressId) : null;
        $retainedProblemIds = array_column($current['problems'] ?? [], 'id');
        $retainedActionIds = [];
        foreach ($current['problems'] ?? [] as $cp) {
            foreach ($cp['corrective_actions'] ?? [] as $ca) {
                if (! empty($ca['id'])) {
                    $retainedActionIds[] = $ca['id'];
                }
            }
        }
        $retainedNextActionIds = array_column($current['next_actions'] ?? [], 'id');
        $retainedFeedbackIds = array_column($current['feedbacks'] ?? [], 'id');

        $hasText = fn ($val) => is_string($val) && trim($val) !== '';

        if (! empty($payload['problems'])) {
            $cleanedProblems = [];
            foreach ($payload['problems'] as $p) {
                $probId = $p['id'] ?? '';
                $isRetainedProblem = in_array($probId, $retainedProblemIds, true);

                $cleanedActions = [];
                foreach ($p['corrective_actions'] ?? [] as $a) {
                    $actId = $a['id'] ?? '';
                    $isRetainedAction = in_array($actId, $retainedActionIds, true);

                    $actionFilled = $hasText($a['description'] ?? '')
                        || $hasText($a['pic'] ?? '')
                        || ! empty($a['actual_date']);

                    if ($actionFilled || $isRetainedAction) {
                        $cleanedActions[] = $a;
                    }
                }
                $p['corrective_actions'] = $cleanedActions;

                $problemFilled = $hasText($p['description'] ?? '')
                    || ! empty($p['photos'])
                    || ! empty($p['corrective_actions']);

                if ($problemFilled || $isRetainedProblem) {
                    $cleanedProblems[] = $p;
                }
            }
            $payload['problems'] = $cleanedProblems;
        }

        if (! empty($payload['next_actions'])) {
            $cleanedNext = [];
            foreach ($payload['next_actions'] as $na) {
                $naId = $na['id'] ?? '';
                $isRetained = in_array($naId, $retainedNextActionIds, true);

                $naFilled = $hasText($na['description'] ?? '')
                    || $hasText($na['pic'] ?? '')
                    || ! empty($na['actual_date']);

                if ($naFilled || $isRetained) {
                    $cleanedNext[] = $na;
                }
            }
            $payload['next_actions'] = $cleanedNext;
        }

        if (! empty($payload['feedbacks'])) {
            $cleanedFeedbacks = [];
            foreach ($payload['feedbacks'] as $fb) {
                $fbId = $fb['id'] ?? '';
                $isRetained = in_array($fbId, $retainedFeedbackIds, true);

                $fbFilled = $hasText($fb['content'] ?? '')
                    || $hasText($fb['pic'] ?? '')
                    || ! empty($fb['date'])
                    || ! empty($fb['files']);

                if ($fbFilled || $isRetained) {
                    $cleanedFeedbacks[] = $fb;
                }
            }
            $payload['feedbacks'] = $cleanedFeedbacks;
        }

        return $payload;
    }

    /**
     * Dapatkan payload data form untuk penyimpanan draft.
     */
    public function getDraftPayload(): array
    {
        return [
            'uuid' => $this->draftUuid,

            'progress_id' => $this->progressId,

            'activity' => $this->activity,
            'activity_date' => $this->activityDate,
            'notes' => $this->notes,
            'pic_customer' => $this->picCustomer,
            'process_trial' => $this->processTrial,
            'machine' => $this->machine,
            'die_high_raw' => $this->dieHighRaw,
            'material_actual_trial' => $this->materialActualTrial,
            'qty_material_raw' => $this->qtyMaterialRaw,
            'qty_process_raw' => $this->qtyProcessRaw,
            'qty_sample_raw' => $this->qtySampleRaw,
            'event_note' => $this->eventNote,
            'remark' => $this->remark,
            'problems' => $this->problems,
            'next_actions' => $this->nextActions,
            'feedbacks' => $this->feedbacks,
            'attachments' => $this->attachments,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Autosave reaktif saat ada perubahan properti (FR12, AT12, AT14).
     * Tidak menyimpan bila form masih kosong sama sekali (dirty check AT14).
     */
    public function updated($property): void
    {
        $root = explode('.', $property)[0];
        if (! in_array($root, [
            'projectId', 'activityDate', 'activity', 'notes', 'picCustomer',
            'processTrial', 'machine', 'dieHighRaw', 'materialActualTrial',
            'qtyMaterialRaw', 'qtyProcessRaw', 'qtySampleRaw', 'eventNote', 'remark',
            'problems', 'nextActions', 'feedbacks', 'attachments',
        ], true)) {
            return;
        }
        $this->persistDraft();
    }

    /**
     * Simpan sebagai draft secara eksplisit (D11).
     * Tidak mempengaruhi hitungan Open/Closed dan dapat dilanjutkan nanti.

    public function saveDraft(): void
    {
        $this->persistDraft();
    }

    /**

    public function cancel()

    /**

    public function reopenAndEnableEdit(): void

            $this->isClosed = false;
            $this->successMessage = "Progress #{$this->progressId} telah dibuka kembali (Open). Seluruh data terjaga dan mode edit telah aktif.";
        }
