    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Nested List Operations (FR07-FR11, AT07-AT11, D06-D09)
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    */

    public function addProblem(): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        $newId = 'prob-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5));
        $this->problems[] = [
            'id' => $newId,
            'description' => '',
            'order' => count($this->problems) + 1,
            'photos' => [],
            'corrective_actions' => [
                [
                    'id' => 'act-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
                    'description' => '',
                    'pic' => '',
                    'actual_date' => null,
                    'order' => 1,
                ],
            ],
        ];
        $this->activeSection = 'problems';
        $this->updated('problems');
        $this->dispatch('editor-focus', selector: '#problem-' . (count($this->problems) - 1));
    }

    /**
     * Cek apakah baris boleh dihapus (Handoff 7.8, UI-06 Langkah 4).
     * Record tersimpan di database TIDAK boleh dihapus melalui form.
     * Hanya baris baru yang belum diterapkan yang boleh dihapus.
     */
    public function canRemove(string $type, string $id, ?string $parentId = null): bool
    {
        if (empty($this->progressId)) {
            return true;
        }

        $current = FakeStore::findProgress($this->progressId);
        if (! $current) {
            return true;
        }

        if ($type === 'problem') {
            $savedIds = array_column($current['problems'] ?? [], 'id');
            return ! in_array($id, $savedIds, true);
        }

        if ($type === 'corrective_action') {
            foreach ($current['problems'] ?? [] as $cp) {
                if ($parentId && ($cp['id'] ?? '') !== $parentId) {
                    continue;
                }
                $savedActionIds = array_column($cp['corrective_actions'] ?? [], 'id');
                if (in_array($id, $savedActionIds, true)) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
            return true;
        }

        if ($type === 'next_action') {
            $savedIds = array_column($current['next_actions'] ?? [], 'id');
            return ! in_array($id, $savedIds, true);
        }

        if ($type === 'feedback') {
            $savedIds = array_column($current['feedbacks'] ?? [], 'id');
            return ! in_array($id, $savedIds, true);
        }

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Cari daftar tindakan dari suatu problem.
     */
    public function findProblemActions(?string $problemId): array
    {
        if (! $problemId) {
            return [];
        }
        foreach ($this->problems as $p) {
            if (($p['id'] ?? '') === $problemId) {
                return $p['corrective_actions'] ?? [];
            }
        }
        return [];
    }

    /**
     * Minta konfirmasi penghapusan baris baru (UI-06 Langkah 4).
     */
    public function promptRemove(string $type, string $id, ?string $parentId = null): void
    {
        if (! $this->canRemove($type, $id, $parentId)) {
            $this->addError('remove', 'Catatan tersimpan dapat dikoreksi melalui edit.');
            return;
        }

        $count = match ($type) {
            'problem' => count($this->problems),
            'corrective_action' => count($this->findProblemActions($parentId)),
            'next_action' => count($this->nextActions),
            'feedback' => count($this->feedbacks),
            default => 0,
        };

        if ($count <= 1) {
            return;
        }

        $this->pendingRemoval = [
            'type' => $type,
            'id' => $id,
            'parentId' => $parentId,
        ];
    }

    public function cancelRemove(): void
    {
        $this->pendingRemoval = null;
    }

    public function confirmRemove(): void
    {
        if (! $this->pendingRemoval) {
            return;
        }

        $type = $this->pendingRemoval['type'];
        $id = $this->pendingRemoval['id'];
        $parentId = $this->pendingRemoval['parentId'] ?? null;

        if ($type === 'problem') {
            $this->removeProblem($id);
        } elseif ($type === 'corrective_action') {
            $this->removeCorrectiveAction($parentId, $id);
        } elseif ($type === 'next_action') {
            $this->removeNextAction($id);
        } elseif ($type === 'feedback') {
            $this->removeFeedback($id);
        }

        $this->pendingRemoval = null;
        $this->updated('problems');
    }

    public function removeProblem(string $problemId): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        if (! $this->canRemove('problem', $problemId)) {
            $this->addError('remove', 'Catatan tersimpan dapat dikoreksi melalui edit.');
            return;
        }

        $this->problems = array_values(array_filter(
            $this->problems,
            fn ($p) => ($p['id'] ?? '') !== $problemId
        ));
        $this->updated('problems');
    }

    public function addCorrectiveAction(string $problemId): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        foreach ($this->problems as &$prob) {
            if (($prob['id'] ?? '') === $problemId) {
                $prob['corrective_actions'][] = [
                    'id' => 'act-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
                    'description' => '',
                    'pic' => '',
                    'actual_date' => null,
                    'order' => count($prob['corrective_actions'] ?? []) + 1,
                ];
                break;
            }
        }
        unset($prob);
        $this->updated('problems');
        $index = array_search($problemId, array_column($this->problems, 'id'), true);
        if ($index !== false) {
            $last = count($this->problems[$index]['corrective_actions']) - 1;
            $this->dispatch('editor-focus', selector: "#f-ca-{$index}-{$last}-desc");
        }
    }

    public function removeCorrectiveAction(string $problemId, string $actionId): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        if (! $this->canRemove('corrective_action', $actionId, $problemId)) {
            $this->addError('remove', 'Catatan tersimpan dapat dikoreksi melalui edit.');
            return;
        }

        foreach ($this->problems as &$prob) {
            if (($prob['id'] ?? '') === $problemId) {
                $prob['corrective_actions'] = array_values(array_filter(
                    $prob['corrective_actions'] ?? [],
                    fn ($a) => ($a['id'] ?? '') !== $actionId
                ));
                break;
            }
        }
        unset($prob);
        $this->updated('problems');
    }

    public function addSimulationPhoto(string $problemId): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        foreach ($this->problems as &$prob) {
            if (($prob['id'] ?? '') === $problemId) {
                $nextNum = count($prob['photos'] ?? []) + 1;
                $prob['photos'][] = [
                    'id' => 'ph-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
                    'filename' => "simulasi_foto_{$nextNum}.jpg",
                    'caption' => '',
                    'path' => null,
                    'thumbnail' => null,
                    'is_simulation' => true,
                ];
                break;
            }
        }
        unset($prob);
        $this->updated('problems');
    }

    public function removeSimulationPhoto(string $problemId, string $photoId): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        foreach ($this->problems as &$prob) {
            if (($prob['id'] ?? '') === $problemId) {
                $prob['photos'] = array_values(array_filter(
                    $prob['photos'] ?? [],
                    fn ($ph) => ($ph['id'] ?? '') !== $photoId
                ));
                break;
            }
        }
        unset($prob);
        $this->updated('problems');
    }

    public function addNextAction(): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        $this->nextActions[] = [
            'id' => 'next-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
            'description' => '',
            'pic' => '',
            'actual_date' => null,
            'order' => count($this->nextActions) + 1,
        ];
        $this->activeSection = 'next_actions';
        $this->updated('nextActions');
        $this->dispatch('editor-focus', selector: '#f-na-' . (count($this->nextActions) - 1) . '-desc');
    }

    public function removeNextAction(string $actionId): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        if (! $this->canRemove('next_action', $actionId)) {
            $this->addError('remove', 'Catatan tersimpan dapat dikoreksi melalui edit.');
            return;
        }

        $this->nextActions = array_values(array_filter(
            $this->nextActions,
            fn ($a) => ($a['id'] ?? '') !== $actionId
        ));
        $this->updated('nextActions');
    }

    public function addFeedback(): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        $this->feedbacks[] = [
            'id' => 'fb-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
            'date' => '',
            'pic' => '',
            'content' => '',
            'order' => count($this->feedbacks) + 1,
            'files' => [],
        ];
        $this->activeSection = 'feedback';
        $this->updated('feedbacks');
        $this->dispatch('editor-focus', selector: '#f-fb-' . (count($this->feedbacks) - 1) . '-content');
    }

    public function removeFeedback(string $feedbackId): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        if (! $this->canRemove('feedback', $feedbackId)) {
            $this->addError('remove', 'Catatan tersimpan dapat dikoreksi melalui edit.');
            return;
        }

        $this->feedbacks = array_values(array_filter(
            $this->feedbacks,
            fn ($f) => ($f['id'] ?? '') !== $feedbackId
        ));
        $this->updated('feedbacks');
    }

    public function addSimulationFeedbackFile(string $feedbackId, string $filename = 'dokumen_feedback.pdf'): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        foreach ($this->feedbacks as &$fb) {
            if (($fb['id'] ?? '') === $feedbackId) {
                $fb['files'] = $fb['files'] ?? [];
                $fb['files'][] = [
                    'id' => 'file-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
                    'name' => $filename,
                    'size' => 1024 * 45,
                ];
                break;
            }
        }
        unset($fb);
        $this->updated('feedbacks');
    }

    public function removeSimulationFeedbackFile(string $feedbackId, string $fileId): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        foreach ($this->feedbacks as &$fb) {
            if (($fb['id'] ?? '') === $feedbackId) {
                $fb['files'] = array_values(array_filter(
                    $fb['files'] ?? [],
                    fn ($f) => ($f['id'] ?? '') !== $fileId
                ));
                break;
            }
        }
        unset($fb);
        $this->updated('feedbacks');
    }


    private function payloadFingerprint(): string
    {
        $payload = $this->cleanProgressPayload($this->getDraftPayload());
        unset($payload['uuid']);
        return hash('sha256', json_encode($payload, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
    }

    private function writable(): bool
    {
        $current = $this->progressId ? FakeStore::findProgress($this->progressId) : null;
        $this->isClosed = $this->isClosed || strtolower($current['status'] ?? '') === 'closed';
        if ($this->isClosed) {
            $this->addError('save', 'Reopen progress terlebih dahulu untuk mengedit.');
            return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    private function persistDraft(): bool
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            $fingerprint = $this->payloadFingerprint();

            if ($fingerprint === $this->draftFingerprint) {
                $this->resetErrorBag('save');
                $this->autosaveStatus = $this->draftUuid ? 'saved' : 'unsaved';
                return true;
            }

            if ($this->simulateSaveError) {
                $this->autosaveStatus = 'error';
                $this->addError('save', 'Simulasi kegagalan simpan draft. Silakan klik Coba Lagi.');
                return false;
            }

            $this->resetErrorBag('save');
            $draft = FakeDraftStore::save(
                $this->cleanProgressPayload($this->getDraftPayload())
            );
            $this->draftUuid = $draft['uuid'];
            $this->lastSavedTime = UiFormat::time($draft['updated_at'] ?? null);
            $this->draftFingerprint = $fingerprint;
            $this->autosaveStatus = 'saved';
            $this->dispatch('draft-changed');
            return true;
        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
            report($e);
            $this->autosaveStatus = 'error';
            return false;
        }
    }

    public function leaveEditor()
    {
        $url = $this->pendingUrl ?: route('prototype.index', ['tab' => 'dashboard']);
        $actual = parse_url($url);
        $base = parse_url(route('prototype.index'));
        abort_unless(is_array($actual)
            && ($actual['scheme'] ?? '') === ($base['scheme'] ?? '')
            && ($actual['host'] ?? '') === ($base['host'] ?? '')
            && ($actual['port'] ?? null) === ($base['port'] ?? null)
            && rtrim($actual['path'] ?? '', '/') === rtrim($base['path'] ?? '', '/'), 422);
        if (! $this->persistDraft()) return null;
        return redirect()->to($url);
    }

    public function openProblemPhoto(string $problemId, string $photoId): void
    {
        foreach ($this->problems as $problem) {
            if (($problem['id'] ?? '') !== $problemId) continue;
            foreach ($problem['photos'] ?? [] as $photo) {
                if (($photo['id'] ?? '') !== $photoId) continue;
                $this->activePhoto = [
                    'src' => $photo['path'] ?? $photo['src'] ?? '',
                    'name' => $photo['filename'] ?? $photo['name'] ?? 'Foto problem',
                ];
                return;
            }
        }
    }

    public function closePhoto(): void { $this->activePhoto = null; }

    // Prototype parity only: store the selected image's data URL, not a fake thumbnail.
    public function attachProblemPhoto(string $problemId, array $photo): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        $valid = validator($photo, [
            'name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'src' => ['required', 'string', 'max:2800000', 'regex:/\Adata:image\/(jpeg|png|webp);base64,[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]+\z/'],
        ])->validate();
        $bytes = base64_decode(explode(',', $valid['src'], 2)[1], true);
        abort_unless($bytes !== false && strlen($bytes) <= 2 * 1024 * 1024 && @getimagesizefromstring($bytes) !== false, 422);
        foreach ($this->problems as &$problem) {
            if (($problem['id'] ?? '') !== $problemId) continue;
            $problem['photos'][] = [
                'id' => (string) Str::uuid(), 'filename' => $valid['name'],
                'path' => $valid['src'], 'caption' => '', 'is_simulation' => true,
            ];
            unset($problem);
            $this->persistDraft();
            return;
        }
        unset($problem);
        abort(422, 'Problem tidak ditemukan.');
    }

    // Metadata only, exactly as the approved prototype (not a production upload).
    public function attachFiles(string $owner, array $files): void
    {
        if (! $this->writable()) return;
        $valid = validator(['files' => $files], [
            'files' => ['required', 'array'],
            'files.*.name' => ['required', 'string', 'max:255'],
            'files.*.size' => ['required', 'integer', 'min:0'],
        ])->validate()['files'];
        $items = array_map(fn ($file) => [
            'id' => (string) Str::uuid(), 'name' => $file['name'], 'size' => $file['size'],
        ], $valid);
        if ($owner === 'progress') {
            $this->attachments = array_merge($this->attachments, $items);
        } else {
            $index = array_search($owner, array_column($this->feedbacks, 'id'), true);
            abort_if($index === false, 422, 'Feedback tidak ditemukan.');
            $this->feedbacks[$index]['files'] = array_merge($this->feedbacks[$index]['files'] ?? [], $items);
        }
        $this->persistDraft();
    }

    public function render()
    {
        $projects = FakeStore::getProjects();
        $this->selectedProject = filled($this->projectId) ? FakeStore::findProject($this->projectId) : null;

        return view('livewire.prototype.progress-form', [
            'projects' => $projects,
        ]);
    }
}

                $this->part_no = (string) ($project['part_no'] ?? '');

                $this->model = $project['model'] ?? '';

                $this->date_receive = $project['date_receive'] ?? null;
                $this->material = $project['material'] ?? '';
                $this->spec = $project['spec'] ?? '';
                $this->material_thickness_raw = $project['material_thickness_raw'] ?? '';
                $this->material_width_raw = $project['material_width_raw'] ?? '';
                $this->process = $project['process'] ?? '';
                $this->dh = $project['dh'] ?? '';
                $this->size = $project['size'] ?? '';
                $this->qty = $project['qty'] ?? '';
                $this->t0_target = $project['t0_target'] ?? $project['t0_target_date'] ?? null;
                $this->t0_actual = $project['t0_actual'] ?? $project['t0_actual_date'] ?? null;
                $this->plan_start = $project['plan_start'] ?? null;
                $this->plan_finish = $project['plan_finish'] ?? null;
                $this->actual_start = $project['actual_start'] ?? null;

    public function save()
    {
        $this->resetErrorBag();

        $payload = [
            'id' => $this->projectId,
            'jo_no' => $this->jo_no,
            'part_no' => $this->part_no,
            'part_name' => $this->part_name,
            'customer' => $this->customer,
            'model' => $this->model,

            'material_thickness_raw' => $this->material_thickness_raw,
            'material_width_raw' => $this->material_width_raw,

            't0_actual' => $this->t0_actual ?: null,

            'plan_finish' => $this->plan_finish ?: null,
            'actual_start' => $this->actual_start ?: null,
            'actual_finish' => $this->actual_finish ?: null,
            'event_1' => $this->event_1 ?: null,
            'event_2' => $this->event_2 ?: null,
            'event_3' => $this->event_3 ?: null,
            'remark' => $this->remark,
        ];

        try {
            $saved = FakeStore::saveProject($payload);
            $this->projectId = $saved['id'];
            $this->successMessage = 'Data Master Project berhasil disimpan.';
            $this->dispatch('project-saved', projectId: $saved['id']);
            $query = ['tab' => 'projects'];
            if ($this->returnToDetail) $query['detail'] = $saved['id'];
            return redirect()->to(route('prototype.index', $query))
                ->with('ui-toast', 'Project tersimpan. Identitas seluruh progress mengikuti data terbaru.');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            foreach ($e->errors() as $field => $messages) {
                foreach ($messages as $msg) {
                    $this->addError($field, $msg);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    {
        $query = ['tab' => 'projects'];
        if ($this->returnToDetail && $this->projectId) $query['detail'] = $this->projectId;
        return redirect()->to(route('prototype.index', $query));
    }

    public function render()
    {
        return view('livewire.prototype.project-form');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Livewire\Prototype;

use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Livewire\Component;
use Livewire\Attributes\On;

class Shell extends PreviewComponent
{
    public string $activeTab = 'dashboard';
    public array $stats = [];
    public ?string $flashMessage = null;

    protected $queryString = [
        'activeTab' => ['as' => 'tab', 'except' => 'dashboard'],
    ];

    public function mount(?string $tab = null): void
    {
        $selectedTab = $tab ?? request()->query('tab');
        if ($selectedTab && in_array($selectedTab, ['dashboard', 'projects', 'progresses', 'drafts', 'components', 'form'])) {
            $this->activeTab = $selectedTab;
        } else {
            $this->activeTab = 'dashboard';
        }
        $this->refreshStats();
    }

    #[On('draft-changed')]
    #[On('draft-discarded')]
    public function refreshStats(): void
    {
        $this->stats = FakeStore::getStats();
    }

    public function resetData(): void
    {
        FakeStore::reset();
        $this->refreshStats();
        $this->flashMessage = 'Data simulasi prototype berhasil direset ke kondisi awal.';
        $this->dispatch('fixture-reset');
    }

    public function dismissFlash(): void
    {
        $this->flashMessage = null;
    }

    public function setTab(string $tab): void
    {
        $this->activeTab = $tab;
    }

    public function render()
    {
        $this->refreshStats();
        $projects = FakeStore::getProjects();
        $progresses = FakeStore::getProgresses();
        $drafts = FakeStore::getDrafts();

        return view('livewire.prototype.shell', [
            'projects' => $projects,
            'progresses' => $progresses,
            'drafts' => $drafts,
        ])->layout('components.layouts.app', [
            'title' => 'Prototype â€” Progress New Model',
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\BelongsTo;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Relations\HasMany;

FILE: .\app\Policies\AdminPolicy.php

<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\CorrectiveAction;
use App\Models\Feedback;
use App\Models\NextAction;
use App\Models\Problem;
use App\Models\Progress;
use App\Models\User;

class AdminPolicy
{
    public function viewAny(User $user): bool
    {
        return $user->admin_slot === true;
    }

    public function view(User $user, $record): bool
    {
        return $this->viewAny($user);
    }

    public function create(User $user): bool
    {
        return $this->viewAny($user);
    }

    public function update(User $user, $record): bool
    {
        $progress = match (true) {
            $record instanceof Progress => $record,
            $record instanceof CorrectiveAction => $record->problem?->progress,
            $record instanceof Problem, $record instanceof NextAction,
            $record instanceof Feedback => $record->progress,
            default => null,
        };

        return $this->viewAny($user) && ($progress === null || $progress->status === 'Open');
    }

    public function close(User $user, $record): bool
    {
        return $this->viewAny($user);
    }

    public function reopen(User $user, $record): bool
    {
        return $this->viewAny($user);
    }

    public function delete(User $user, $record): bool
    {
        return false;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Policies;

use App\Models\User;

class AttachmentPolicy extends AdminPolicy
{
    public function view(User $user, $record): bool
    {
        return parent::view($user, $record) && (int) $record->uploaded_by === (int) $user->id
            && ($record->draft_id === null || (int) $record->draft?->admin_id === (int) $user->id);
    }

    public function download(User $user, $record): bool
    {
        return $this->view($user, $record) && $record->state === 'attached';
    }

    public function update(User $user, $record): bool
    {
        $progress = $record->progress ?? $record->problem?->progress ?? $record->feedback?->progress ?? $record->draft?->progress;

        return $this->view($user, $record) && ($progress === null || $progress->status === 'Open');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Prototype;

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class FakeDraftStore
{
    /**
     * Ambil seluruh draft tersimpan dari session adapter FakeStore.
     *
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public static function all(): array
    {
        return FakeStore::getDrafts();
    }

    /**
     * Cari draft berdasarkan UUID unik.
     *
     * @param string $uuid
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public static function find(string $uuid): ?array
    {
        return FakeStore::findDraft($uuid);
    }

    /**
     * Simpan atau perbarui draft ke dalam store.
     * PRD D11: Draft tidak mempengaruhi data tersimpan dan tidak dihitung Open/Closed.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $payload
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function save(array $payload): array
    {
        return FakeStore::saveDraft($payload);
    }

    /**
     * Hapus draft berdasarkan UUID.
     *
     * @param string $uuid
     * @return bool
     */
    public static function delete(string $uuid): bool
    {
        return FakeStore::deleteDraft($uuid);
    }

    /**
     * Buang draft (discard) oleh aksi pengguna.
     *
     * @param string $uuid
     * @return bool
     */
    public static function discard(string $uuid): bool
    {
        return static::delete($uuid);
    }

    /**
     * Cek apakah draft payload benar-benar kosong.
     * AT14: Form baru dibuka tidak boleh membuat draft kosong.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $payload
     * @return bool
     */
    public static function isEmptyDraft(array $payload): bool
    {
        $hasProject = ! empty(trim($payload['project_id'] ?? ''));
        $hasNotes = ! empty(trim($payload['notes'] ?? ''));
        $hasPic = ! empty(trim($payload['pic_progress'] ?? ''));
        $hasPicCust = ! empty(trim($payload['pic_customer'] ?? ''));
        $hasMachine = ! empty(trim($payload['machine'] ?? ''));
        $hasDh = ! empty(trim($payload['die_high_raw'] ?? ''));
        $hasProblems = ! empty($payload['problems']);
        $hasActions = ! empty($payload['next_actions']);
        $hasFeedbacks = ! empty($payload['feedbacks']);

        return ! ($hasProject || $hasNotes || $hasPic || $hasPicCust || $hasMachine || $hasDh || $hasProblems || $hasActions || $hasFeedbacks);
    }

    /**
     * Hitung total draft aktif saat ini.
     *
     * @return int
     */
    public static function count(): int
    {
        return count(static::all());
    }
}

FILE: .\app\Prototype\FakeStore.php
================================================================================
<?php

namespace App\Prototype;

use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Session;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class FakeStore
{
    protected const SESSION_KEY = 'prototype_store';

    /**
     * Fallback in-memory state when session is not available.
     *
     * @var array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    protected static ?array $memoryStore = null;

    /**
     * Get the full state (from session or memory).
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function all(): array
    {
        if (Session::isStarted() && Session::has(self::SESSION_KEY)) {
            return Session::get(self::SESSION_KEY);
        }

        if (static::$memoryStore !== null) {
            return static::$memoryStore;
        }

        return static::loadInitialFixtures();
    }

    /**
     * Load initial fixtures from JSON and cache in store.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    protected static function loadInitialFixtures(): array
    {
        $path = resource_path('fixtures/prototype.json');

        if (! file_exists($path)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Prototype fixture file not found at: {$path}");
        }

        $data = json_decode(file_get_contents($path), true) ?: [];

        static::saveStore($data);

        return $data;
    }

    /**
     * Persist the store into session and static memory.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     */
    protected static function saveStore(array $data): void
    {
        static::$memoryStore = $data;

        if (Session::isStarted()) {
            Session::put(self::SESSION_KEY, $data);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Reset store back to the original fixture data.
     */
    public static function reset(): void
    {
        static::$memoryStore = null;

        if (Session::isStarted()) {
            Session::forget(self::SESSION_KEY);
        }

        static::loadInitialFixtures();
    }

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Project Operations
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    */

    /**
     * Get all projects.
     *
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public static function getProjects(): array
    {
        return static::all()['projects'] ?? [];
    }

    /**
     * Find project by ID or JO No.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public static function findProject(string $idOrJo): ?array
    {
        foreach (static::getProjects() as $project) {
            if ($project['id'] === $idOrJo || $project['jo_no'] === $idOrJo) {
                return $project;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Save (create or update) a project record.
     * Enforces D01, FR01, AT01, AT02:
     * - JO No must be unique (trimmed, case-insensitive)
     * - Part No must be unique (trimmed, case-insensitive)
     * - Part Name is required for new projects
     * - Leading zeros preserved as string
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     * @throws \Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException
     */
    public static function saveProject(array $data): array
    {
        $joNo = trim($data['jo_no'] ?? '');
        $partNo = trim($data['part_no'] ?? '');
        $partName = trim($data['part_name'] ?? '');

        $errors = [];

        if ($joNo === '') {
            $errors['jo_no'] = ['JO No wajib diisi.'];
        }
        if ($partNo === '') {
            $errors['part_no'] = ['Part No wajib diisi.'];
        }
        if ($partName === '') {
            $errors['part_name'] = ['Part Name wajib diisi.'];
        }

        $isNew = empty($data['id']);
        $id = $isNew ? 'proj-' . Str::lower(Str::random(6)) : $data['id'];

        $store = static::all();
        $projects = $store['projects'] ?? [];

        // Check uniqueness of JO No (AT01) and Part No (AT02)
        foreach ($projects as $p) {
            if ($p['id'] === $id) {
                continue;
            }

            if ($joNo !== '' && strcasecmp(trim($p['jo_no']), $joNo) === 0) {
                $errors['jo_no'] = ["JO No '{$joNo}' sudah digunakan pada project lain."];
            }

            if ($partNo !== '' && strcasecmp(trim($p['part_no']), $partNo) === 0) {
                $errors['part_no'] = ["Part No '{$partNo}' sudah digunakan pada project lain."];
            }
        }

        if (! empty($errors)) {
            throw \Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
        }

        $existingIndex = null;
        if (! $isNew) {
            foreach ($projects as $idx => $p) {
                if ($p['id'] === $id) {
                    $existingIndex = $idx;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        $existing = $existingIndex !== null ? $projects[$existingIndex] : [];

        $dateValue = static function (string $key, ?string $legacyKey = null) use ($data, $existing): ?string {
            if (array_key_exists($key, $data)) {
                return $data[$key] === '' ? null : $data[$key];
            }

            return $existing[$key]
                ?? ($legacyKey !== null ? ($existing[$legacyKey] ?? null) : null);
        };

        // Build normalized record according to Section 15 of PRD (23 active fields)
        $record = [
            'id' => $id,
            'jo_no' => (string) $joNo,
            'part_no' => (string) $partNo,
            'part_name' => (string) $partName,
            'customer' => $data['customer'] ?? $existing['customer'] ?? null,
            'model' => $data['model'] ?? $existing['model'] ?? null,
            'no_doc' => $data['no_doc'] ?? $existing['no_doc'] ?? null,
            'date_receive' => $dateValue('date_receive'),
            'material' => $data['material'] ?? $existing['material'] ?? null,
            'spec' => $data['spec'] ?? $existing['spec'] ?? null,
            'material_thickness_raw' => $data['material_thickness_raw'] ?? $existing['material_thickness_raw'] ?? null,
            'material_width_raw' => $data['material_width_raw'] ?? $existing['material_width_raw'] ?? null,
            'process' => $data['process'] ?? $existing['process'] ?? null,
            't0_target' => $dateValue('t0_target', 't0_target_date'),
            't0_actual' => $dateValue('t0_actual', 't0_actual_date'),
            't0_target_date' => $dateValue('t0_target', 't0_target_date'),
            't0_actual_date' => $dateValue('t0_actual', 't0_actual_date'),
            'plan_start' => $dateValue('plan_start'),
            'plan_finish' => $dateValue('plan_finish'),
            'actual_start' => $dateValue('actual_start'),
            'actual_finish' => $dateValue('actual_finish'),
            'event_1' => $dateValue('event_1', 'event_1_date'),
            'event_2' => $dateValue('event_2', 'event_2_date'),
            'event_3' => $dateValue('event_3', 'event_3_date'),
            'event_1_date' => $dateValue('event_1', 'event_1_date'),
            'event_2_date' => $dateValue('event_2', 'event_2_date'),
            'event_3_date' => $dateValue('event_3', 'event_3_date'),
            'dh' => $data['dh'] ?? $existing['dh'] ?? null,
            'size' => $data['size'] ?? $existing['size'] ?? null,
            'qty' => $data['qty'] ?? $existing['qty'] ?? null,
            'remark' => $data['remark'] ?? $existing['remark'] ?? null,
        ];

        if ($existingIndex !== null) {
            $projects[$existingIndex] = $record;
        } else {
            $projects[] = $record;
        }

        $store['projects'] = $projects;
        static::saveStore($store);

        return $record;
    }

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Progress Operations
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    */

    /**
     * Get unique customer names sorted alphabetically.
     *
     * @return array<int, string>
     */
    public static function getCustomers(): array
    {
        $customers = [];
        foreach (static::getProjects() as $p) {
            if (! empty($p['customer']) && ! in_array($p['customer'], $customers, true)) {
                $customers[] = $p['customer'];
            }
        }
        sort($customers);

        return $customers;
    }

    /**
     * Get all progresses with optional filters and sorting.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $filters
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public static function getProgresses(array $filters = []): array
    {
        $progresses = static::all()['progresses'] ?? [];

        // Filter by project_id
        if (! empty($filters['project_id'])) {
            $progresses = array_filter($progresses, fn ($p) => $p['project_id'] === $filters['project_id']);
        }

        // Filter by customer
        if (! empty($filters['customer'])) {
            $targetCustomer = strtolower(trim($filters['customer']));
            $progresses = array_filter($progresses, function ($p) use ($targetCustomer) {
                $project = static::findProject($p['project_id']);
                return strtolower(trim($project['customer'] ?? '')) === $targetCustomer;
            });
        }

        // Filter by activity (Trial, Sent Sample, Send Document, Audit, Others)
        if (! empty($filters['activity']) && ! in_array(strtolower($filters['activity']), ['all', 'semua'], true)) {
            $progresses = array_filter($progresses, fn ($p) => strtolower($p['activity']) === strtolower($filters['activity']));
        }

        // Filter by status (Open / Closed). If empty or 'all'/'semua', do not filter.
        if (! empty($filters['status']) && ! in_array(strtolower($filters['status']), ['all', 'semua'], true)) {
            $progresses = array_filter($progresses, fn ($p) => strtolower($p['status']) === strtolower($filters['status']));
        }

        // Filter by search keyword (JO, Part No, Part Name, Customer, Notes, Problems)
        if (! empty($filters['search'])) {
            $keyword = strtolower(trim($filters['search']));
            $progresses = array_filter($progresses, function ($p) use ($keyword, $filters) {
                $project = static::findProject($p['project_id']);
                $joNo = strtolower($project['jo_no'] ?? '');
                $partNo = strtolower($project['part_no'] ?? '');
                $partName = strtolower($project['part_name'] ?? '');
                if (! empty($filters['identity_only'])) {
                    return str_contains(implode(' ', [$joNo, $partNo, $partName]), $keyword);
                }
                $customer = strtolower($project['customer'] ?? '');
                $notes = strtolower($p['notes'] ?? '');

                if (str_contains($joNo, $keyword) ||
                    str_contains($partNo, $keyword) ||
                    str_contains($partName, $keyword) ||
                    str_contains($customer, $keyword) ||
                    str_contains($notes, $keyword)) {
                    return true;
                }

                // Check problem descriptions
                foreach ($p['problems'] ?? [] as $prob) {
                    if (str_contains(strtolower($prob['description'] ?? ''), $keyword)) {
                        return true;
                    }
                }

                return false;
            });
        }

        // Filter by from date (YYYY-MM-DD)
        if (! empty($filters['from'])) {
            $progresses = array_filter($progresses, function ($p) use ($filters) {
                return ! empty($p['activity_date']) && $p['activity_date'] >= $filters['from'];
            });
        }

        // Filter by to date (YYYY-MM-DD)
        if (! empty($filters['to'])) {
            $progresses = array_filter($progresses, function ($p) use ($filters) {
                return ! empty($p['activity_date']) && $p['activity_date'] <= $filters['to'];
            });
        }

        // Filter by PIC and PIC Role (FR18, AT24) - Guarantees unique progress records
        if (! empty($filters['pic'])) {
            $picKw = strtolower(trim($filters['pic']));
            $role = strtolower(trim($filters['pic_role'] ?? 'all'));

            $progresses = array_filter($progresses, function ($p) use ($picKw, $role) {
                $matchProgress = str_contains(strtolower($p['pic_customer'] ?? ''), $picKw);

                $matchCorrective = false;
                foreach ($p['problems'] ?? [] as $prob) {
                    foreach ($prob['corrective_actions'] ?? [] as $act) {
                        if (str_contains(strtolower($act['pic'] ?? ''), $picKw)) {
                            $matchCorrective = true;
                            break 2;
                        }
                    }
                }

                $matchNextAction = false;
                foreach ($p['next_actions'] ?? [] as $na) {
                    if (str_contains(strtolower($na['pic'] ?? ''), $picKw)) {
                        $matchNextAction = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                $matchFeedback = false;
                foreach ($p['feedbacks'] ?? [] as $fb) {
                    if (str_contains(strtolower($fb['pic'] ?? ''), $picKw)) {
                        $matchFeedback = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                return match ($role) {
                    'progress', 'customer' => $matchProgress,
                    'corrective', 'corrective_action' => $matchCorrective,
                    'next', 'next_action' => $matchNextAction,
                    'feedback' => $matchFeedback,
                    'all' => $matchProgress || $matchCorrective || $matchNextAction || $matchFeedback,
                    default => $matchProgress,
                };
            });
        }

        // Convert to indexed array
        $result = array_values($progresses);

        // Sort: default 'oldest' (FR18). Oldest activity_date first, null dates at the end, secondary order by ID
        $sort = strtolower(trim($filters['sort'] ?? 'oldest'));
        usort($result, function ($a, $b) use ($sort) {
            $dateA = $a['activity_date'] ?? null;
            $dateB = $b['activity_date'] ?? null;

            if (empty($dateA) && ! empty($dateB)) {
                return 1;
            }
            if (! empty($dateA) && empty($dateB)) {
                return -1;
            }
            if (empty($dateA) && empty($dateB)) {
                return strcmp($a['id'] ?? '', $b['id'] ?? '');
            }

            if ($sort === 'newest') {
                $cmp = strcmp($dateB, $dateA);
            } else {
                $cmp = strcmp($dateA, $dateB);
            }

            if ($cmp !== 0) {
                return $cmp;
            }

            return strcmp($a['id'] ?? '', $b['id'] ?? '');
        });

        // Enrich each progress with related project and safe fallbacks for convenient display
        foreach ($result as &$item) {
            $item['pic_progress'] = $item['pic_progress'] ?? '';
            $item['pic_customer'] = $item['pic_customer'] ?? null;
            $item['project'] = static::findProject($item['project_id']);
        }
        unset($item);

        return $result;
    }

    /**
     * Find a single progress by ID.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public static function findProgress(string $id): ?array
    {
        foreach (static::all()['progresses'] ?? [] as $progress) {
            if ($progress['id'] === $id) {
                // Enrich with project details and safe fallbacks
                $progress['pic_progress'] = $progress['pic_progress'] ?? '';
                $progress['pic_customer'] = $progress['pic_customer'] ?? null;
                $progress['project'] = static::findProject($progress['project_id']);
                return $progress;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Save (insert or update) a progress record.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $data
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function saveProgress(array $data): array
    {
        $store = static::all();
        $progresses = $store['progresses'] ?? [];

        $isNew = empty($data['id']);
        $id = $isNew ? 'prog-' . Str::lower(Str::random(6)) : $data['id'];

        if ($isNew) {
            $errors = [];
            if (empty(trim($data['project_id'] ?? ''))) {
                $errors['project_id'] = ['JO No wajib dipilih.'];
            }
            if (isset($data['activity_date']) && $data['activity_date'] === '') {
                $errors['activity_date'] = ['Tanggal Aktivitas wajib diisi.'];
            }
            $allowedActivities = ['Trial', 'Sent Sample', 'Send Document', 'Audit', 'Others'];
            if (! empty($data['activity']) && ! in_array($data['activity'], $allowedActivities, true)) {
                $errors['activity'] = ['Activity wajib dipilih dari salah satu: Trial, Sent Sample, Send Document, Audit, Others.'];
            }
            if (! empty($errors)) {
                throw \Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException::withMessages($errors);
            }
        }

        $existingIndex = null;
        if (! $isNew) {
            foreach ($progresses as $idx => $p) {
                if ($p['id'] === $id) {
                    $existingIndex = $idx;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }

        $existing = $existingIndex !== null ? $progresses[$existingIndex] : [];

        // Build normalized progress record according to Section 16 of PRD
        $notesContent = $data['notes'] ?? $data['description'] ?? $existing['notes'] ?? '';
        $record = [
            'id' => $id,
            'project_id' => $data['project_id'] ?? $existing['project_id'] ?? '',
            'activity' => $data['activity'] ?? $existing['activity'] ?? 'Trial',
            'activity_date' => $data['activity_date'] ?? $existing['activity_date'] ?? date('Y-m-d'),
            'pic_progress' => $data['pic_progress'] ?? $existing['pic_progress'] ?? '',
            'pic_customer' => $data['pic_customer'] ?? $existing['pic_customer'] ?? null,
            'status' => $existing['status'] ?? 'Open',
            'notes' => $notesContent,
            'description' => $notesContent,
            'process_trial' => $data['process_trial'] ?? $existing['process_trial'] ?? null,
            'machine' => $data['machine'] ?? $existing['machine'] ?? null,
            'die_high_raw' => $data['die_high_raw'] ?? $data['dh'] ?? $existing['die_high_raw'] ?? $existing['dh'] ?? null,
            'material_actual_trial' => $data['material_actual_trial'] ?? $existing['material_actual_trial'] ?? null,
            'qty_material_raw' => $data['qty_material_raw'] ?? $existing['qty_material_raw'] ?? null,
            'qty_process_raw' => $data['qty_process_raw'] ?? $existing['qty_process_raw'] ?? null,
            'qty_sample_raw' => $data['qty_sample_raw'] ?? $existing['qty_sample_raw'] ?? null,
            'event_note' => $data['event_note'] ?? $existing['event_note'] ?? null,
            'remark' => $data['remark'] ?? $existing['remark'] ?? null,
            'revision' => ($existing['revision'] ?? 0) + 1,
            'problems' => static::normalizeProblems($data['problems'] ?? $existing['problems'] ?? []),
            'next_actions' => static::normalizeNextActions($data['next_actions'] ?? $existing['next_actions'] ?? []),
            'feedbacks' => static::normalizeFeedbacks($data['feedbacks'] ?? $existing['feedbacks'] ?? []),
            'attachments' => $data['attachments'] ?? $existing['attachments'] ?? [],
        ];

        if ($existingIndex !== null) {
            $progresses[$existingIndex] = $record;
        } else {
            $progresses[] = $record;
        }

        $store['progresses'] = $progresses;
        static::saveStore($store);

        return $record;
    }

    /**
     * Close a progress manually.
     * Per D10: Close is an explicit admin action.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public static function closeProgress(string $id): ?array
    {
        $store = static::all();
        foreach ($store['progresses'] as $idx => $p) {
            if ($p['id'] === $id) {
                $store['progresses'][$idx]['status'] = 'Closed';
                $store['progresses'][$idx]['revision'] = ($p['revision'] ?? 1) + 1;
                static::saveStore($store);
                return $store['progresses'][$idx];
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Reopen a closed progress.
     * Per D10: Reopen preserves all contents, actual dates, problems, actions, and photos.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public static function reopenProgress(string $id): ?array
    {
        $store = static::all();
        foreach ($store['progresses'] as $idx => $p) {
            if ($p['id'] === $id) {
                $store['progresses'][$idx]['status'] = 'Open';
                $store['progresses'][$idx]['revision'] = ($p['revision'] ?? 1) + 1;
                static::saveStore($store);
                return $store['progresses'][$idx];
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Draft Operations
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    */

    /**
     * Get all drafts.
     *
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public static function getDrafts(): array
    {
        return static::all()['drafts'] ?? [];
    }

    /**
     * Find draft by UUID.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public static function findDraft(string $uuid): ?array
    {
        foreach (static::getDrafts() as $draft) {
            if ($draft['uuid'] === $uuid) {
                return $draft;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Save draft payload into store.
     *
     * @param array<string, mixed> $payload
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function saveDraft(array $payload): array
    {
        $store = static::all();
        $drafts = $store['drafts'] ?? [];

        $uuid = $payload['uuid'] ?? (string) Str::uuid();
        $payload['uuid'] = $uuid;
        $payload['updated_at'] = now()->toIso8601String();

        $existingIdx = null;
        foreach ($drafts as $idx => $d) {
            if ($d['uuid'] === $uuid) {
                $existingIdx = $idx;
                break;
            }
        }

        if ($existingIdx !== null) {
            $drafts[$existingIdx] = array_merge($drafts[$existingIdx], $payload);
        } else {
            $drafts[] = $payload;
        }

        $store['drafts'] = $drafts;
        static::saveStore($store);

        return $payload;
    }

    /**
     * Delete draft by UUID.
     */
    public static function deleteDraft(string $uuid): bool
    {
        $store = static::all();
        $initialCount = count($store['drafts'] ?? []);

        $store['drafts'] = array_values(array_filter(
            $store['drafts'] ?? [],
            fn ($d) => $d['uuid'] !== $uuid
        ));

        if (count($store['drafts']) < $initialCount) {
            static::saveStore($store);
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Statistics
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    */

    /**
     * Get counts summary.
     * Per D11: Draft does not count towards Open or Closed.
     *
     * @return array<string, int>
     */
    public static function getStats(): array
    {
        $progresses = static::all()['progresses'] ?? [];

        $openCount = 0;
        $closedCount = 0;

        foreach ($progresses as $p) {
            if (strtolower($p['status'] ?? '') === 'open') {
                $openCount++;
            } elseif (strtolower($p['status'] ?? '') === 'closed') {
                $closedCount++;
            }
        }

        return [
            'total_projects' => count(static::getProjects()),
            'total_progresses' => count($progresses),
            'open_count' => $openCount,
            'closed_count' => $closedCount,
            'draft_count' => count(static::getDrafts()),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Get global dashboard summary stats according to FR17 & AT23.
     * Returns:
     * - open_count: Progress Open tersimpan (excluding drafts)
     * - draft_count: Draft aktif (new and edit)
     * - current_month_count: Aktivitas tersimpan dalam bulan kalender Asia/Jakarta (Open + Closed, excluding drafts, excluding legacy null dates)
     * - current_month_label: Label periode kalender (e.g. "Oktober 2026")
     * - year_month: Format 'Y-m' yang dievaluasi
     *
     * @param string|null $yearMonth Format 'Y-m' (defaults to Asia/Jakarta current month)
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function getGlobalStats(?string $yearMonth = null): array
    {
        $progresses = static::all()['progresses'] ?? [];
        $drafts = static::getDrafts();

        $openCount = 0;
        foreach ($progresses as $p) {
            if (strtolower($p['status'] ?? '') === 'open') {
                $openCount++;
            }
        }

        $draftCount = count($drafts);

        $now = \Illuminate\Support\Carbon::now('Asia/Jakarta')->locale('id');
        $targetYm = $yearMonth ?: $now->format('Y-m');

        if ($yearMonth) {
            $parsed = \Illuminate\Support\Carbon::createFromFormat('Y-m', $yearMonth, 'Asia/Jakarta');
            $monthLabel = $parsed ? $parsed->locale('id')->translatedFormat('F Y') : $yearMonth;
        } else {
            $monthLabel = $now->translatedFormat('F Y');
        }

        $currentMonthCount = 0;
        foreach ($progresses as $p) {
            $date = $p['activity_date'] ?? null;
            if (! empty($date) && str_starts_with($date, $targetYm)) {
                $currentMonthCount++;
            }
        }

        return [
            'open_count' => $openCount,
            'draft_count' => $draftCount,
            'current_month_count' => $currentMonthCount,
            'current_month_label' => $monthLabel,
            'year_month' => $targetYm,
        ];
    }

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Internal Normalization Helpers
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    */

    /**
     * Normalize problems array and their nested corrective actions.
     *
     * @param array<int, mixed> $problems
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    protected static function normalizeProblems(array $problems): array
    {
        $normalized = [];

        foreach ($problems as $i => $prob) {
            $probId = ! empty($prob['id']) ? $prob['id'] : 'prob-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5));
            $actions = [];

            foreach ($prob['corrective_actions'] ?? [] as $j => $act) {
                $actions[] = [
                    'id' => ! empty($act['id']) ? $act['id'] : 'act-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
                    'description' => $act['description'] ?? '',
                    'pic' => $act['pic'] ?? '',
                    'actual_date' => $act['actual_date'] ?? null,
                    'order' => $act['order'] ?? ($j + 1),
                ];
            }

            $normalized[] = [
                'id' => $probId,
                'description' => $prob['description'] ?? '',
                'order' => $prob['order'] ?? ($i + 1),
                'photos' => $prob['photos'] ?? [],
                'corrective_actions' => $actions,
            ];
        }

        return $normalized;
    }

    /**
     * Normalize next actions array.
     *
     * @param array<int, mixed> $nextActions
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    protected static function normalizeNextActions(array $nextActions): array
    {
        $normalized = [];

        foreach ($nextActions as $i => $na) {
            $normalized[] = [
                'id' => ! empty($na['id']) ? $na['id'] : 'next-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
                'description' => $na['description'] ?? '',
                'pic' => $na['pic'] ?? '',
                'actual_date' => $na['actual_date'] ?? null,
                'order' => $na['order'] ?? ($i + 1),
            ];
        }

        return $normalized;
    }

    /**
     * Normalize feedbacks array.
     *
     * @param array<int, mixed> $feedbacks
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    protected static function normalizeFeedbacks(array $feedbacks): array
    {
        $normalized = [];

        foreach ($feedbacks as $i => $fb) {
            $normalized[] = [
                'id' => ! empty($fb['id']) ? $fb['id'] : 'fb-' . Str::lower(Str::random(5)),
                'date' => $fb['date'] ?? null,
                'content' => $fb['content'] ?? '',
                'pic' => $fb['pic'] ?? '',
                'order' => $fb['order'] ?? ($i + 1),
                'files' => $fb['files'] ?? [],
            ];
        }

        return $normalized;
    }
}

namespace App\Prototype;

class PrototypeManager
{
    /**
     * Determine if prototype mode is allowed and active.
     */
    public static function isEnabled(): bool
    {
        // Absolute guard: never allow in production under any circumstance
        if (app()->environment('production')) {
            return false;
        }

        $config = config('prototype.enabled');
        if ($config !== null) {
            return (bool) $config;
        }

        return app()->environment('local', 'testing');
    }

namespace App\Providers;

{
    /**
     * Register any application services.
     */
    public function register(): void
    {
        //
    }

     * Bootstrap any application services.
     */
    public function boot(): void

        Gate::policy(Attachment::class, AttachmentPolicy::class);
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Queries;

use App\Models\Project;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

class ProjectLookup
{
    public function search(string $term, int $limit = 20): Collection
    {
        if (blank($term)) {
            return new Collection;
        }

        $pattern = '%'.strtolower(trim($term)).'%';

        return Project::query()
            ->where(function ($q) use ($pattern) {
                $q->whereRaw('LOWER(jo_no) LIKE ?', [$pattern])
                    ->orWhereRaw('LOWER(part_no) LIKE ?', [$pattern])
                    ->orWhereRaw('LOWER(part_name) LIKE ?', [$pattern]);
            })
            ->orderBy('jo_no')
            ->limit($limit)
            ->get();
    }

    public function find(?int $id): ?Project
    {
        if (! $id) {
            return null;
        }

        return Project::find($id);
    }

    public function allForPicker(): Collection
    {
        return Project::query()
            ->select(['id', 'jo_no', 'part_no', 'part_name', 'customer', 'model', 'no_doc'])
            ->whereNotNull('jo_no')
            ->orderBy('jo_no')
            ->get();
    }
}

FILE: .\app\Services\ProgressDraftService.php

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Data\ProgressPayload;
use App\Exceptions\FeatureNotReady;
use App\Models\Progress;
use App\Models\ProgressDraft;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

final class ProgressDraftService
{
    /** expectedRevision=0 for a new UUID; requestSequence increases per editor. */
    public function save(User $admin, string $draftId, array $input, int $expectedRevision, int $requestSequence, ?int $progressId = null, ?int $baseRevision = null): ProgressDraft
    {
        Gate::forUser($admin)->authorize('create', ProgressDraft::class);
        $progress = $progressId === null ? null : Progress::findOrFail($progressId);
        if ($progress) {
            Gate::forUser($admin)->authorize('update', $progress);
        }
        $draft = ProgressDraft::find($draftId);
        if ($draft) {
            Gate::forUser($admin)->authorize('update', $draft);
        }
        ProgressPayload::fromArray($input, false, $progress, $draft, $admin);
        throw new FeatureNotReady('Autosave revision/sequence (Fase 5)');
    }

    public function discard(User $admin, string $draftId): void
    {
        $draft = ProgressDraft::findOrFail($draftId);
        Gate::forUser($admin)->authorize('delete', $draft);
        throw new FeatureNotReady('Buang draft dan cleanup staging (Fase 5)');
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Support;

use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

final class UiFormat
{
    public static function date(?string $value): string
    {
        return filled($value)
            ? Carbon::parse($value, 'Asia/Jakarta')->locale('id')->isoFormat('DD MMM YYYY')
            : 'Belum diisi';
    }

    public static function time(?string $value): string
    {
        return filled($value)
            ? Carbon::parse($value)->timezone('Asia/Jakarta')->format('H:i')
            : '';
    }
}

<?php

use App\Models\User;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Authentication Defaults
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |

    | as required, but they're a perfect start for most applications.

        'guard' => env('AUTH_GUARD', 'web'),

    |
    | Next, you may define every authentication guard for your application.
    | Of course, a great default configuration has been defined for you
    | which utilizes session storage plus the Eloquent user provider.
    |
    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage

    |
    | Supported: "session"
    |

        ],
    ],

    | All authentication guards have a user provider, which defines how the
    | users are actually retrieved out of your database or other storage
    | system used by the application. Typically, Eloquent is utilized.
    |
    | If you have multiple user tables or models you may configure multiple
    | providers to represent the model / table. These providers may then

    |
    | Supported: "database", "eloquent"
    |
    */

        'users' => [

    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | These configuration options specify the behavior of Laravel's password
    | reset functionality, including the table utilized for token storage
    | and the user provider that is invoked to actually retrieve users.
    |
    | The expiry time is the number of minutes that each reset token will be
    | considered valid. This security feature keeps tokens short-lived so
    | they have less time to be guessed. You may change this as needed.
    |
    | The throttle setting is the number of seconds a user must wait before
    | generating more password reset tokens. This prevents the user from
    | quickly generating a very large amount of password reset tokens.
    |
    */

<?php

use Illuminate\Support\Str;

return [

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Default Session Driver
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option determines the default session driver that is utilized for
    | incoming requests. Laravel supports a variety of storage options to
    | persist session data. Database storage is a great default choice.
    |
    | Supported: "file", "cookie", "database", "memcached",
    |            "redis", "dynamodb", "array"
    |
    */

    'driver' => env('SESSION_DRIVER', 'database'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Lifetime
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may specify the number of minutes that you wish the session
    | to be allowed to remain idle before it expires. If you want them
    | to expire immediately when the browser is closed then you may
    | indicate that via the expire_on_close configuration option.
    |
    */

    'lifetime' => (int) env('SESSION_LIFETIME', 120),

    'expire_on_close' => env('SESSION_EXPIRE_ON_CLOSE', false),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Encryption
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | This option allows you to easily specify that all of your session data
    | should be encrypted before it's stored. All encryption is performed
    | automatically by Laravel and you may use the session like normal.
    |
    */

    'encrypt' => env('SESSION_ENCRYPT', false),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session File Location
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When utilizing the "file" session driver, the session files are placed
    | on disk. The default storage location is defined here; however, you
    | are free to provide another location where they should be stored.
    |
    */

    'files' => storage_path('framework/sessions'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Database Connection
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using the "database" or "redis" session drivers, you may specify a
    | connection that should be used to manage these sessions. This should
    | correspond to a connection in your database configuration options.
    |
    */

    'connection' => env('SESSION_CONNECTION'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Database Table
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using the "database" session driver, you may specify the table to
    | be used to store sessions. Of course, a sensible default is defined
    | for you; however, you're welcome to change this to another table.
    |
    */

    'table' => env('SESSION_TABLE', 'sessions'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cache Store
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | When using one of the framework's cache driven session backends, you may
    | define the cache store which should be used to store the session data
    | between requests. This must match one of your defined cache stores.
    |
    | Affects: "dynamodb", "memcached", "redis"
    |
    */

    'store' => env('SESSION_STORE'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Sweeping Lottery
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Some session drivers must manually sweep their storage location to get
    | rid of old sessions from storage. Here are the chances that it will
    | happen on a given request. By default, the odds are 2 out of 100.
    |
    */

    'lottery' => [2, 100],

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | Session Cookie Name
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | Here you may change the name of the session cookie that is created by

    | since doing so does not grant a meaningful security improvement.
    |
    */

    'cookie' => env(

    ),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    |

    'path' => env('SESSION_PATH', '/'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------

    | This value determines the domain and subdomains the session cookie is

    |
    */

    'domain' => env('SESSION_DOMAIN'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | HTTPS Only Cookies
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |
    | By setting this option to true, session cookies will only be sent back
    | to the server if the browser has a HTTPS connection. This will keep
    | the cookie from being sent to you when it can't be done securely.
    |
    */

    'secure' => env('SESSION_SECURE_COOKIE'),

    /*
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    | HTTP Access Only
    |--------------------------------------------------------------------------
    |

    'http_only' => env('SESSION_HTTP_ONLY', true),

    /*

    'same_site' => env('SESSION_SAME_SITE', 'lax'),

    'partitioned' => env('SESSION_PARTITIONED_COOKIE', false),

FILE: .\database\factories\UserFactory.php
================================================================================
<?php

namespace Database\Factories;

use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\Factory;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * @extends Factory<User>
 */
class UserFactory extends Factory
{
    /**
     * The current password being used by the factory.
     */
    protected static ?string $password;

    /**
     * Define the model's default state.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function definition(): array
    {
        return [
            'name' => fake()->name(),
            'email' => fake()->unique()->safeEmail(),
            'email_verified_at' => now(),
            'password' => static::$password ??= Hash::make('password'),
            'remember_token' => Str::random(10),
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Indicate that the model's email address should be unverified.
     */
    public function unverified(): static
    {
        return $this->state(fn (array $attributes) => [
            'email_verified_at' => null,
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Database\Seeders;

use App\Data\ProgressPayload;
use App\Data\ProjectPayload;
use App\Models\Progress;
use App\Models\Project;
use Illuminate\Database\Seeder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class DevelopmentSeeder extends Seeder
{
    public function run(): void
    {
        $db = config('database.connections.pgsql.database');
        if (! app()->environment('local', 'testing') || ! in_array($db, ['progress_new_model_dev', 'progress_new_model_test'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Fixture hanya untuk database development/test terisolasi.');
        }
        if (Project::exists() || Progress::exists()) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Fixture memerlukan database kosong; tidak menimpa data.');
        }
        $source = json_decode(file_get_contents(resource_path('fixtures/prototype.json')), true, flags: JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        DB::transaction(function () use ($source) {
            $map = [];
            foreach ($source['projects'] as $row) {
                $data = array_intersect_key($row, array_flip(['jo_no', 'part_no', ...ProjectPayload::TEXT, ...ProjectPayload::DATES]));
                $map[$row['id']] = Project::create($data)->id;
            }
            foreach ($source['progresses'] as $row) {
                $data = array_intersect_key($row, array_flip(['activity_date', 'activity', 'status', ...ProgressPayload::TEXT_FIELDS]));
                $data['project_id'] = $map[$row['project_id']];
                $data['description'] = $row['notes'] ?? $row['description'] ?? null;
                $progress = Progress::create($data);
                foreach ($row['problems'] ?? [] as $i => $p) {
                    $problem = $progress->problems()->create(['client_id' => (string) Str::uuid(), 'description' => $p['description'] ?? null, 'position' => $i]);
                    foreach ($p['corrective_actions'] ?? [] as $j => $a) {
                        $problem->correctiveActions()->create([...array_intersect_key($a, array_flip(['description', 'pic', 'actual_date'])), 'client_id' => (string) Str::uuid(), 'position' => $j]);
                    }
                }
                foreach (['next_actions' => 'nextActions', 'feedbacks' => 'feedbacks'] as $key => $relation) {
                    foreach ($row[$key] ?? [] as $i => $child) {
                        $attrs = array_intersect_key($child, array_flip(['description', 'content', 'pic', 'actual_date']));
                        if ($key === 'feedbacks') {
                            $attrs['feedback_date'] = $child['date'] ?? null;
                        }
                        $progress->$relation()->create([...$attrs, 'client_id' => (string) Str::uuid(), 'position' => $i]);
                    }
                }
            }
            $legacy = Progress::factory()->create(['project_id' => reset($map), 'legacy_incomplete' => true, 'activity' => null, 'activity_date' => null]);
            $legacy->legacyDocuments()->create(['source_field' => 'Doc1', 'name' => 'arsip-fiktif.pdf', 'description' => 'Metadata saja; byte file tidak tersedia.']);
        });
    }
}

FILE: .\resources\views\components\ui\error-summary.blade.php
================================================================================
@props(['errors'])

@if($errors->any())
    <div
        id="error-summary"
        class="error-summary"
        role="alert"
        tabindex="-1"
        style="margin-bottom: 20px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #f87171; background-color: #fef2f2; border-radius: 8px; color: #991b1b;"
        x-data="{
            focusTarget(selector) {
                const el = document.querySelector(selector);
                if (el) {
                    el.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'center' });
                    if (typeof el.focus === 'function') {
                        el.focus({ preventScroll: true });
                    }
                }
            }
        }"
        data-testid="error-summary"
    >
        <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 8px;">
            <x-ui.icon name="info" class="w-5 h-5 text-red-600" />
            <span>Terdapat kesalahan pengisian data ({{ $errors->count() }} kesalahan):</span>
        </div>
        <ul style="list-style-type: disc; padding-left: 24px; margin: 0; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6;">
            @php
                $uniqueErrors = [];
                foreach ($errors->getMessages() as $key => $messages) {
                    // Skip alias keys like projectId or activityDate to avoid duplicate lines in summary
                    if (in_array($key, ['projectId', 'activityDate']) && isset($errors->getMessages()[$key === 'projectId' ? 'project_id' : 'activity_date'])) {
                        continue;
                    }
                    foreach ($messages as $msg) {
                        $uniqueErrors[$key] = $msg;
                    }
                }
            @endphp
            @foreach($uniqueErrors as $key => $msg)

                    $target = match($key) {
                        'projectId', 'project_id' => '#f-project',
                        'activityDate', 'activity_date' => '#f-date',
                        'activity' => '#f-activity',
                        'picCustomer', 'pic_customer' => '#f-customerPic',
                        'description' => '#f-description',
                        'processTrial', 'process_trial' => '#f-processTrial',
                        'machine' => '#f-machine',
                        'dieHighRaw', 'die_high_raw' => '#f-dh',
                        'materialActualTrial', 'material_actual_trial' => '#f-material',
                        'qtyMaterialRaw', 'qty_material_raw' => '#f-qtyMaterial',
                        'qtyProcessRaw', 'qty_process_raw' => '#f-qtyProcess',
                        'qtySampleRaw', 'qty_sample_raw' => '#f-qtySample',
                        'eventNote', 'event_note' => '#f-eventNote',
                        'remark' => '#f-remark',
                        default => '#heading-activity'
                    };
                @endphp
                <li>
                    <a
                        href="{{ $target }}"
                        @click.prevent="focusTarget('{{ $target }}')"
                        style="color: #b91c1c; text-decoration: underline; font-weight: 500;"
                    >
                        {{ $msg }}
                    </a>
                </li>
            @endforeach
        </ul>
    </div>
@endif
