FILE: .\resources\views\livewire\prototype\progress-form.blade.php
================================================================================
<div
    x-data="{
    observer: null, linkHandler: null, stopLeaveInterceptor: null, pending: Promise.resolve(), busy: 0, leaving: false,
    requestFailed: false, requestErrorMessage: '', stopRequestInterceptor: null,
    beforeUnloadHandler: null, changeSeq: 0, unconfirmedInput: false,
    init() {
        this.$nextTick(() => this.growAll());
        this.observer = new MutationObserver(() => this.growAll());
        this.observer.observe(this.$el, { childList: true, subtree: true, characterData: true });
        this.stopRequestInterceptor = this.$wire.$interceptMessage(({ onFailure, onError, onSuccess }) => {
            const submittedSeq = this.changeSeq;
            onFailure(() => {
                this.requestFailed = true;
                this.requestErrorMessage = 'Koneksi terputus. Perubahan belum terkonfirmasi.';
            });
            onError(({ response }) => {
                this.requestFailed = true;
                this.requestErrorMessage = response?.status === 419
                    ? 'Sesi berakhir. Pertahankan isian sebelum memuat ulang.'
                    : 'Permintaan gagal. Isian masih ada di form.';
            });
            onSuccess(({ onSync }) => onSync(() => {
                this.requestFailed = false;
                this.requestErrorMessage = '';
                if (submittedSeq === this.changeSeq && this.$wire.autosaveStatus !== 'error') {
                    this.unconfirmedInput = false;
                }
            }));
        });
        this.beforeUnloadHandler = event => {
            if (this.unconfirmedInput || this.requestFailed || this.busy > 0 || this.$wire.autosaveStatus === 'error') {
                event.preventDefault();
                event.returnValue = '';
            }
        };
        window.addEventListener('beforeunload', this.beforeUnloadHandler);
        this.stopLeaveInterceptor = this.$wire.$intercept('leaveEditor', ({ onFinish }) => {
            onFinish(() => { this.leaving = false; });
        });
        this.linkHandler = async event => {
            const link = event.target.closest('a[href]');
            if (!link || event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey || link.hasAttribute('download') || (link.target && link.target !== '_self')) return;
            const target = new URL(link.href, location.href);
            if (target.origin !== location.origin || target.pathname.replace(/\/$/, '') !== location.pathname.replace(/\/$/, '') || link.getAttribute('href').startsWith('#')) return;
            event.preventDefault();
            event.stopImmediatePropagation();
            if (this.leaving) return;
            this.leaving = true;
            try {
                await this.pending;
                await this.$wire.$set('pendingUrl', target.href, false);
                this.$refs.leave.click();
            } catch (_) {
                this.leaving = false;
                this.$dispatch('ui-toast', { message: 'Isian belum tersimpan. Coba lagi sebelum berpindah halaman.' });
            }
        };
        document.addEventListener('click', this.linkHandler, true);
    },
    destroy() {
        this.observer?.disconnect();
        document.removeEventListener('click', this.linkHandler, true);
        this.stopLeaveInterceptor?.();
        this.stopRequestInterceptor?.();
        window.removeEventListener('beforeunload', this.beforeUnloadHandler);
    },
    markInput(el) {
        this.changeSeq++;
        this.unconfirmedInput = true;
        this.grow(el);
    },
    grow(el) {
        if (!el?.matches('.entry-sheet textarea')) return;
        el.style.height = 'auto';
        el.style.height = Math.min(320, Math.max(56, el.scrollHeight + 2)) + 'px';
    },
    growAll() { this.$el.querySelectorAll('.entry-sheet textarea').forEach(el => this.grow(el)); },
    focus(selector) {
        this.$nextTick(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => this.$el.querySelector(selector)?.focus()));
    },
    enqueue(job) {
        this.busy++;
        const task = this.pending.catch(() => {}).then(job);
        this.pending = task
            .catch(() => this.$dispatch('ui-toast', {
                message: 'Lampiran belum tersimpan. Coba pilih file kembali.'
            }))
            .finally(() => { this.busy--; });
        return this.pending;
    },
    pickPhotos(event, problemId) {
        const files = Array.from(event.target.files || []);
        event.target.value = '';
        this.enqueue(async () => {
            for (const file of files) {
                if (!['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'].includes(file.type)) {
                    this.$dispatch('ui-toast', { message: 'Gunakan foto JPG, PNG, atau WebP.' }); continue;
                }
                if (file.size > 2 * 1024 * 1024) {
                    this.$dispatch('ui-toast', { message: 'Gunakan foto di bawah 2 MB.' }); continue;
                }
                const src = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
                    const reader = new FileReader(); reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result);
                    reader.onerror = reject; reader.readAsDataURL(file);
                });
                await this.$wire.$call('attachProblemPhoto', problemId, { name: file.name, src });
            }
        });
    },
    pickFiles(event, owner) {
        const files = Array.from(event.target.files || [], f => ({ name: f.name, size: f.size }));
        event.target.value = '';
        if (files.length) this.enqueue(() => this.$wire.$call('attachFiles', owner, files));
    }
}"
    x-on:input.capture="markInput($event.target)"
    x-on:editor-focus.window="focus($event.detail.selector)"
    x-on:focus-first-error.window="focus('.input-error, [aria-invalid=true]')"
    x-on:keydown.window="if (($event.ctrlKey || $event.metaKey) && $event.key === 'Enter' && !document.querySelector('dialog[open]')) { $event.preventDefault(); if (!busy && !$wire.isClosed) $refs.save.click(); }"
>

    });

<?php

namespace Tests;

use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\TestCase as BaseTestCase;

abstract class TestCase extends BaseTestCase
{
    public function createApplication()
    {
        $app = parent::createApplication();
        $db = $app['config']->get('database.connections.pgsql.database');
        if (! $app->environment('testing') || $app['config']->get('database.default') !== 'pgsql'
            || $db !== 'progress_new_model_test') {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Tests require PostgreSQL database progress_new_model_test; refusing unsafe database.');
        }

        return $app;
    }
}

FILE: .\tests\Browser\foundation.spec.js

import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

async function login(page) {
    if (!process.env.BROWSER_TEST_EMAIL || !process.env.BROWSER_TEST_PASSWORD) throw new Error('Use an isolated development admin via BROWSER_TEST_EMAIL/PASSWORD.');
    await page.goto('/login');
    await page.getByLabel('Email', { exact: true }).fill(process.env.BROWSER_TEST_EMAIL);
    await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill(process.env.BROWSER_TEST_PASSWORD);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Masuk', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/app$/);
}

test('session auth, invalid login, logout, and anonymous data guard', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/prototype');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    await page.getByLabel('Email', { exact: true }).fill('invalid@example.test');
    await page.getByLabel('Password', { exact: true }).fill('wrong');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Masuk', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('alert')).toContainText('Email atau password');
    await login(page);
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Keluar', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
    await page.goto('/prototype');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login$/);
});

for (const viewport of [{ width: 1366, height: 768 }, { width: 1024, height: 768 }, { width: 911, height: 722 }, { width: 768, height: 1024 }, { width: 390, height: 844 }]) {
    test(`existing UI remains usable at ${viewport.width}px`, async ({ page }) => {
        await page.setViewportSize(viewport);
        await login(page);
        for (const query of ['dashboard', 'projects', 'form', 'progresses&id=prog-003', 'drafts']) {
            await page.goto(`/prototype?tab=${query}`);
            await expect(page.locator('main')).toBeVisible();
            expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth + 1)).toBeTruthy();
            if (query === 'form') {
                await expect(page.locator('.entry-section')).toHaveCount(5);
                await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Simpan progress', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
                await expect(page.locator('label').filter({ hasText: 'PIC Progress' })).toHaveCount(0);
            }
        }
        await page.goto('/prototype?tab=projects&action=new');
        await expect(page.locator('dialog[open]')).toBeVisible();
        await expect(page.locator('dialog label').filter({ hasText: /^Spec$/ })).toHaveCount(0);
    });
}

test('empty and unchanged editor navigation do not create drafts; confirmed draft recovers', async ({ page }) => {
    await login(page);
    await page.goto('/prototype?tab=drafts');
    const initial = await page.locator('.draft-card').count();
    await page.goto('/prototype?tab=form');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Kembali ke daftar', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/tab=dashboard/);
    await page.goto('/prototype?tab=drafts');
    await expect(page.locator('.draft-card')).toHaveCount(initial);
    await page.goto('/prototype?tab=form&id=prog-003');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Kembali ke daftar', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/tab=dashboard/);
    await page.goto('/prototype?tab=drafts');
    await expect(page.locator('.draft-card')).toHaveCount(initial);
    await page.goto('/prototype?tab=form&id=prog-003');
    await page.locator('#f-description').fill('Catatan uji browser fiktif');
    await expect(page.locator('#save-indicator')).toContainText('Draft tersimpan');
    await page.reload();
    await expect(page.locator('#f-description')).toHaveValue('Catatan uji browser fiktif');
});

test('project dates can be cleared and Close/Reopen keeps saved data', async ({ page }) => {
    await login(page);
    await page.goto('/prototype?tab=projects&edit=proj-001');
    await page.locator('#master-t0Target').fill('');
    await page.locator('#master-planFinish').fill('');
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Simpan project', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.locator('dialog[open]')).toHaveCount(0);
    await page.goto('/prototype?tab=projects&edit=proj-001');
    await expect(page.locator('#master-t0Target')).toHaveValue('');
    await expect(page.locator('#master-planFinish')).toHaveValue('');
    await page.goto('/prototype?tab=progresses&id=prog-003');
    const before = await page.locator('main').innerText();
    await page.getByTestId('close-progress-btn').click();
    await page.locator('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: 'Close progress', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reopen progress', exact: true })).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reopen progress', exact: true }).click();
    await expect(page.getByTestId('close-progress-btn')).toBeVisible();
    expect(await page.locator('main').innerText()).toBe(before);
});

FILE: .\tests\Feature\PrototypeAutosaveDraftTest.php
================================================================================
<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Livewire\Prototype\DraftList;
use App\Livewire\Prototype\ProgressForm;
use App\Prototype\FakeDraftStore;
use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\PrototypeTestCase as TestCase;

class PrototypeAutosaveDraftTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        FakeStore::reset();
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        FakeStore::reset();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    /**
     * FR12, AT12, AT13: Perubahan data pada form memicu simpan draft secara reaktif
     * tanpa merubah data progress resmi tersimpan di dashboard (D11).
     */
    public function test_at12_at13_autosave_persists_to_draft_without_modifying_saved_progress(): void
    {
        $originalProgress = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertNotNull($originalProgress);
        $originalNotes = $originalProgress['notes'];
        $initialStats = FakeStore::getStats();

        // Buka form edit untuk prog-001
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class, ['progressId' => 'prog-001'])
            ->set('notes', 'CATATAN BARU: Masih dianalisis oleh tim internal (Draft Only)');

        // Verifikasi draft tersimpan di FakeDraftStore
        $draftUuid = $component->get('draftUuid');
        $this->assertNotNull($draftUuid, 'Autosave harus menghasilkan UUID draft');
        $this->assertSame('saved', $component->get('autosaveStatus'));

        $savedDraft = FakeDraftStore::find($draftUuid);
        $this->assertNotNull($savedDraft);
        $this->assertSame('CATATAN BARU: Masih dianalisis oleh tim internal (Draft Only)', $savedDraft['notes']);
        $this->assertSame('prog-001', $savedDraft['progress_id']);
        $this->assertSame('edit', $savedDraft['type']);

        // VERIFIKASI KRITIS: Data progress resmi tersimpan TIDAK BERUBAH (tetap catatan lama)
        $currentProgress = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame($originalNotes, $currentProgress['notes'], 'Data tersimpan tidak boleh berubah sebelum Simpan final');

        // VERIFIKASI KRITIS: Statistik Open/Closed tidak berubah (PRD D11)
        $currentStats = FakeStore::getStats();
        $this->assertSame($initialStats['open_count'], $currentStats['open_count']);
        $this->assertSame($initialStats['closed_count'], $currentStats['closed_count']);
    }

    /**
     * AT14: Membuka form baru tanpa mengisi apapun tidak boleh membuat record draft kosong.
     */
    public function test_at14_opening_empty_form_does_not_create_empty_draft(): void
    {
        $initialDraftCount = FakeDraftStore::count();

        // Buka form baru kosong tanpa modifikasi apapun
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class);

        $this->assertNull($component->get('draftUuid'));
        $this->assertSame($initialDraftCount, FakeDraftStore::count(), 'Form baru kosong tidak boleh menambah record draft');
    }

    /**
     * AT15, AT16: Melanjutkan draft dari URL/UUID memulihkan seluruh data yang disimpan.
     */
    public function test_at15_at16_resuming_draft_restores_all_state(): void
    {
        // 1. Buat draft dengan data spesifik
        $payload = [
            'type' => 'new',
            'project_id' => 'proj-001',
            'activity' => 'Sent Sample',
            'activity_date' => '2026-10-28',
            'notes' => 'Draft pengiriman sampel ke customer',
            'pic_progress' => 'Rahmat Specialist',
            'pic_customer' => 'Mr. Tanaka',
            'machine' => 'KOMATSU 200T',
            'die_high_raw' => '135,5',
        ];
        $draft = FakeDraftStore::save($payload);
        $draftUuid = $draft['uuid'];

        // 2. Buka form dengan parameter query draft
        $component = Livewire::withQueryParams(['draft' => $draftUuid])
            ->test(ProgressForm::class);

        $this->assertSame($draftUuid, $component->get('draftUuid'));
        $this->assertSame('proj-001', $component->get('projectId'));
        $this->assertSame('Sent Sample', $component->get('activity'));
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-28', $component->get('activityDate'));
        $this->assertSame('Draft pengiriman sampel ke customer', $component->get('notes'));
        $this->assertSame('Mr. Tanaka', $component->get('picCustomer'));
        $this->assertSame('KOMATSU 200T', $component->get('machine'));
        $this->assertSame('135,5', $component->get('dieHighRaw'));
    }

    /**
     * FR13, AT17, AT18: Simpan final menerapkan perubahan ke data tersimpan,
     * dan otomatis menghapus draft terkait.
     */
    public function test_at17_at18_final_save_applies_changes_and_deletes_draft(): void
    {
        // Buat draft perubahan untuk prog-001
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class, ['progressId' => 'prog-001'])
            ->set('notes', 'PERUBAHAN FINAL: Masalah flange selesai diperbaiki');

        $draftUuid = $component->get('draftUuid');
        $this->assertNotNull(FakeDraftStore::find($draftUuid));

        // Submit form (Simpan final)
        $component->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors();

        // 1. Progress resmi sekarang telah ter-update dengan catatan baru
        $updatedProgress = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame('PERUBAHAN FINAL: Masalah flange selesai diperbaiki', $updatedProgress['notes']);
        $this->assertSame('Ahmad Fauzi (Fiktif)', $updatedProgress['pic_progress']);

        // 2. Draft terkait harus sudah terhapus otomatis dari FakeDraftStore
        $this->assertNull(FakeDraftStore::find($draftUuid), 'Draft harus otomatis terhapus saat progress final tersimpan');
    }

    /**
     * FR14, AT19: Buang draft melalui DraftList menghapus draft dan menjaga data resmi tetap utuh.
     */
    public function test_at19_discard_draft_removes_draft_and_leaves_saved_data_untouched(): void
    {
        // Buat draft perubahan
        $draft = FakeDraftStore::save([
            'type' => 'edit',
            'progress_id' => 'prog-001',
            'project_id' => 'proj-001',
            'notes' => 'Draft yang akan dibuang',
        ]);
        $draftUuid = $draft['uuid'];

        $originalProgress = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');

        // Buang draft via DraftList
        Livewire::test(DraftList::class)
            ->call('confirmDiscard', $draftUuid)
            ->call('discardDraft', $draftUuid)
            ->assertDispatched('ui-toast');

        // Draft terhapus dari store
        $this->assertNull(FakeDraftStore::find($draftUuid));

        // Progress resmi tetap utuh
        $currentProgress = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame($originalProgress['notes'], $currentProgress['notes']);
    }

    /**
     * UI07, AT37: Indikator status autosave dan simulasi kegagalan simpan (Retry).
     */
    public function test_at37_save_error_simulation_and_retry(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->set('projectId', 'proj-001')
            ->set('notes', 'Uji coba retry autosave');

        // Normal state: saved
        $this->assertSame('saved', $component->get('autosaveStatus'));

        // Toggle simulasi error dan ubah data sehingga ada perubahan yang dicoba disimpan
        $component->set('simulateSaveError', true);
        $component->set('notes', 'Uji coba retry autosave - revisi');
        $component->call('saveDraft');

        $this->assertSame('error', $component->get('autosaveStatus'));
        $component->assertHasErrors(['save']);

        // Kembalikan ke normal lalu retry
        $component->set('simulateSaveError', false);
        $component->call('saveDraft');

        $this->assertSame('saved', $component->get('autosaveStatus'));
    }
}

<?php



namespace Tests\Feature;



use App\Livewire\Prototype\ProgressDetail;

use App\Livewire\Prototype\ProgressForm;

use App\Prototype\FakeStore;

use Livewire\Livewire;

use Tests\PrototypeTestCase as TestCase;



class PrototypeCloseReopenTest extends TestCase

{

    protected function setUp(): void

    {

        parent::setUp();

        $this->withoutVite();

        FakeStore::reset();

    }



    protected function tearDown(): void

    {

        FakeStore::reset();

        parent::tearDown();

    }



    /**

     * FR16, AT20, D10: Close progress berhasil dilakukan meskipun actual date kosong

     * dan tindakan belum selesai (tidak ada syarat kelengkapan data).

     */

    public function test_at20_close_progress_succeeds_even_with_incomplete_actions_or_empty_actual_dates(): void

    {

        // prog-001 di fixture berstatus Open

        $progress = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');

        $this->assertSame('Open', $progress['status']);



        $initialStats = FakeStore::getStats();



        // Panggil closeProgress via komponen ProgressDetail

        Livewire::test(ProgressDetail::class, ['progressId' => 'prog-001'])

            ->call('closeProgress')

            ->assertDispatched('ui-toast')
            ->assertDispatched('progress-closed');



        // Verifikasi di FakeStore

        $updated = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');

        $this->assertSame('Closed', $updated['status']);



        // Verifikasi statistik global: Open berkurang 1, Closed bertambah 1

        $currentStats = FakeStore::getStats();

        $this->assertSame($initialStats['open_count'] - 1, $currentStats['open_count']);

        $this->assertSame($initialStats['closed_count'] + 1, $currentStats['closed_count']);

    }



    /**

     * FR16, AT21, D10: Progress berstatus Closed memblokir edit langsung (Read-Only)

     * dan menampilkan banner serta opsi Reopen.

     */

    public function test_at21_closed_progress_blocks_editing_and_shows_reopen_option(): void

    {

        // Pastikan prog-001 berstatus Closed

        FakeStore::closeProgress('prog-001');



        // 1. Periksa tampilan di ProgressDetail: tombol Reopen aktif, tombol edit disabled

        Livewire::test(ProgressDetail::class, ['progressId' => 'prog-001'])

            ->assertSee('Reopen progress')

            ->assertDontSee('Edit progress')

            ->assertSee('Closed');



        // 2. Buka form edit untuk progress Closed: isClosed = true dan save ditolak

        Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class, ['progressId' => 'prog-001'])
            ->assertRedirect(route('prototype.index', ['tab' => 'progresses', 'detail' => 'prog-001']));

    }



    /**

     * FR16, AT22, D10: Reopen membuka kembali mode edit dan MENJAGA SELURUH ISI DATA

     * (tanpa reset catatan, problem, tindakan, foto, atau parameter mesin).

     */

    public function test_at22_reopening_closed_progress_restores_edit_and_preserves_all_data(): void

    {

        // 1. Simpan progress lengkap dengan problem, corrective action, dan rincian parameter

        $saved = FakeStore::saveProgress([

            'project_id' => 'proj-001',

            'activity' => 'Trial',

            'activity_date' => '2026-10-30',

            'notes' => 'Catatan trial penting yang tidak boleh hilang',

            'pic_progress' => 'Budi QA Specialist',

            'machine' => 'KOMATSU 300T',

            'die_high_raw' => '120,5',

            'problems' => [

                [

                    'id' => 'prob-test-1',

                    'description' => 'Temuan burry 1,5 mm',

                    'corrective_actions' => [

                        [

                            'id' => 'act-test-1',

                            'description' => 'Asah punch die',

                            'pic' => 'Andi Toolmaker',

                            'actual_date' => '2026-10-31',

                        ],

                    ],

                    'photos' => [

                        [

                            'id' => 'ph-test-1',

                            'filename' => 'burry_detail.jpg',

                            'caption' => 'Foto macro burry',

                        ],

                    ],

                ],

            ],

            'next_actions' => [

                [

                    'id' => 'na-test-1',

                    'description' => 'Trial tahap dua minggu depan',

                    'pic' => 'Doni PC',

                ],

            ],

            'feedbacks' => [

                [

                    'id' => 'fb-test-1',

                    'content' => 'Feedback dari customer Toyota',

                    'pic' => 'Mr. Tanaka',

                ],

            ],

        ]);



        $progressId = $saved['id'];



        // 2. Tutup progress

        FakeStore::closeProgress($progressId);

        $closedProgress = FakeStore::findProgress($progressId);

        $this->assertSame('Closed', $closedProgress['status']);



        // 3. Reopen via ProgressDetail

        Livewire::test(ProgressDetail::class, ['progressId' => $progressId])

            ->call('reopenProgress')

            ->assertDispatched('ui-toast')
            ->assertDispatched('progress-reopened');



        // 4. Verifikasi bahwa status kembali Open dan SELURUH data tetap utuh 100% (AT22)

        $reopenedProgress = FakeStore::findProgress($progressId);

        $this->assertSame('Open', $reopenedProgress['status']);

        $this->assertSame('Catatan trial penting yang tidak boleh hilang', $reopenedProgress['notes']);

        $this->assertSame('Budi QA Specialist', $reopenedProgress['pic_progress']);

        $this->assertSame('KOMATSU 300T', $reopenedProgress['machine']);

        $this->assertSame('120,5', $reopenedProgress['die_high_raw']);



        // Verifikasi problem & corrective action tetap utuh

        $this->assertCount(1, $reopenedProgress['problems']);

        $this->assertSame('Temuan burry 1,5 mm', $reopenedProgress['problems'][0]['description']);

        $this->assertSame('Asah punch die', $reopenedProgress['problems'][0]['corrective_actions'][0]['description']);

        $this->assertSame('Andi Toolmaker', $reopenedProgress['problems'][0]['corrective_actions'][0]['pic']);

        $this->assertSame('2026-10-31', $reopenedProgress['problems'][0]['corrective_actions'][0]['actual_date']);

        $this->assertSame('Foto macro burry', $reopenedProgress['problems'][0]['photos'][0]['caption']);



        // Verifikasi next actions & feedbacks tetap utuh

        $this->assertSame('Trial tahap dua minggu depan', $reopenedProgress['next_actions'][0]['description']);

        $this->assertSame('Feedback dari customer Toyota', $reopenedProgress['feedbacks'][0]['content']);



        // 5. Verifikasi di ProgressForm: mode edit dapat diaktifkan kembali via reopenAndEnableEdit

        $formComponent = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class, ['progressId' => $progressId]);

        $this->assertFalse($formComponent->get('isClosed'));

    }



    /**

     * D02, D10: Menutup satu progress tidak mempengaruhi master project dan tidak mengubah progress lain.

     */

    public function test_closing_progress_does_not_affect_project_or_other_progresses(): void

    {

        $prog3Before = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-003');

        $this->assertSame('Open', $prog3Before['status']);



        $prog2Before = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-002');

        $this->assertSame('Closed', $prog2Before['status']);



        $projectBefore = FakeStore::findProject('proj-001');



        // Tutup prog-001

        FakeStore::closeProgress('prog-001');



        // prog-003 tetap Open, prog-002 tetap Closed

        $prog3After = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-003');

        $this->assertSame('Open', $prog3After['status']);



        $prog2After = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-002');

        $this->assertSame('Closed', $prog2After['status']);



        // Master project tidak memiliki status project dan identitasnya tidak berubah

        $projectAfter = FakeStore::findProject('proj-001');

        $this->assertSame($projectBefore['jo_no'], $projectAfter['jo_no']);

        $this->assertSame($projectBefore['part_no'], $projectAfter['part_no']);

        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('status_project', $projectAfter);

    }

}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Livewire\Prototype\Dashboard;
use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\PrototypeTestCase as TestCase;

class PrototypeDashboardTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        FakeStore::reset();
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        FakeStore::reset();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    /**
     * AT23: Ringkasan Open/Draft/bulan menghitung record unik; jumlah anak tidak menggandakan angka.
     */
    public function test_at23_global_stats_counts_unique_records_and_is_immune_to_table_filters(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(Dashboard::class, ['yearMonth' => '2026-10'])
            ->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertSee('RINGKASAN KESELURUHAN')
            // Open count = 5 (padded '05')
            ->assertSeeHtml('data-testid="stat-open"')
            ->assertSee('05')
            // Draft count = 2 (padded '02')
            ->assertSeeHtml('data-testid="stat-draft"')
            ->assertSee('02')
            // Current month activity count = 1 (prog-008, padded '01')
            ->assertSeeHtml('data-testid="stat-month"')
            ->assertSee('01');

        // Apply a strict filter that returns 0 rows in worklist
        $component->set('search', 'NONEXISTENT_KEYWORD_XYZ')
            ->assertSee('Tidak ada progress yang cocok')
            // FR17: Filter on table does NOT mutate global summary numbers
            ->assertSeeHtml('data-testid="stat-open"')
            ->assertSee('05')
            ->assertSeeHtml('data-testid="stat-draft"')
            ->assertSee('02');
    }

    /**
     * AT24: Default dashboard menampilkan progress Open terlama lebih dahulu (FR18).
     */
    public function test_at24_default_sort_displays_open_progresses_oldest_first(): void
    {
        // prog-003 is 2026-02-28 (oldest Open)
        // prog-001 is 2026-03-10
        // prog-005 is 2026-04-02
        // prog-007 is 2026-04-12
        // prog-008 is 2026-10-10 (newest Open)
        Livewire::test(Dashboard::class)
            ->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertSet('status', 'Open')
            ->assertSet('sort', 'oldest')
            ->assertSeeInOrder(['prog-003', 'prog-001', 'prog-005', 'prog-007', 'prog-008'])
            // Closed records must not appear in default Open view
            ->assertDontSee('prog-002')
            ->assertDontSee('prog-004')
            ->assertDontSee('prog-006');
    }

    /**
     * AT24: Urutan terbaru menampilkan progress terbaru lebih dahulu.
     */
    public function test_at24_newest_sort_displays_newest_first(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(Dashboard::class)
            ->set('sort', 'newest')
            ->assertSeeInOrder(['prog-008', 'prog-007', 'prog-005', 'prog-001', 'prog-003']);
    }

    /**
     * AT24 & AT23: Pencarian PIC berdasarkan peran mengembalikan progress unik (tidak berlipat karena problem/action bertingkat).
     */
    public function test_at24_pic_role_filter_guarantees_unique_progress_rows(): void
    {
        session()->forget('prototype_ui_filters');

        // 1. prog-001 has 2 problems and 4 corrective actions.
        // Budi Santoso is in corrective action 1 of problem 1.
        Livewire::test(Dashboard::class)
            ->set('status', 'all')
            ->set('pic', 'Budi Santoso')
            ->set('picRole', 'corrective_action')
            // prog-001 must appear exactly once
            ->assertSee('prog-001')
            ->assertDontSee('prog-005')
            ->assertViewHas('progresses', function ($progresses) {
                return count($progresses) === 1 && $progresses[0]['id'] === 'prog-001';
            });

        session()->forget('prototype_ui_filters');

        // 2. prog-005 has Budi Santoso as PIC in Next Action.
        Livewire::test(Dashboard::class)
            ->set('status', 'all')
            ->set('pic', 'Budi Santoso')
            ->set('picRole', 'next_action')
            ->assertSee('prog-005')
            ->assertDontSee('prog-001')
            ->assertViewHas('progresses', function ($progresses) {
                return count($progresses) === 1 && $progresses[0]['id'] === 'prog-005';
            });

        session()->forget('prototype_ui_filters');

        // 3. Search 'Budi Santoso' with 'all' roles: appears in prog-001 (action) and prog-005 (next_action).
        // Must yield exactly 2 unique rows.
        Livewire::test(Dashboard::class)
            ->set('status', 'all')
            ->set('pic', 'Budi Santoso')
            ->set('picRole', 'all')
            ->assertViewHas('progresses', function ($progresses) {
                $ids = array_column($progresses, 'id');
                return count($progresses) === 2
                    && in_array('prog-001', $ids)
                    && in_array('prog-005', $ids)
                    && count($ids) === count(array_unique($ids));
            });
    }

    /**
     * AT24: Filter Customer, Activity, dan Status bekerja dengan benar.
     */
    public function test_at24_filters_by_customer_activity_and_status(): void
    {
        session()->forget('prototype_ui_filters');

        // Customer filter: PT ASTRA FIKTIF MOTOR
        Livewire::test(Dashboard::class)
            ->set('customer', 'PT ASTRA FIKTIF MOTOR')
            ->assertViewHas('progresses', function ($progresses) {
                foreach ($progresses as $p) {
                    if (($p['project']['customer'] ?? '') !== 'PT ASTRA FIKTIF MOTOR') {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
                return count($progresses) > 0;
            });

        session()->forget('prototype_ui_filters');

        // Activity filter: Send Document
        Livewire::test(Dashboard::class)
            ->set('activity', 'Send Document')
            ->assertViewHas('progresses', function ($progresses) {
                return count($progresses) === 1 && $progresses[0]['activity'] === 'Send Document';
            });

        session()->forget('prototype_ui_filters');

        // Status filter: Closed
        Livewire::test(Dashboard::class)
            ->set('status', 'Closed')
            ->assertViewHas('progresses', function ($progresses) {
                return count($progresses) === 3;
            });
    }

    /**
     * AT24: Tombol Bersihkan Filter (clearFilters) mengembalikan ke kondisi awal.
     */
    public function test_at24_clear_filter_resets_all_fields_to_default(): void
    {
        session()->forget('prototype_ui_filters');

        Livewire::test(Dashboard::class)
            ->set('search', 'Trial')
            ->set('status', 'Closed')
            ->set('activity', 'Trial')
            ->set('customer', 'PT ASTRA FIKTIF MOTOR')
            ->set('pic', 'Budi')
            ->set('picRole', 'corrective_action')
            ->set('sort', 'newest')
            ->call('clearFilters')
            ->assertSet('search', '')
            ->assertSet('status', 'Open')
            ->assertSet('activity', '')
            ->assertSet('customer', '')
            ->assertSet('pic', '')
            ->assertSet('picRole', 'all')
            ->assertSet('sort', 'oldest');
    }

    /**
     * AT25: Diferensiasi pesan empty state antara hasil filter kosong vs default Open kosong.
     */
    public function test_at25_empty_state_differentiation(): void
    {
        // Case A: Filtered empty state
        Livewire::test(Dashboard::class)
            ->set('search', 'KATA_KUNCI_TIDAK_DITEMUKAN')
            ->assertSee('Tidak ada progress yang cocok')
            ->assertSee('Bersihkan filter')
            ->assertDontSee('Tidak ada progress Open');

        // Case B: Default Open empty state
        // Close all open progresses first
        foreach (FakeStore::getProgresses(['status' => 'Open']) as $p) {
            FakeStore::closeProgress($p['id']);
        }

        Livewire::test(Dashboard::class)
            // On default filter (status='Open', search='')
            ->assertSee('Tidak ada progress yang cocok')
            ->assertSee('Bersihkan filter');
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Livewire\Prototype\ProgressForm;
use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\PrototypeTestCase as TestCase;

class PrototypeNestedListsTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        FakeStore::reset();
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        FakeStore::reset();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    /**
     * FR07 & AT07: Struktur dua tingkat Problem (Induk) dan Corrective Action (Anak).
     * Verifikasi: Isi PIC berbeda pada 4 tindakan, tambah problem ketiga, kembali ke problem pertama;
     * tidak ada nilai atau data tindakan yang tertukar.
     */
    public function test_at07_nested_problem_and_corrective_actions_stability(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->set('projectId', 'proj-001')
            ->set('activityDate', '2026-10-25')
            ->set('activity', 'Trial');

        // 1. Problem 1 sudah tersedia di awal form
        $problems = $component->get('problems');
        $this->assertCount(1, $problems);
        $prob1Id = $problems[0]['id'];

        $component->set('problems.0.description', 'Problem 1: Burry pada lubang pierching diameter 8 mm');

        // Tambah 2 Tindakan pada Problem 1 dengan PIC berbeda
        $component->call('addCorrectiveAction', $prob1Id);
        $component->call('addCorrectiveAction', $prob1Id);

        $component->set('problems.0.corrective_actions.0.description', 'Tindakan 1.1: Asah punch die');
        $component->set('problems.0.corrective_actions.0.pic', 'Budi Toolmaker');
        $component->set('problems.0.corrective_actions.0.actual_date', '2026-10-26');

        $component->set('problems.0.corrective_actions.1.description', 'Tindakan 1.2: Check clearance stripper');
        $component->set('problems.0.corrective_actions.1.pic', 'Andi Stamping');
        $component->set('problems.0.corrective_actions.1.actual_date', '2026-10-27');

        // 2. Tambah Problem 2
        $component->call('addProblem');
        $problems = $component->get('problems');
        $this->assertCount(2, $problems);
        $prob2Id = $problems[1]['id'];

        $component->set('problems.1.description', 'Problem 2: Springback sudut bending flange melebihi 2 derajat');

        // Tambah 2 Tindakan pada Problem 2 dengan PIC berbeda
        $component->call('addCorrectiveAction', $prob2Id);
        $component->call('addCorrectiveAction', $prob2Id);

        $component->set('problems.1.corrective_actions.0.description', 'Tindakan 2.1: Shim die bending');
        $component->set('problems.1.corrective_actions.0.pic', 'Joko Maintenance');

        $component->set('problems.1.corrective_actions.1.description', 'Tindakan 2.2: Trial ulang 10 pcs');
        $component->set('problems.1.corrective_actions.1.pic', 'Siti QA');

        // 3. Tambah Problem 3
        $component->call('addProblem');
        $problems = $component->get('problems');
        $this->assertCount(3, $problems);
        $prob3Id = $problems[2]['id'];
        $component->set('problems.2.description', 'Problem 3: Scratch pada permukaan luar part');

        // 4. Verifikasi Nilai Problem 1 dan Problem 2 tetap utuh dan TIDAK tertukar (AT07)
        $currentProblems = $component->get('problems');
        $this->assertSame('Problem 1: Burry pada lubang pierching diameter 8 mm', $currentProblems[0]['description']);
        $this->assertSame('Budi Toolmaker', $currentProblems[0]['corrective_actions'][0]['pic']);
        $this->assertSame('Andi Stamping', $currentProblems[0]['corrective_actions'][1]['pic']);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-26', $currentProblems[0]['corrective_actions'][0]['actual_date']);

        $this->assertSame('Problem 2: Springback sudut bending flange melebihi 2 derajat', $currentProblems[1]['description']);
        $this->assertSame('Joko Maintenance', $currentProblems[1]['corrective_actions'][0]['pic']);
        $this->assertSame('Siti QA', $currentProblems[1]['corrective_actions'][1]['pic']);

        $this->assertSame('Problem 3: Scratch pada permukaan luar part', $currentProblems[2]['description']);

        // 5. Hapus Problem 2 -> Problem 1 dan Problem 3 tetap ada dengan data lengkap
        $component->call('removeProblem', $prob2Id);
        $afterDelete = $component->get('problems');
        $this->assertCount(2, $afterDelete);
        $this->assertSame($prob1Id, $afterDelete[0]['id']);
        $this->assertSame('Budi Toolmaker', $afterDelete[0]['corrective_actions'][0]['pic']);
        $this->assertSame($prob3Id, $afterDelete[1]['id']);
        $this->assertSame('Problem 3: Scratch pada permukaan luar part', $afterDelete[1]['description']);
    }

    /**
     * FR08 & AT08: Next Action berdiri sendiri sebagai saudara problem, bukan anak dari problem (D07).
     */
    public function test_at08_next_actions_stand_independently(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->set('projectId', 'proj-001')
            ->set('activityDate', '2026-10-25')
            ->set('activity', 'Trial');

        // Tambah Next Action ke-2 (Next Action ke-1 sudah tersedia di awal)
        $component->call('addNextAction');

        $this->assertCount(2, $component->get('nextActions'));

        $component->set('nextActions.0.description', 'Jadwalkan Trial 2 bersama pihak Customer');
        $component->set('nextActions.0.pic', 'Doni Project Coordinator');
        $component->set('nextActions.0.actual_date', '2026-10-28');

        $component->set('nextActions.1.description', 'Kirim sample trial pertama ke lab CMM');
        $component->set('nextActions.1.pic', 'Eko Lab CMM');

        // Pastikan problems tetap kosong (tidak tertukar)
        $this->assertCount(1, $component->get('problems'));

        // Hapus salah satu next action
        $na1Id = $component->get('nextActions')[0]['id'];
        $component->call('removeNextAction', $na1Id);

        $this->assertCount(1, $component->get('nextActions'));
        $this->assertSame('Kirim sample trial pertama ke lab CMM', $component->get('nextActions')[0]['description']);
    }

    /**

    public function test_at09_feedback_entries_are_repeatable_and_independent(): void

    /**
     * FR10, FR11, FR19 & AT10, AT11, AT26: Galeri foto per problem dengan caption dan badge [SIMULASI].
     */
    public function test_at10_gallery_photos_per_problem_with_simulation_badge(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->set('projectId', 'proj-001')
            ->set('activityDate', '2026-10-25')
            ->set('activity', 'Trial');

        $component->call('addProblem');
        $probId = $component->get('problems')[0]['id'];

        // Tambah 2 foto simulasi pada problem
        $component->call('addSimulationPhoto', $probId);
        $component->call('addSimulationPhoto', $probId);

        $problems = $component->get('problems');
        $this->assertCount(2, $problems[0]['photos']);

        $component->set('problems.0.photos.0.caption', 'Foto burry pada lubang pierching');
        $component->set('problems.0.photos.1.caption', 'Grafik hasil pengukuran CMM');

        $component->assertSee('[SIMULASI]')
            ->assertSee('Foto burry pada lubang pierching');

        // Hapus foto pertama
        $ph1Id = $problems[0]['photos'][0]['id'];
        $component->call('removeSimulationPhoto', $probId, $ph1Id);

        $updatedProblems = $component->get('problems');
        $this->assertCount(1, $updatedProblems[0]['photos']);
        $this->assertSame('Grafik hasil pengukuran CMM', $updatedProblems[0]['photos'][0]['caption']);
    }

    /**
     * Menyimpan form final ke FakeStore menyimpan seluruh relasi graf bertingkat secara utuh.
     */
    public function test_save_persists_complete_nested_graph_to_fake_store(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->set('projectId', 'proj-001')
            ->set('activityDate', '2026-10-29')
            ->set('activity', 'Trial')
            ->set('notes', 'Full test of nested relations');

        // 1 problem with 1 action & 1 photo
        $component->call('addProblem');
        $probId = $component->get('problems')[0]['id'];
        $component->set('problems.0.description', 'Problem Utama');
        $component->call('addCorrectiveAction', $probId);
        $component->set('problems.0.corrective_actions.0.description', 'Tindakan Korektif');
        $component->set('problems.0.corrective_actions.0.pic', 'PIC Khusus');
        $component->call('addSimulationPhoto', $probId);
        $component->set('problems.0.photos.0.caption', 'Foto Bukti');

        // 1 next action
        $component->call('addNextAction');
        $component->set('nextActions.0.description', 'Langkah Lanjutan Mandiri');
        $component->set('nextActions.0.pic', 'PIC Next');

        // 1 feedback
        $component->call('addFeedback');
        $component->set('feedbacks.0.content', 'Feedback Customer Terkait');
        $component->set('feedbacks.0.pic', 'PIC Customer');

        // Simpan final
        $component->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors();

        // Verifikasi FakeStore
        $progresses = FakeStore::getProgresses(['project_id' => 'proj-001', 'activity' => 'Trial']);
        $saved = end($progresses);

        $this->assertNotEmpty($saved['problems']);
        $this->assertSame('Problem Utama', $saved['problems'][0]['description']);
        $this->assertSame('Tindakan Korektif', $saved['problems'][0]['corrective_actions'][0]['description']);
        $this->assertSame('PIC Khusus', $saved['problems'][0]['corrective_actions'][0]['pic']);
        $this->assertSame('Foto Bukti', $saved['problems'][0]['photos'][0]['caption']);

        $this->assertNotEmpty($saved['next_actions']);
        $this->assertSame('Langkah Lanjutan Mandiri', $saved['next_actions'][0]['description']);
        $this->assertSame('PIC Next', $saved['next_actions'][0]['pic']);

        $this->assertNotEmpty($saved['feedbacks']);
        $this->assertSame('Feedback Customer Terkait', $saved['feedbacks'][0]['content']);
        $this->assertSame('PIC Customer', $saved['feedbacks'][0]['pic']);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Livewire\Prototype\ProgressForm;

class PrototypeProgressFormTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        FakeStore::reset();
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        FakeStore::reset();

    /**
     * FR04 & AT05: 1 Form Identik untuk Seluruh 5 Activity.
     * Mengubah Activity tidak mereset atau menghilangkan isian rincian trial.
     */
    public function test_at05_form_structure_is_identical_across_all_five_activities(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            // Pastikan 5 pilihan activity tersedia
            ->assertSee('Trial')
            ->assertSee('Sent Sample')
            ->assertSee('Send Document')
            ->assertSee('Audit')
            ->assertSee('Others')
            // Isi data rincian parameter trial
            ->set('projectId', 'proj-001')
            ->set('machine', 'KOMATSU 300T PRESS')
            ->set('dieHighRaw', '120,5')
            ->set('processTrial', 'OP10 DRAWING')
            ->set('materialActualTrial', 'SPCC 1.2 x 350')
            ->set('qtyMaterialRaw', '15,5')
            ->set('qtyProcessRaw', '10')
            ->set('qtySampleRaw', '2,5')
            ->set('eventNote', 'Uji coba tooling batch pertama')
            ->set('remark', 'Perlu penyesuaian radius R3');

        // Verifikasi pada activity awal (Trial)
        $this->assertSame('', $component->get('activity'));
        $this->assertSame('KOMATSU 300T PRESS', $component->get('machine'));
        $this->assertSame('120,5', $component->get('dieHighRaw'));

        // Ubah Activity ke 'Sent Sample' (FR04 / AT05)
        $component->call('setActivity', 'Sent Sample');
        $this->assertSame('Sent Sample', $component->get('activity'));
        $this->assertSame('KOMATSU 300T PRESS', $component->get('machine'), 'Nilai mesin tidak boleh hilang saat pindah ke Sent Sample');
        $this->assertSame('120,5', $component->get('dieHighRaw'), 'Nilai DH tidak boleh hilang saat pindah ke Sent Sample');
        $this->assertSame('OP10 DRAWING', $component->get('processTrial'));

        // Ubah Activity ke 'Others'
        $component->call('setActivity', 'Others');
        $this->assertSame('Others', $component->get('activity'));
        $this->assertSame('KOMATSU 300T PRESS', $component->get('machine'), 'Nilai mesin tidak boleh hilang saat pindah ke Others');
        $this->assertSame('120,5', $component->get('dieHighRaw'), 'Nilai DH tidak boleh hilang saat pindah ke Others');

        // Ubah Activity ke 'Send Document'
        $component->call('setActivity', 'Send Document');
        $this->assertSame('Send Document', $component->get('activity'));
        $this->assertSame('KOMATSU 300T PRESS', $component->get('machine'));

        // Ubah Activity ke 'Audit'
        $component->call('setActivity', 'Audit');
        $this->assertSame('Audit', $component->get('activity'));
        $this->assertSame('KOMATSU 300T PRESS', $component->get('machine'));
    }

    /**
     * FR05 & AT06: PIC Progress dan PIC Customer teks bebas tanpa ketergantungan akun/master PIC.
     * Raw text mempertahankan koma dan titik (misal '1,5' dan '1.5') tanpa konversi otomatis.

    public function test_at06_pic_and_raw_text_formatting_preserved(): void

        $progresses = FakeStore::getProgresses(['project_id' => 'proj-001']);

    /**
     * FR02 & AT03: Memilih JO otomatis memicu autofill 5 field identitas hanya-baca dari Master Project terkini.
     */
    public function test_at03_autofill_five_identity_fields_from_current_project_master(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class);

        // Awalnya belum memilih JO -> data identitas kosong
        $this->assertNull($component->get('selectedProject'));

        // Pilih proj-001 (JO: 0012/NM/2026)
        $component->set('projectId', 'proj-001');
        $selected = $component->get('selectedProject');

        $this->assertNotNull($selected);
        $this->assertSame('0012/NM/2026', $selected['jo_no']);
        $this->assertSame('0091-XYZ-01', $selected['part_no']);
        $this->assertSame('BRACKET FRONT LH (FIKTIF)', $selected['part_name']);
        $this->assertSame('PT ASTRA FIKTIF MOTOR', $selected['customer']);
        $this->assertSame('K-FIKTIF-1', $selected['model']);
        $this->assertSame('DOC-001/2026', $selected['no_doc']);

        // Komponen merender identitas di view
        $component->assertSee('BRACKET FRONT LH (FIKTIF)')
            ->assertSee('0091-XYZ-01')
            ->assertSee('PT ASTRA FIKTIF MOTOR')
            ->assertSee('K-FIKTIF-1')
            ->assertSee('DOC-001/2026');

        // Ganti ke proj-002 (JO: 0450/NM/2026)
        $component->set('projectId', 'proj-002');
        $selected2 = $component->get('selectedProject');

        $this->assertSame('0450/NM/2026', $selected2['jo_no']);
        $this->assertSame('08234-K0100', $selected2['part_no']);
        $this->assertSame('COVER SIDE LOWER (FIKTIF)', $selected2['part_name']);
        $component->assertSee('COVER SIDE LOWER (FIKTIF)');
    }

    /**
     * Validasi Simpan Baru: Hanya 3 field wajib (project_id, activity_date, activity).
     * Problem/action/foto/rincian trial adalah opsional untuk simpan awal.
     */
    public function test_validation_new_progress_only_requires_three_mandatory_fields(): void
    {
        // 1. Submit tanpa field wajib -> error pada 3 field wajib
        Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->set('projectId', '')
            ->set('activityDate', '')
            ->set('activity', '')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasErrors(['projectId', 'activityDate', 'activity']);

        // 2. Isi HANYA 3 field wajib -> berhasil disimpan tanpa error
        Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->set('projectId', 'proj-001')
            ->set('activityDate', '2026-10-20')
            ->set('activity', 'Audit')
            ->set('notes', '') // Catatan kosong diperbolehkan untuk simpan cepat awal
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasNoErrors();

        // Pastikan progress tercatat dengan status default Open
        $progresses = FakeStore::getProgresses(['project_id' => 'proj-001', 'activity' => 'Audit']);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($progresses);
        $this->assertSame('Open', end($progresses)['status']);
    }

    /**
     * PRD D11: Simpan draft tidak mempengaruhi hitungan statistik Open / Closed.
     */
    public function test_d11_save_draft_does_not_affect_open_closed_statistics(): void
    {
        $statsInitial = FakeStore::getStats();
        $initialDraftCount = count(FakeStore::getDrafts());

        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->set('projectId', 'proj-001')
            ->set('activity', 'Trial')
            ->set('activityDate', '2026-10-21')
            ->set('notes', 'DRAFT: Hasil trial sementara masih dianalisis')
            ->call('saveDraft');

        $draftUuid = $component->get('draftUuid');
        $this->assertNotNull($draftUuid);
        $this->assertSame('saved', $component->get('autosaveStatus'));

        // Cek bahwa jumlah draft bertambah
        $draftsAfter = FakeStore::getDrafts();
        $this->assertCount($initialDraftCount + 1, $draftsAfter);

        // Cek bahwa statistik Open dan Closed TIDAK berubah (PRD D11)
        $statsAfter = FakeStore::getStats();
        $this->assertSame($statsInitial['open_count'], $statsAfter['open_count'], 'Draft tidak boleh menambah open count');
        $this->assertSame($statsInitial['closed_count'], $statsAfter['closed_count'], 'Draft tidak boleh menambah closed count');

        // Pastikan draft dapat dimuat kembali
        $loadedDraft = FakeStore::findDraft($draftUuid);
        $this->assertNotNull($loadedDraft);
        $this->assertSame('DRAFT: Hasil trial sementara masih dianalisis', $loadedDraft['notes']);
    }

    /**
     * Menyimpan progress final menghapus draft terkait bila sebelumnya disimpan sebagai draft.
     */
    public function test_saving_final_progress_cleans_up_associated_draft(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->set('projectId', 'proj-001')
            ->set('activity', 'Sent Sample')
            ->set('activityDate', '2026-10-22')
            ->set('notes', 'Sampel dikirim ke customer')
            ->call('saveDraft');

        $draftUuid = $component->get('draftUuid');
        $this->assertNotNull(FakeStore::findDraft($draftUuid));

        // Submit form final
        $component->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors();

        // Draft harus sudah terhapus
        $this->assertNull(FakeStore::findDraft($draftUuid), 'Draft harus otomatis terhapus saat progress final tersimpan');
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Livewire\Prototype\ProjectDetail;
use App\Livewire\Prototype\ProjectForm;
use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\PrototypeTestCase as TestCase;

class PrototypeProjectTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        FakeStore::reset();
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        FakeStore::reset();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    /**
     * AT01: JO yang sudah ada ditolak pada project baru; tidak muncul project kedua.
     */
    public function test_at01_duplicate_jo_no_is_rejected_on_new_project(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class)
            ->set('jo_no', '0012/NM/2026') // Existing JO in proj-001
            ->set('part_no', '9988-UNIQUE-PART')
            ->set('part_name', 'TEST DUPLICATE JO')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasErrors(['jo_no'])
            ->assertSee("JO No &#039;0012/NM/2026&#039; sudah digunakan pada project lain.", false);

        // Ensure total projects remains 3
        $this->assertCount(3, FakeStore::getProjects());
    }

    /**
     * AT02: Part No yang sudah dipakai JO lain ditolak; nol di depan tetap utuh.
     */
    public function test_at02_duplicate_part_no_is_rejected_and_leading_zeros_preserved(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class)
            ->set('jo_no', '8888/NM/2026')
            ->set('part_no', '0091-XYZ-01') // Existing Part No in proj-001 with leading zero
            ->set('part_name', 'TEST DUPLICATE PART')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasErrors(['part_no'])
            ->assertSee("Part No &#039;0091-XYZ-01&#039; sudah digunakan pada project lain.", false);

        // Ensure total projects remains 3
        $this->assertCount(3, FakeStore::getProjects());

        // Test creating a new valid project with leading zeros
        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class)
            ->set('jo_no', '0007/NM/2026')
            ->set('part_no', '00045-K0001')
            ->set('part_name', 'COVER FRONT LH TEST')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasNoErrors();

        $saved = FakeStore::findProject('0007/NM/2026');
        $this->assertNotNull($saved);
        $this->assertSame('0007/NM/2026', $saved['jo_no']);
        $this->assertSame('00045-K0001', $saved['part_no']);
        $this->assertCount(4, FakeStore::getProjects());
    }

    /**
     * AT03: Koreksi Part Name / Customer master terlihat pada progress lama tanpa mengubah uraian kegiatan.
     */
    public function test_at03_updating_master_project_reflects_in_old_progress(): void
    {
        // prog-001 belongs to proj-001
        $progBefore = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame('BRACKET FRONT LH (FIKTIF)', $progBefore['project']['part_name']);
        $originalNotes = $progBefore['notes'];

        // Edit master proj-001 through ProjectForm
        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class, ['projectId' => 'proj-001'])
            ->assertSet('jo_no', '0012/NM/2026')
            ->assertSet('part_no', '0091-XYZ-01')
            ->set('part_name', 'BRACKET FRONT LH (REVISI DESIGN MASTER)')
            ->set('customer', 'PT ASTRA HONDA FIKTIF')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasNoErrors();

        // Re-read progress: must reflect dynamic new master identity
        $progAfter = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame('BRACKET FRONT LH (REVISI DESIGN MASTER)', $progAfter['project']['part_name']);
        $this->assertSame('PT ASTRA HONDA FIKTIF', $progAfter['project']['customer']);
        $this->assertSame($originalNotes, $progAfter['notes'], 'Uraian kegiatan progress tidak boleh berubah');
    }

    /**
     * AT04: T0 Target/Actual, jadwal, dan Event 1 sampai 3 tersimpan manual.
     */
    public function test_at04_master_schedule_and_events_saved_manually(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class)
            ->set('jo_no', '0999/NM/2026')
            ->set('part_no', '08999-XYZ-99')
            ->set('part_name', 'STAMPING TEST SCHEDULE')
            ->set('t0_target', '2026-05-10')
            ->set('t0_actual', '2026-05-15')
            ->set('event_1', '2026-06-01')
            ->set('event_2', '2026-07-01')
            ->set('event_3', '2026-08-01')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasNoErrors();

        $saved = FakeStore::findProject('0999/NM/2026');
        $this->assertSame('2026-05-10', $saved['t0_target']);
        $this->assertSame('2026-05-15', $saved['t0_actual']);
        $this->assertSame('2026-06-01', $saved['event_1']);
        $this->assertSame('2026-07-01', $saved['event_2']);
        $this->assertSame('2026-08-01', $saved['event_3']);
    }

    /**
     * D02 & FR01: Project User dan Status Project tidak mempunyai field di tampilan dan form.
     */
    public function test_d02_project_user_and_status_project_removed_completely(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class)
            ->assertDontSee('Project User')
            ->assertDontSee('Status Project');

        Livewire::test(ProjectDetail::class, ['projectId' => 'proj-001'])
            ->assertDontSee('Project User')
            ->assertDontSee('Status Project')
            ->assertSee('BRACKET FRONT LH (FIKTIF)')
            ->assertSee('0012/NM/2026');
    }
}

namespace Tests\Feature;

use Tests\PrototypeTestCase as TestCase;

class PrototypeRouteTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
    }
    public function test_prototype_route_is_accessible_in_testing_environment(): void
    {
        config(['prototype.enabled' => true]);

        $response = $this->get('/prototype');
        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $response->assertSee('PROTOTYPE');
        $response->assertSee('Progress New Model');
    }

    public function test_root_redirects_to_prototype_when_enabled(): void
    {
        config(['prototype.enabled' => true]);

        $response = $this->get('/');
        $response->assertRedirect(route('app'));
    }

    public function test_prototype_route_aborts_404_when_prototype_is_disabled(): void
    {
        config(['prototype.enabled' => false]);

        $response = $this->get('/prototype');
        $response->assertStatus(404);
    }

    public function test_prototype_route_aborts_404_in_production_environment(): void
    {
        $this->app['env'] = 'production';
        config(['prototype.enabled' => true]);

        $response = $this->get('/prototype');
        $response->assertStatus(404);
    }

    public function test_root_renders_welcome_page_when_prototype_disabled(): void
    {
        config(['prototype.enabled' => false]);

        $response = $this->get('/');
        $response->assertRedirect(route('app'));
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Livewire\Prototype\Shell;
use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\PrototypeTestCase as TestCase;

class PrototypeShellTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        FakeStore::reset();
    }

    public function test_shell_renders_successfully_with_initial_stats(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(Shell::class)
            ->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertSee('RINGKASAN KESELURUHAN')
            ->assertSee('Progress Open')
            ->assertSee('Draft')
            ->assertSee('Aktivitas bulan ini');
    }

    public function test_shell_switches_tabs(): void
    {
        // Projects Tab
        Livewire::test(Shell::class, ['tab' => 'projects'])
            ->assertSee('Project Master')
            ->assertSee('0012/NM/2026')
            ->assertSee('0091-XYZ-01');

        // Progresses Tab
        Livewire::test(Shell::class, ['tab' => 'progresses'])
            ->assertSee('Semua progress')
            ->assertSee('Trial')
            ->assertSee('Sent Sample');

        // Drafts Tab
        Livewire::test(Shell::class, ['tab' => 'drafts'])
            ->assertSee('Draft')
            ->assertSee('Lanjutkan');

        // Components Tab
        Livewire::test(Shell::class, ['tab' => 'components'])
            ->assertSee('Pustaka Komponen UI Terstandardisasi')
            ->assertSee('Simpan (Primary)')
            ->assertSee('Burry 1,5 mm');
    }

    public function test_shell_reset_action_restores_fixtures(): void
    {
        // Mutate store
        FakeStore::saveProgress([
            'project_id' => 'proj-001',
            'activity' => 'Trial',
            'notes' => 'Mutated test notes',
        ]);

        $this->assertCount(9, FakeStore::getProgresses());

        // Call resetData on component
        Livewire::test(Shell::class)
            ->call('resetData')
            ->assertDispatched('fixture-reset')
            ->assertSee('Data simulasi prototype berhasil direset');

        // Verify FakeStore is back to 8
        $this->assertCount(8, FakeStore::getProgresses());
    }
}

    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)

            ->set('activityDate', '2026-10-25')

        $prob1Id = $component->get('problems')[0]['id'];
        $component->set('problems.0.description', 'Problem 1');
        $component->set('problems.0.corrective_actions.0.description', 'CA 1.1');

        $component->set('problems.0.corrective_actions.1.pic', 'Andi 1');
        $component->set('problems.0.corrective_actions.1.actual_date', '2026-10-27');

        // Problem 2
        $component->call('addProblem');
        $prob2Id = $component->get('problems')[1]['id'];
        $component->set('problems.1.description', 'Problem 2');
        $component->set('problems.1.corrective_actions.0.description', 'CA 2.1');
        $component->set('problems.1.corrective_actions.0.pic', 'Joko 2');
        $component->set('problems.1.corrective_actions.0.actual_date', '2026-10-28');

        $component->set('problems.1.corrective_actions.1.description', 'CA 2.2');
        $component->set('problems.1.corrective_actions.1.pic', 'Siti 2');
        $component->set('problems.1.corrective_actions.1.actual_date', '2026-10-29');

        $component->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors();

        $progresses = FakeStore::getProgresses(['project_id' => 'proj-001']);
        $saved = end($progresses);

        $this->assertCount(2, $saved['problems']);

        $this->assertCount(2, $saved['problems'][1]['corrective_actions']);

        $this->assertSame('Andi 1', $saved['problems'][0]['corrective_actions'][1]['pic']);
        $this->assertSame('Joko 2', $saved['problems'][1]['corrective_actions'][0]['pic']);

        $stillInitial = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame($origNotes, $stillInitial['notes'] ?? '');

        // Buka kembali form dengan draft
        $restored = Livewire::withQueryParams(['draft' => $draftUuid])
            ->test(ProgressForm::class);

        // Close progress
        FakeStore::closeProgress('prog-001');

        // Simpan draft untuk progress Closed tersebut
        $draft = FakeDraftStore::save([
            'progress_id' => 'prog-001',
            'project_id' => 'proj-001',
            'activity' => 'Trial',
            'notes' => 'Mencoba edit progress closed',
        ]);

        $component = Livewire::withQueryParams(['draft' => $draft['uuid']])
            ->test(ProgressForm::class);

        $component->assertRedirect(route('prototype.index', ['tab' => 'progresses', 'detail' => 'prog-001']));

        // Reopen progress lalu form dapat dimuat dan disimpan
        FakeStore::reopenProgress('prog-001');

        $component = Livewire::withQueryParams(['draft' => $draft['uuid']])
            ->test(ProgressForm::class);

        $this->assertFalse($component->get('isClosed'));
        $component->call('save')->assertHasNoErrors();
    }

    public function test_can_remove_and_confirmation_modal_flow(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class, ['progressId' => 'prog-001']);
        $initialProblems = $component->get('problems');
        $savedProblemId = $initialProblems[0]['id'];

        // Record tersimpan TIDAK boleh dihapus
        $this->assertFalse($component->instance()->canRemove('problem', $savedProblemId));

        $component->call('promptRemove', 'problem', $savedProblemId);
        $this->assertNull($component->get('pendingRemoval'));
        $component->assertHasErrors(['remove']);

        // Tambah baris baru
        $component->call('addProblem');
        $newProblems = $component->get('problems');
        $newProblemId = end($newProblems)['id'];

        $this->assertTrue($component->instance()->canRemove('problem', $newProblemId));

        // Minta hapus baris baru -> Munculkan dialog konfirmasi
        $component->call('promptRemove', 'problem', $newProblemId);
        $this->assertSame('problem', $component->get('pendingRemoval.type'));
        $this->assertSame($newProblemId, $component->get('pendingRemoval.id'));

        // Batal
        $component->call('cancelRemove');
        $this->assertNull($component->get('pendingRemoval'));
        $this->assertCount(count($newProblems), $component->get('problems'));

        // Minta lagi lalu konfirmasi hapus
        $component->call('promptRemove', 'problem', $newProblemId);
        $component->call('confirmRemove');

        $this->assertNull($component->get('pendingRemoval'));
        $this->assertCount(count($initialProblems), $component->get('problems'));
    }
}

     */

    {
        // Prog-001 awal
        $initial = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $savedNotes = $initial['notes'] ?? '';

        // Simpan draft perubahan untuk prog-001
        FakeDraftStore::save([
            'progress_id' => 'prog-001',
            'project_id' => 'proj-001',
            'activity' => 'Trial',
            'notes' => 'Catatan draft yang belum di-apply',
        ]);

        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressDetail::class, ['progressId' => 'prog-001'])
            ->assertSee($savedNotes)
            ->assertDontSee('Catatan draft yang belum di-apply')
            ->assertSee('Ada draft perubahan. Data di halaman ini adalah versi yang terakhir diterapkan.')
            ->assertSee('Lanjutkan draft');
    }

    /**
     * Close manual melalui konfirmasi, tanpa syarat actual date kosong.
     * Semua catatan, problem, dan tindakan tetap tersimpan.
     */
    public function test_close_progress_with_modal_flow(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressDetail::class, ['progressId' => 'prog-001']);
        $this->assertFalse($component->get('confirmingClose'));

        // Buka dialog konfirmasi
        $component->call('openConfirmClose');
        $this->assertTrue($component->get('confirmingClose'));

        // Batal konfirmasi
        $component->call('cancelConfirmClose');
        $this->assertFalse($component->get('confirmingClose'));
        $this->assertSame('Open', FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001')['status']);

        // Buka lagi lalu konfirmasi
        $component->call('openConfirmClose');
        $component->call('confirmCloseProgress');

        $this->assertFalse($component->get('confirmingClose'));
        $closed = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame('Closed', $closed['status']);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($closed['problems']);
        $this->assertNotEmpty($closed['next_actions']);

        // Komponen menampilkan tombol Reopen
        $component->assertSee('Reopen progress');
    }

     */
    public function test_reopen_progress_preserves_all_children(): void
    {

        // Batal

        // Minta lagi lalu konfirmasi buang

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Livewire\Prototype\ProgressForm;
use App\Prototype\FakeDraftStore;
use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\PrototypeTestCase as TestCase;

class PrototypeUiParityRegressionTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        session()->forget('prototype_ui_filters');
        FakeStore::reset();
    }

    public function test_new_editor_is_blank_but_first_rows_are_ready_without_creating_draft(): void
    {
        $before = count(FakeDraftStore::all());
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->assertSet('activity', '')->assertSet('activityDate', '');
        $this->assertCount(1, $component->get('problems'));
        $this->assertCount(1, $component->get('problems')[0]['corrective_actions']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $component->get('nextActions'));
        $this->assertCount(1, $component->get('feedbacks'));
        $this->assertSame($before, count(FakeDraftStore::all()));
    }

    public function test_opening_saved_progress_resumes_draft_and_keeps_applied_record_separate(): void
    {
        $before = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $draft = FakeDraftStore::save([
            'uuid' => 'audit-resume', 'progress_id' => 'prog-001',
            'project_id' => 'proj-001', 'activity' => 'Trial',
            'notes' => 'Perubahan yang belum diterapkan',
        ]);
        Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class, ['progressId' => 'prog-001'])
            ->assertSet('draftUuid', $draft['uuid'])
            ->assertSet('notes', 'Perubahan yang belum diterapkan');
        $this->assertSame($before, FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001'));
    }

    public function test_closed_url_uses_read_only_detail(): void
    {
        FakeStore::closeProgress('prog-001');
        Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class, ['progressId' => 'prog-001'])
            ->assertRedirect(route('prototype.index', ['tab' => 'progresses', 'detail' => 'prog-001']));
    }

    public function test_new_feedback_has_no_automatic_date(): void
    {

        $this->assertSame('', $component->get('feedbacks')[1]['date']);
    }

    public function test_selected_photo_and_documents_are_kept_in_draft_and_photo_open_does_not_delete(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class);
        $problemId = $component->get('problems')[0]['id'];
        $feedbackId = $component->get('feedbacks')[0]['id'];
        $image = 'data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mP8/x8AAwMCAO+aE1sAAAAASUVORK5CYII=';
        $component->call('attachProblemPhoto', $problemId, ['name' => 'uji.png', 'src' => $image]);
        $photos = $component->get('problems')[0]['photos'];
        $this->assertCount(1, $photos);

        $this->assertSame($image, $draft['problems'][0]['photos'][0]['path']);
    }

FILE: .\tests\Feature\UiRecheckRegressionTest.php

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Livewire\Prototype\ProgressForm;
use App\Prototype\FakeDraftStore;
use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\PrototypeTestCase as TestCase;

class UiRecheckRegressionTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        FakeStore::reset();
        foreach (FakeDraftStore::all() as $draft) {
            FakeDraftStore::delete($draft['uuid']);
        }
    }

    public function test_leaving_empty_editor_does_not_create_draft(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->call('cancel')
            ->assertRedirect(route('prototype.index', ['tab' => 'dashboard']));

        $this->assertCount(0, FakeDraftStore::all());
    }

    public function test_leaving_unchanged_saved_progress_does_not_create_draft(): void
    {
        $before = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');

        Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class, ['progressId' => 'prog-001'])
            ->call('cancel')
            ->assertRedirect(route('prototype.index', ['tab' => 'dashboard']));

        $this->assertCount(0, FakeDraftStore::all());
        $this->assertSame($before, FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001'));
    }

    public function test_actual_change_survives_failed_autosave_and_retry(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)
            ->set('simulateSaveError', true)
            ->set('notes', 'Catatan yang belum berhasil disimpan')
            ->assertSet('autosaveStatus', 'error');

        $this->assertCount(0, FakeDraftStore::all());

        $component->set('simulateSaveError', false)
            ->call('saveDraft')
            ->assertSet('autosaveStatus', 'saved');

        $draft = FakeDraftStore::find($component->get('draftUuid'));
        $this->assertSame('Catatan yang belum berhasil disimpan', $draft['notes']);
        $this->assertCount(1, FakeDraftStore::all());
    }

    public function test_project_dates_can_be_explicitly_cleared_including_aliases(): void
    {
        $keys = [
            'date_receive', 't0_target', 't0_actual',
            'plan_start', 'plan_finish', 'actual_start', 'actual_finish',
            'event_1', 'event_2', 'event_3',
        ];
        $project = FakeStore::findProject('proj-001');
        $dated = FakeStore::saveProject(array_replace(
            $project, array_fill_keys($keys, '2026-10-15')
        ));
        $cleared = FakeStore::saveProject(array_replace(
            $dated, array_fill_keys($keys, null)
        ));

        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            $this->assertNull($cleared[$key], $key);
        }
        foreach (['t0_target_date', 't0_actual_date', 'event_1_date', 'event_2_date', 'event_3_date'] as $key) {
            $this->assertNull($cleared[$key], $key);
        }
    }
}
