<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Auth;

use App\Livewire\Prototype\ProgressForm;
use App\Models\Attachment;
use App\Models\CorrectiveAction;
use App\Models\Problem;
use App\Models\Progress;
use App\Models\ProgressDraft;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\AuthenticationException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Hash;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Storage;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\View\ViewException;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\TestCase;

class AdminAccessTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
    }

    public function test_anonymous_cannot_access_data_file_or_direct_livewire_action(): void
    {
        foreach (['/app', '/prototype', '/attachments/'.Str::uuid().'/download'] as $url) {
            $this->get($url)->assertRedirect(route('login'));
        }
        try {
            Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class);
            $this->fail('Anonymous Livewire access accepted');
        } catch (ViewException $e) {
            $cause = $e;
            while ($cause->getPrevious()) {
                $cause = $cause->getPrevious();
            }
            $this->assertInstanceOf(AuthenticationException::class, $cause);
        }
        $this->post('/register', [])->assertNotFound();
        $this->get('/register')->assertNotFound();
    }

    public function test_login_failure_success_logout_and_no_fixture_in_operational_route(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create(['email' => 'admin@example.test', 'password' => 'test-password-private']);
        $this->post('/login', ['email' => $admin->email, 'password' => 'wrong'])->assertSessionHasErrors('email');
        $this->assertGuest();
        $this->post('/login', ['email' => $admin->email, 'password' => 'test-password-private'])->assertRedirect(route('app'));
        $this->assertAuthenticatedAs($admin);
        $this->get('/app')->assertOk()->assertDontSee('Ahmad Fauzi');
        $this->post('/logout')->assertRedirect(route('login'));
        $this->assertGuest();
        $this->get('/prototype')->assertRedirect(route('login'));
    }

    public function test_login_is_rate_limited(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create(['email' => 'limited@example.test']);
        for ($i = 0; $i < 5; $i++) {
            $this->post('/login', ['email' => $admin->email, 'password' => 'wrong']);
        }
        $this->post('/login', ['email' => $admin->email, 'password' => 'password'])->assertSessionHasErrors('email');
        $this->assertGuest();
    }

    public function test_command_creates_one_hashed_admin_and_refuses_second(): void
    {
        $this->artisan('admin:create', ['email' => 'local@example.test', '--name' => 'Admin Fiktif'])
            ->expectsQuestion('Password admin (minimal 12 karakter)', 'test-secret-1234')
            ->expectsQuestion('Ulangi password', 'test-secret-1234')->assertSuccessful();
        $admin = User::sole();
        $this->assertTrue(Hash::check('test-secret-1234', $admin->password));
        $this->artisan('admin:create', ['email' => 'second@example.test'])->assertFailed();
        $this->assertSame(1, User::count());
    }

    public function test_draft_and_file_policy_and_closed_update_guard(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create();
        $p = Progress::factory()->create(['status' => 'Closed']);
        $draft = ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id]);
        $otherIdentity = new User;
        $otherIdentity->id = $admin->id + 1;
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($otherIdentity)->allows('view', $draft));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('update', $p));
        $problem = Problem::factory()->create(['progress_id' => $p->id]);
        $action = CorrectiveAction::factory()->create(['problem_id' => $problem->id]);
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('update', $problem));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('update', $action));
        Storage::fake('private');
        $key = 'attachments/'.Str::uuid();
        Storage::disk('private')->put($key, 'private');
        $a = Attachment::create(['uploaded_by' => $admin->id, 'progress_id' => $p->id, 'owner_kind' => 'progress', 'state' => 'attached', 'kind' => 'document', 'storage_key' => $key, 'original_name' => 'private.txt', 'mime_type' => 'text/plain', 'size_bytes' => 7, 'checksum' => hash('sha256', 'private')]);
        $this->actingAs($admin)->get(route('attachments.download', $a))->assertDownload('private.txt');
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($admin)->allows('update', $a));
        $this->assertFalse(Gate::forUser($otherIdentity)->allows('download', $a));
        $a->update(['progress_id' => null, 'draft_id' => $draft->id, 'state' => 'staging']);
        $this->get(route('attachments.download', $a))->assertForbidden();
        config(['prototype.enabled' => false]);
        Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class)->assertNotFound();
    }

    public function test_mutating_login_request_requires_csrf_token(): void
    {
        // Enable the real CSRF check, normally bypassed by the testing environment.
        $this->app['env'] = 'local';
        $this->post('/login', ['email' => 'csrf@example.test', 'password' => 'invalid'])->assertStatus(419);
        $this->assertGuest();
    }

    public function test_livewire_rechecks_session_before_a_later_action(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create();
        $this->actingAs($admin);
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressForm::class);
        auth()->logout();
        try {
            $component->call('addProblem')->assertUnauthorized();
        } catch (AuthenticationException $e) {
            $this->assertSame('Unauthenticated.', $e->getMessage());
        } catch (ViewException $e) {
            $cause = $e;
            while ($cause->getPrevious()) {
                $cause = $cause->getPrevious();
            }
            $this->assertInstanceOf(AuthenticationException::class, $cause);
        }
    }
}

FILE: .\tests\Feature\Foundation\PayloadTest.php

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Foundation;

use App\Data\ProgressPayload;
use App\Data\ProjectPayload;
use App\Models\Attachment;
use App\Models\ProgressDraft;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Tests\Fixtures\FoundationGraph;
use Tests\TestCase;

class PayloadTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function row(array $data = []): array
    {
        return ['client_id' => (string) Str::uuid(), ...$data];
    }

    private function invalid(callable $fn, string $field): void
    {
        try {
            $fn();
            $this->fail('Invalid payload accepted');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey($field, $e->errors());
        }
    }

    private function base(): array
    {
        return ['project_id' => Project::factory()->create()->id, 'activity_date' => '2026-10-15', 'activity' => 'Trial'];
    }

    public function test_partial_draft_and_only_three_final_required_fields(): void
    {
        $this->assertSame(['schema_version' => 1], ProgressPayload::fromArray([])->data);
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray([], true), 'project_id');
        $dto = ProgressPayload::fromArray($this->base(), true);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('problems', $dto->data);
        $this->assertArrayNotHasKey('part_no', $dto->data);
    }

    public function test_nested_payload_preserves_raw_text_pic_only_rows_and_null_dates(): void
    {
        $input = [...$this->base(), 'die_high_raw' => '1,5', 'qty_material_raw' => '1.5',
            'problems' => [$this->row(['corrective_actions' => [$this->row(['pic' => 'PIC bebas', 'actual_date' => ''])]])],
            'next_actions' => [$this->row(['pic' => 'Nama bebas', 'actual_date' => null])],
            'feedbacks' => [$this->row(['content' => 'Satu', 'feedback_date' => '']), $this->row(['content' => 'Dua'])]];
        $data = ProgressPayload::fromArray($input, true)->data;
        $this->assertSame('1,5', $data['die_high_raw']);
        $this->assertSame('1.5', $data['qty_material_raw']);
        $this->assertNull($data['problems'][0]['corrective_actions'][0]['actual_date']);
        $this->assertSame('PIC bebas', $data['problems'][0]['corrective_actions'][0]['pic']);
        $this->assertCount(2, $data['feedbacks']);
    }

    public function test_invalid_activity_unknown_fields_and_invalid_date_are_rejected(): void
    {
        $base = $this->base();
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray([...$base, 'activity' => 'Other'], true), 'activity');
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray([...$base, 'activity_date' => '2026-02-30'], true), 'activity_date');
        foreach (['part_no', 'pic_progress', 'status', 'project_user'] as $field) {
            $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray([...$base, $field => 'injected']), 'payload');
        }
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray(['schema_version' => 2]), 'schema_version');
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray(['next_actions' => [$this->row(['target_date' => '2026-10-15'])]]), 'next_actions.0');
    }

    public function test_cross_parent_ids_changed_client_ids_and_duplicates_are_rejected(): void
    {
        $p = FoundationGraph::create();
        $other = FoundationGraph::create();
        $first = $p->problems[0];
        $second = $p->problems[1];
        $row = ['id' => $first->id, 'client_id' => $first->client_id];
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray(['problems' => [['id' => $other->problems[0]->id, 'client_id' => $other->problems[0]->client_id]]], false, $p), 'problems.0.id');
        $foreignAction = $second->correctiveActions[0];
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray(['problems' => [[...$row, 'corrective_actions' => [['id' => $foreignAction->id, 'client_id' => $foreignAction->client_id]]]]], false, $p), 'problems.0.corrective_actions.0.id');
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray(['problems' => [[...$row, 'client_id' => (string) Str::uuid()]]], false, $p), 'problems.0.id');
        $duplicate = $this->row();
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray(['next_actions' => [$duplicate, $duplicate]]), 'next_actions.1.client_id');
        $this->assertCount(2, $p->fresh()->problems);
    }

    public function test_attachment_references_cannot_cross_drafts_or_owners(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create();
        $draft = ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id]);
        $other = ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id]);
        $client = (string) Str::uuid();
        $attachment = Attachment::create(['uploaded_by' => $admin->id, 'draft_id' => $draft->id, 'owner_kind' => 'problem', 'owner_client_id' => $client, 'state' => 'staging', 'kind' => 'photo', 'storage_key' => 'attachments/'.Str::uuid(), 'original_name' => 'a.png', 'mime_type' => 'image/png', 'size_bytes' => 10, 'checksum' => str_repeat('b', 64)]);
        $input = ['problems' => [['client_id' => $client, 'photo_refs' => [$attachment->id]]]];
        $this->assertSame($attachment->id, ProgressPayload::fromArray($input, false, null, $draft, $admin)->data['problems'][0]['photo_refs'][0]);
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray($input, false, null, $other, $admin), 'problems.0.photo_refs.0');
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProgressPayload::fromArray(['attachment_refs' => [$attachment->id]], false, null, $draft, $admin), 'attachment_refs.0');
    }

    public function test_project_required_identity_trim_and_clear_dates_without_normalizing_raw(): void
    {
        $p = Project::factory()->create(['t0_target' => '2026-10-15']);
        $data = ProjectPayload::fromArray(['jo_no' => ' 0007 ', 'part_no' => '0008', 'part_name' => 'Part fiktif', 't0_target' => '', 'material_thickness_raw' => '1,5'], $p)->data;
        $this->assertSame('0007', $data['jo_no']);
        $this->assertSame('1,5', $data['material_thickness_raw']);
        $this->assertNull($data['t0_target']);
        $p->update($data);
        $this->assertNull($p->fresh()->t0_target);
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProjectPayload::fromArray(['jo_no' => '0007', 'part_no' => 'unique', 'part_name' => 'Part']), 'jo_no');
        $this->invalid(fn () => ProjectPayload::fromArray([]), 'part_name');
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Foundation;

use App\Models\Attachment;
use App\Models\LegacyDocumentMetadata;
use App\Models\Problem;
use App\Models\Progress;
use App\Models\ProgressDraft;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Database\Seeders\DevelopmentSeeder;
use Illuminate\Database\QueryException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Schema;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Tests\Fixtures\FoundationGraph;
use Tests\TestCase;

class SchemaTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private function rejected(callable $write, string $state): void
    {
        try {
            DB::transaction($write);
            $this->fail('Database accepted invalid record');
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            $this->assertSame($state, $e->getCode());
        }
    }

    public function test_unique_identity_raw_text_dates_and_removed_fields(): void
    {
        $p = Project::factory()->create(['jo_no' => '0007', 'part_no' => '0009', 'no_doc' => '00001']);
        $this->rejected(fn () => Project::factory()->create(['jo_no' => '0007']), '23505');
        $this->rejected(fn () => Project::factory()->create(['part_no' => '0009']), '23505');
        $this->rejected(fn () => Project::factory()->create(['jo_no' => ' 0007 ']), '23514');
        $this->assertSame('0007', $p->fresh()->jo_no);
        $this->assertSame('1,5', $p->fresh()->material_thickness_raw);
        $this->assertSame('1.5', $p->fresh()->material_width_raw);
        $this->assertNull($p->date_receive);
        foreach (['project_user', 'status_project'] as $field) {
            $this->assertFalse(Schema::hasColumn('projects', $field));
        }
        $this->assertFalse(Schema::hasColumn('progresses', 'pic_progress'));
        foreach (['corrective_actions', 'next_actions'] as $table) {
            $this->assertFalse(Schema::hasColumn($table, 'target_date'));
        }
    }

    public function test_graph_relations_master_identity_and_foreign_key_integrity(): void
    {
        $p = FoundationGraph::create();
        $this->assertCount(2, $p->problems);
        $this->assertCount(3, $p->nextActions);
        $this->assertCount(2, $p->feedbacks);
        foreach ($p->problems as $i => $problem) {
            $this->assertCount(2, $problem->correctiveActions);
            foreach ($problem->correctiveActions as $j => $a) {
                $this->assertSame("PIC $i-$j Fiktif", $a->pic);
                $this->assertSame($problem->id, $a->problem->id);
            }
        }
        $p->project->update(['model' => 'RS8', 'part_name' => 'Master terkini']);
        $this->assertSame('RS8', $p->fresh()->project->model);
        $this->rejected(fn () => Problem::factory()->create(['progress_id' => 999999]), '23503');
        $this->rejected(fn () => $p->project->delete(), '23001');
    }

    public function test_legacy_nulls_and_database_activity_status_checks(): void
    {
        $p = Progress::factory()->create(['legacy_incomplete' => true, 'activity_date' => null, 'activity' => null]);
        $this->assertNull($p->fresh()->activity_date);
        $this->rejected(fn () => Progress::factory()->create(['activity_date' => null]), '23514');
        $this->rejected(fn () => Progress::factory()->create(['activity' => 'Other']), '23514');
        $this->rejected(fn () => Progress::factory()->create(['status' => 'Done']), '23514');
        $this->rejected(fn () => Progress::factory()->create(['revision' => 0]), '23514');
    }

    public function test_single_admin_and_one_active_edit_draft_constraint(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create();
        $progress = Progress::factory()->create();
        ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id, 'progress_id' => $progress->id, 'base_revision' => 1]);
        $this->rejected(fn () => User::factory()->create(), '23505');
        $this->rejected(fn () => ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id, 'progress_id' => $progress->id, 'base_revision' => 1]), '23505');
        ProgressDraft::factory()->count(2)->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id]);
        $this->assertSame(3, ProgressDraft::count());
        $this->rejected(fn () => ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id, 'state' => 'applied']), '23514');
    }

    public function test_attachment_has_one_owner_and_legacy_metadata_has_no_download_key(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create();
        $progress = Progress::factory()->create();
        $draft = ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id]);
        $attrs = ['uploaded_by' => $admin->id, 'draft_id' => $draft->id, 'owner_kind' => 'progress', 'state' => 'staging', 'kind' => 'document', 'storage_key' => 'attachments/'.Str::uuid(), 'original_name' => 'test.pdf', 'mime_type' => 'application/pdf', 'size_bytes' => 4, 'checksum' => str_repeat('a', 64)];
        Attachment::create($attrs);
        $this->rejected(fn () => Attachment::create([...$attrs, 'storage_key' => 'attachments/'.Str::uuid(), 'progress_id' => $progress->id]), '23514');
        $meta = $progress->legacyDocuments()->create(['source_field' => 'Doc1', 'name' => null, 'description' => 'Keterangan saja']);
        $this->assertNull($meta->name);
        $this->assertFalse(Schema::hasColumn('legacy_document_metadata', 'storage_key'));
        $this->rejected(fn () => LegacyDocumentMetadata::create(['source_field' => 'Doc2']), '23514');
    }

    public function test_nested_database_failure_rolls_back_graph_and_preserves_draft(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create();
        $draft = ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id]);
        $count = Progress::count();
        $this->rejected(function () {
            $p = Progress::factory()->create();
            Problem::factory()->create(['progress_id' => $p->id]);
            Problem::factory()->create(['progress_id' => 999999]);
        }, '23503');
        $this->assertSame($count, Progress::count());
        $this->assertSame(0, Problem::count());
        $this->assertSame('active', $draft->fresh()->state);
    }

    public function test_development_seeder_is_fictitious_and_refuses_overwrite(): void
    {
        $this->seed(DevelopmentSeeder::class);
        $this->assertSame(9, Progress::count());
        $this->assertSame(3, Project::count());
        $this->assertSame(0, User::count());
        $this->expectException(\RuntimeException::class);
        $this->seed(DevelopmentSeeder::class);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Foundation;

use App\Actions\CloseProgress;

use App\Exceptions\FeatureNotReady;

class ServiceContractTest extends TestCase

        $p = FoundationGraph::create();
        $before = $p->problems->toArray();
        $draft = ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id, 'progress_id' => $p->id, 'base_revision' => 1]);
        $other = Progress::factory()->create();
        $closed = app(CloseProgress::class)->handle($admin, $p->id, 1)->progress;
        $this->assertSame('Closed', $closed->status);
        $this->assertSame(2, $closed->revision);
        $this->assertSame('Open', $other->fresh()->status);
        $this->assertSame('active', $draft->fresh()->state);
        try {
            app(ReopenProgress::class)->handle($admin, $p->id, 1);
            $this->fail('stale revision accepted');
        } catch (VersionConflict $e) {
            $this->assertSame(409, $e->getStatusCode());
        }
        $opened = app(ReopenProgress::class)->handle($admin, $p->id, 2)->progress;
        $this->assertSame('Open', $opened->status);
        $this->assertSame(3, $opened->revision);
        $this->assertSame($before, $opened->problems()->with('correctiveActions')->get()->toArray());
    }

    public function test_save_skeleton_fails_explicitly_and_keeps_draft_and_database_unchanged(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create();
        $p = Progress::factory()->create();
        $draft = ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id, 'payload' => ['project_id' => $p->project_id, 'activity' => 'Trial', 'activity_date' => '2026-10-15']]);
        try {
            app(SaveProgress::class)->handle($admin, $draft->id, 1);
            $this->fail('false success');
        } catch (FeatureNotReady $e) {
            $this->assertSame(501, $e->getStatusCode());
        }
        $this->assertSame(1, Progress::count());
        $this->assertSame('active', $draft->fresh()->state);
        $this->assertNull($draft->fresh()->applied_progress_id);
    }

    public function test_applied_draft_retries_return_same_record_and_never_duplicate(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create();
        $p = Progress::factory()->create();
        $draft = ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id, 'state' => 'applied', 'applied_progress_id' => $p->id]);
        foreach ([1, 2] as $_) {
            $result = app(SaveProgress::class)->handle($admin, $draft->id, 1);
            $this->assertSame($p->id, $result->progress->id);
            $this->assertSame('already_applied', $result->outcome);
        }
        $this->assertSame(1, Progress::count());
    }

    public function test_stale_edit_base_conflicts_without_discarding_draft(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create();
        $p = Progress::factory()->create();
        $draft = ProgressDraft::factory()->create(['admin_id' => $admin->id, 'progress_id' => $p->id, 'base_revision' => 1]);
        app(CloseProgress::class)->handle($admin, $p->id, 1);
        $this->expectException(VersionConflict::class);
        app(SaveProgress::class)->handle($admin, $draft->id, 1);
    }

    public function test_draft_skeleton_never_claims_autosave_success(): void
    {
        $admin = User::factory()->create();
        try {
            app(ProgressDraftService::class)->save($admin, (string) Str::uuid(), [], 0, 1);
            $this->fail('false success');
        } catch (FeatureNotReady $e) {
            $this->assertSame(501, $e->getStatusCode());
        }
        $this->assertSame(0, ProgressDraft::count());
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Progress;

use App\Actions\SaveProgress;
use App\Models\Progress;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Tests\TestCase;

class SaveBasicProgressTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private User $admin;

    private Project $project;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        $this->admin = User::factory()->create();
        $this->project = Project::factory()->create([
            'jo_no' => '0020/NM/2026',
            'part_no' => '0020-PART-01',
            'part_name' => 'Bracket Arm',
        ]);
        $this->actingAs($this->admin);
    }

    public function test_create_basic_progress_sets_open_status_and_revision_1(): void
    {
        $action = new SaveProgress;
        $progress = $action->saveBasic($this->admin, [
            'project_id' => $this->project->id,
            'activity_date' => '2026-10-19',
            'activity' => 'Trial',
            'description' => 'First trial activity',
            'pic_customer' => 'Mr. Tanaka',
            'machine' => 'Press 300T',
            'die_high_raw' => '1,5',
            'qty_material_raw' => '100.5',
        ]);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Progress::class, $progress);
        $this->assertSame('Open', $progress->status);
        $this->assertSame(1, $progress->revision);
        $this->assertSame('First trial activity', $progress->description);
        $this->assertSame('1,5', $progress->die_high_raw);
        $this->assertSame('100.5', $progress->qty_material_raw);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('progresses', [
            'id' => $progress->id,
            'project_id' => $this->project->id,
            'activity' => 'Trial',
            'status' => 'Open',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_final_validation_requires_three_mandatory_fields(): void
    {
        $action = new SaveProgress;

        // Missing project_id
        try {
            $action->saveBasic($this->admin, [
                'activity_date' => '2026-10-19',
                'activity' => 'Trial',
            ]);
            $this->fail('Missing project_id should fail');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey('project_id', $e->errors());
        }

        // Missing activity_date
        try {
            $action->saveBasic($this->admin, [
                'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                'activity' => 'Trial',
            ]);
            $this->fail('Missing activity_date should fail');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey('activity_date', $e->errors());
        }

        // Missing activity
        try {
            $action->saveBasic($this->admin, [
                'project_id' => $this->project->id,
                'activity_date' => '2026-10-19',
            ]);
            $this->fail('Missing activity should fail');
        } catch (ValidationException $e) {
            $this->assertArrayHasKey('activity', $e->errors());
        }
    }

    public function test_invalid_activity_rejected(): void
    {
        $action = new SaveProgress;

        $this->expectException(ValidationException::class);
        $action->saveBasic($this->admin, [
            'project_id' => $this->project->id,
            'activity_date' => '2026-10-19',
            'activity' => 'Invalid Activity Type',
        ]);
    }

    public function test_edit_open_progress_updates_scalar_fields(): void
    {
        $action = new SaveProgress;
        $progress = Progress::factory()->create([
            'project_id' => $this->project->id,
            'activity_date' => '2026-10-15',
            'activity' => 'Trial',
            'status' => 'Open',
            'description' => 'Original description',
        ]);

        $updated = $action->saveBasic($this->admin, [
            'project_id' => $this->project->id,
            'activity_date' => '2026-10-16',
            'activity' => 'Sent Sample',
            'description' => 'Updated description',
        ], $progress);

        $this->assertSame('Open', $updated->status);
        $this->assertSame('Sent Sample', $updated->activity);
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-16', $updated->activity_date->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertSame('Updated description', $updated->description);
    }

    public function test_edit_closed_progress_is_rejected(): void
    {
        $action = new SaveProgress;
        $progress = Progress::factory()->create([
            'project_id' => $this->project->id,
            'status' => 'Closed',
        ]);

        $this->expectException(AuthorizationException::class);
        $action->saveBasic($this->admin, [
            'project_id' => $this->project->id,
            'activity_date' => '2026-10-19',
            'activity' => 'Trial',
            'description' => 'Trying to edit closed',
        ], $progress);

        $this->assertSame('Closed', $progress->fresh()->status);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Progress;

use App\Livewire\Progresses\ProgressEditor;
use App\Models\Progress;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ValidationTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private User $admin;

    private Project $project;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        $this->admin = User::factory()->create();
        $this->project = Project::factory()->create([
            'jo_no' => '0088/NM/2026',
            'part_no' => 'PN-0088',
            'part_name' => 'Reinforce Bracket',
        ]);
        $this->actingAs($this->admin);
    }

    public function test_minimal_valid_progress_saves_successfully(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(ProgressEditor::class)
            ->set('projectId', $this->project->id)
            ->set('activityDate', '2026-10-19')
            ->set('activity', 'Trial')
            // All other fields remain null/empty
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasNoErrors();

        $saved = Progress::where('project_id', $this->project->id)->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-19', $saved->activity_date->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertSame('Trial', $saved->activity);
        $this->assertSame('Open', $saved->status);
        $this->assertFalse($saved->legacy_incomplete);
    }

    public function test_validation_errors_displayed_and_user_inputs_preserved(): void
    {
        $component = Livewire::test(ProgressEditor::class)
            // Leave projectId and activityDate null/empty
            ->set('description', 'User typed important note')
            ->set('picCustomer', 'Budi Free Text')
            ->set('dieHighRaw', '325,5')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasErrors(['projectId', 'activityDate'])
            ->assertSeeHtml('id="error-summary"')
            ->assertSee('Pilih JO No.')
            ->assertSee('Isi tanggal aktivitas.')
            // Confirm user inputs are preserved after validation failure
            ->assertSet('description', 'User typed important note')
            ->assertSet('picCustomer', 'Budi Free Text')
            ->assertSet('dieHighRaw', '325,5');
    }

    public function test_legacy_incomplete_record_displays_notice_and_does_not_auto_fill_date(): void
    {
        // Insert legacy incomplete progress directly with null activity_date
        $legacy = Progress::forceCreate([
            'project_id' => $this->project->id,
            'activity_date' => null,
            'activity' => 'Trial',
            'description' => 'Migrated Access note',
            'legacy_incomplete' => true,
            'status' => 'Open',
            'revision' => 1,
        ]);

        Livewire::test(ProgressEditor::class, ['progressId' => $legacy->id])
            ->assertSet('activityDate', null)
            ->assertSee('Data Legacy Incomplete')
            // User tries to save without filling activityDate
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasErrors(['activityDate'])
            ->assertSee('Isi tanggal aktivitas.');
    }

    public function test_saving_legacy_incomplete_with_minimum_fields_clears_incomplete_flag(): void
    {
        $legacy = Progress::forceCreate([
            'project_id' => $this->project->id,
            'activity_date' => null,
            'activity' => 'Trial',
            'description' => 'Migrated record to be completed',
            'legacy_incomplete' => true,
            'status' => 'Open',
            'revision' => 1,
        ]);

        $this->assertTrue($legacy->legacy_incomplete);

        Livewire::test(ProgressEditor::class, ['progressId' => $legacy->id])
            ->set('activityDate', '2026-10-19')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasNoErrors();

        $fresh = $legacy->fresh();
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-19', $fresh->activity_date->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertFalse($fresh->legacy_incomplete);
    }

    public function test_optional_fields_have_no_hidden_required_rules(): void
    {
        // Verify that description, PIC, event note, remark, and trial details are strictly optional
        Livewire::test(ProgressEditor::class)
            ->set('projectId', $this->project->id)
            ->set('activityDate', '2026-10-19')
            ->set('activity', 'Sent Sample')
            ->set('description', '')
            ->set('picCustomer', '')
            ->set('processTrial', '')
            ->set('machine', '')
            ->set('dieHighRaw', '')
            ->set('materialActualTrial', '')
            ->set('qtyMaterialRaw', '')
            ->set('qtyProcessRaw', '')
            ->set('qtySampleRaw', '')
            ->set('eventNote', '')
            ->set('remark', '')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertDatabaseHas('progresses', [
            'project_id' => $this->project->id,
            'activity' => 'Sent Sample',
            'status' => 'Open',
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Project;

use App\Actions\SaveProject;
use App\Livewire\Projects\ProjectForm;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ProjectFormTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private User $admin;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        $this->admin = User::factory()->create();
        $this->actingAs($this->admin);
    }

    /**
     * AT01: JO yang sudah ada ditolak pada project baru; tidak muncul project kedua.
     */
    public function test_at01_duplicate_jo_no_is_rejected_on_create(): void
    {
        Project::factory()->create([
            'jo_no' => '0012/NM/2026',
            'part_no' => 'PART-ORIG-01',
            'part_name' => 'Original Part',
        ]);

        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class)
            ->set('jo_no', '0012/NM/2026')
            ->set('part_no', 'PART-NEW-02')
            ->set('part_name', 'New Part Name')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasErrors(['jo_no']);

        $this->assertSame(1, Project::count());
    }

    /**
     * AT02: Part No yang sudah dipakai JO lain ditolak; nol di depan tetap utuh.
     */
    public function test_at02_duplicate_part_no_is_rejected_and_leading_zeros_preserved(): void
    {
        Project::factory()->create([
            'jo_no' => 'JO-ORIG-01',
            'part_no' => '0091-XYZ-01',
            'part_name' => 'Original Part',
        ]);

        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class)
            ->set('jo_no', 'JO-NEW-02')
            ->set('part_no', '0091-XYZ-01')
            ->set('part_name', 'New Part')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasErrors(['part_no']);

        $this->assertSame(1, Project::count());

        // Test creating a new valid project with leading zeros
        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class)
            ->set('jo_no', '0007/NM/2026')
            ->set('part_no', '0042-ABC-99')
            ->set('part_name', 'Part with Leading Zero')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertSame(2, Project::count());
        $created = Project::where('jo_no', '0007/NM/2026')->first();
        $this->assertNotNull($created);
        $this->assertSame('0007/NM/2026', $created->jo_no);
        $this->assertSame('0042-ABC-99', $created->part_no);
    }

    /**
     * AT04: T0 Target/Actual, jadwal, dan Event 1 sampai 3 tersimpan manual.
     */
    public function test_at04_manual_dates_and_events_saved(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class)
            ->set('jo_no', 'JO-DATES-01')
            ->set('part_no', 'PART-DATES-01')
            ->set('part_name', 'Part with Dates')
            ->set('date_receive', '2026-10-01')
            ->set('t0_target', '2026-10-10')
            ->set('t0_actual', '2026-10-12')
            ->set('plan_start', '2026-10-02')
            ->set('plan_finish', '2026-10-20')
            ->set('actual_start', '2026-10-03')
            ->set('actual_finish', '2026-10-21')
            ->set('event_1', '2026-11-01')
            ->set('event_2', '2026-11-15')
            ->set('event_3', '2026-12-01')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasNoErrors();

        $project = Project::where('jo_no', 'JO-DATES-01')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-01', $project->date_receive->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-10', $project->t0_target->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-12', $project->t0_actual->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-02', $project->plan_start->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-20', $project->plan_finish->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-03', $project->actual_start->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertSame('2026-10-21', $project->actual_finish->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertSame('2026-11-01', $project->event_1->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertSame('2026-11-15', $project->event_2->format('Y-m-d'));
        $this->assertSame('2026-12-01', $project->event_3->format('Y-m-d'));
    }

    /**
     * AT06: Raw numeric text values preserved as text (1,5 and 1.5).
     */
    public function test_at06_raw_numeric_values_preserved_as_text(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class)
            ->set('jo_no', 'JO-RAW-01')
            ->set('part_no', 'PART-RAW-01')
            ->set('part_name', 'Part with Raw Text')
            ->set('material_thickness_raw', '1,5')
            ->set('material_width_raw', '12.5')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasNoErrors();

        $project = Project::where('jo_no', 'JO-RAW-01')->firstOrFail();
        $this->assertSame('1,5', $project->material_thickness_raw);
        $this->assertSame('12.5', $project->material_width_raw);
    }

    /**
     * Edit project: mengedit project yang sudah ada mempertahankan JO dan Part No sendiri tanpa error.
     */
    public function test_edit_project_allows_same_jo_and_part_no(): void
    {
        $project = Project::factory()->create([
            'jo_no' => 'JO-EDIT-01',
            'part_no' => 'PART-EDIT-01',
            'part_name' => 'Original Part Name',
        ]);

        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class, ['projectId' => $project->id])
            ->assertSet('jo_no', 'JO-EDIT-01')
            ->assertSet('part_no', 'PART-EDIT-01')
            ->set('part_name', 'Updated Part Name')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasNoErrors();

        $this->assertSame('Updated Part Name', $project->fresh()->part_name);
        $this->assertSame('JO-EDIT-01', $project->fresh()->jo_no);
        $this->assertSame('PART-EDIT-01', $project->fresh()->part_no);
    }

    /**
     * Required field validation.
     */
    public function test_required_fields_validation(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(ProjectForm::class)
            ->set('jo_no', '')
            ->set('part_no', '')
            ->set('part_name', '')
            ->call('save')
            ->assertHasErrors(['jo_no', 'part_no', 'part_name']);
    }

    /**
     * Action SaveProject: directly test Action and race condition handling.
     */
    public function test_save_project_action_handles_uniqueness(): void
    {
        $action = new SaveProject;
        $p1 = $action->handle([
            'jo_no' => 'JO-ACTION-01',
            'part_no' => 'PART-ACTION-01',
            'part_name' => 'Action Part 1',
        ]);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Project::class, $p1);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('projects', ['jo_no' => 'JO-ACTION-01']);

        // Duplicate JO
        $this->expectException(ValidationException::class);
        $action->handle([
            'jo_no' => 'JO-ACTION-01',
            'part_no' => 'PART-ACTION-02',
            'part_name' => 'Action Part 2',
        ]);
    }

<?php

namespace Tests\Feature\Project;

use App\Livewire\Components\ProjectPicker;
use App\Models\Project;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Queries\ProjectLookup;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Livewire\Livewire;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ProjectPickerTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private User $admin;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->withoutVite();
        $this->admin = User::factory()->create();
        $this->actingAs($this->admin);
    }

    public function test_project_lookup_search_and_find(): void
    {
        $p1 = Project::factory()->create([
            'jo_no' => '0012/NM/2026',
            'part_no' => '0091-XYZ-01',
            'part_name' => 'Cover Handle Front',
            'customer' => 'Customer A',
        ]);

        $p2 = Project::factory()->create([
            'jo_no' => '0013/NM/2026',
            'part_no' => '0092-XYZ-02',
            'part_name' => 'Bracket Base',
            'customer' => 'Customer B',
        ]);

        $lookup = new ProjectLookup;

        // Search by JO
        $results = $lookup->search('0012');
        $this->assertCount(1, $results);
        $this->assertSame($p1->id, $results->first()->id);

        // Search by Part No
        $results = $lookup->search('0092');
        $this->assertCount(1, $results);
        $this->assertSame($p2->id, $results->first()->id);

        // Search by Part Name
        $results = $lookup->search('bracket');
        $this->assertCount(1, $results);
        $this->assertSame($p2->id, $results->first()->id);

        // Find by ID
        $found = $lookup->find($p1->id);
        $this->assertNotNull($found);
        $this->assertSame('Cover Handle Front', $found->part_name);
    }

    public function test_project_picker_displays_selected_project_identity(): void
    {
        $project = Project::factory()->create([
            'jo_no' => '0014/NM/2026',
            'part_no' => '0094-ABC-01',
            'part_name' => 'Door Panel Assembly',
            'customer' => 'Customer C',
            'model' => 'K2SJ',
            'no_doc' => 'DOC-2026-99',
        ]);

        Livewire::test(ProjectPicker::class, ['selectedId' => $project->id])
            ->assertSee('0014/NM/2026')
            ->assertSee('Door Panel Assembly')
            ->assertSee('0094-ABC-01')
            ->assertSee('Customer C')
            ->assertSee('K2SJ')
            ->assertSee('DOC-2026-99');
    }

    /**
     * AT03: Koreksi Part Name/Customer/Model/No Doc master terlihat pada progress lama dan draft yang dibuka.
     */
    public function test_at03_master_update_reflected_immediately(): void
    {
        $project = Project::factory()->create([
            'jo_no' => '0015/NM/2026',
            'part_no' => '0095-ABC-02',
            'part_name' => 'Initial Part Name',
            'customer' => 'Initial Customer',
            'model' => 'Model V1',
            'no_doc' => 'DOC-V1',
        ]);

        $component = Livewire::test(ProjectPicker::class, ['selectedId' => $project->id]);
        $component->assertSee('Initial Part Name');
        $component->assertSee('Initial Customer');

        // Update Project master in DB
        $project->update([
            'part_name' => 'Updated Part Name Realtime',
            'customer' => 'Updated Customer Corp',
            'model' => 'Model V2',
            'no_doc' => 'DOC-V2',
        ]);

        // When picker re-renders or calls loadSelectedProject, it reflects updated master without snapshot
        $component->call('loadSelectedProject')
            ->assertSee('Updated Part Name Realtime')
            ->assertSee('Updated Customer Corp')
            ->assertSee('Model V2')
            ->assertSee('DOC-V2')
            ->assertDontSee('Initial Part Name');
    }

    public function test_project_picker_handles_missing_or_null_project(): void
    {
        Livewire::test(ProjectPicker::class, ['selectedId' => null])
            ->assertSee('Pilih JO No')
            ->assertSee('â€”');

        Livewire::test(ProjectPicker::class, ['selectedId' => 999999])
            ->assertSee('â€”');
    }
}

    public static function create(): Progress
    {
        $progress = Progress::factory()->create();
        foreach ([0, 1] as $i) {
            $problem = Problem::factory()->create(['progress_id' => $progress->id, 'position' => $i]);
            foreach ([0, 1] as $j) {
                CorrectiveAction::factory()->create(['problem_id' => $problem->id, 'position' => $j, 'pic' => "PIC $i-$j Fiktif", 'actual_date' => $j === 0 ? null : '2026-10-15']);
            }
        }
        NextAction::factory()->count(3)->create(['progress_id' => $progress->id]);
        Feedback::factory()->count(2)->create(['progress_id' => $progress->id]);

        return $progress->fresh(['project', 'problems.correctiveActions', 'nextActions', 'feedbacks']);
    }

<?php

namespace Tests\Fixtures;

class PrototypeDataset
{
    /**
     * Get the complete raw fixture array.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public static function raw(): array
    {
        $path = resource_path('fixtures/prototype.json');

        if (! file_exists($path)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException("Fixture file not found at: {$path}");
        }

        $json = file_get_contents($path);

        return json_decode($json, true) ?: [];
    }

    /**
     * Get all fictitious projects.
     *
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public static function projects(): array
    {
        return static::raw()['projects'] ?? [];
    }

    /**
     * Get all fictitious progresses.
     *
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public static function progresses(): array
    {
        return static::raw()['progresses'] ?? [];
    }

    /**
     * Get all draft entries.
     *
     * @return array<int, array<string, mixed>>
     */
    public static function drafts(): array
    {
        return static::raw()['drafts'] ?? [];
    }

    /**
     * Find project by ID or JO No.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public static function findProject(string $idOrJo): ?array
    {
        foreach (static::projects() as $project) {
            if ($project['id'] === $idOrJo || $project['jo_no'] === $idOrJo) {
                return $project;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Find progress by ID.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public static function findProgress(string $id): ?array
    {
        foreach (static::progresses() as $progress) {
            if ($progress['id'] === $id) {
                return $progress;
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    /**
     * Get the designated complex progress for testing relations.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>|null
     */
    public static function complexProgress(): ?array
    {
        return static::findProgress('prog-001');
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Prototype\FakeStore;
use Tests\Fixtures\PrototypeDataset;
use Tests\TestCase;

class FakeStoreTest extends TestCase
{
    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        FakeStore::reset();
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        FakeStore::reset();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    public function test_projects_fixture_has_three_unique_projects_with_leading_zeros(): void
    {
        $projects = FakeStore::getProjects();

        $this->assertCount(3, $projects);

        $joList = array_column($projects, 'jo_no');
        $partList = array_column($projects, 'part_no');

        // D01: 1 JO = 1 Part No, unique
        $this->assertCount(3, array_unique($joList));
        $this->assertCount(3, array_unique($partList));

        // Leading zeros exist
        $hasLeadingZeroJo = false;
        $hasLeadingZeroPart = false;
        foreach ($projects as $project) {
            if (str_starts_with($project['jo_no'], '0')) {
                $hasLeadingZeroJo = true;
            }
            if (str_starts_with($project['part_no'], '0')) {
                $hasLeadingZeroPart = true;
            }
        }

        $this->assertTrue($hasLeadingZeroJo, 'At least one project JO must have leading zero');
        $this->assertTrue($hasLeadingZeroPart, 'At least one project Part No must have leading zero');

        // D15: Raw text for DH, size, qty
        $first = $projects[0];
        $this->assertStringContainsString(',', $first['dh']);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('.', $first['qty']);
    }

    public function test_progresses_fixture_covers_all_five_activities_and_both_statuses(): void
    {
        $progresses = FakeStore::getProgresses();

        $this->assertCount(8, $progresses);

        $activities = array_unique(array_column($progresses, 'activity'));
        $expectedActivities = ['Trial', 'Sent Sample', 'Send Document', 'Audit', 'Others'];

        foreach ($expectedActivities as $expected) {
            $this->assertContains($expected, $activities, "Activity {$expected} must be present in fixture");
        }

        $statuses = array_unique(array_column($progresses, 'status'));
        $this->assertContains('Open', $statuses);
        $this->assertContains('Closed', $statuses);

        // Check old historical date exists
        $hasOldDate = false;
        foreach ($progresses as $p) {
            if (str_starts_with($p['activity_date'], '2025-')) {
                $hasOldDate = true;
            }
        }
        $this->assertTrue($hasOldDate, 'At least one progress must have an old date (2025)');
    }

    public function test_complex_progress_nested_problems_and_corrective_actions_do_not_mix(): void
    {
        $complex = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');

        $this->assertNotNull($complex);
        $this->assertSame('Trial', $complex['activity']);
        $this->assertSame('Open', $complex['status']);

        // Must have 2 problems
        $problems = $complex['problems'];
        $this->assertCount(2, $problems);

        $prob1 = $problems[0];
        $prob2 = $problems[1];

        $this->assertNotEquals($prob1['id'], $prob2['id']);

        // Each problem must have 2 corrective actions
        $this->assertCount(2, $prob1['corrective_actions']);
        $this->assertCount(2, $prob2['corrective_actions']);

        $prob1ActionIds = array_column($prob1['corrective_actions'], 'id');
        $prob2ActionIds = array_column($prob2['corrective_actions'], 'id');

        // Verification requirement: actions of problem 1 are distinct from problem 2
        $intersection = array_intersect($prob1ActionIds, $prob2ActionIds);
        $this->assertEmpty($intersection, 'Corrective action IDs between problems must not mix or overlap');

        // Next Actions: exactly 3
        $this->assertCount(3, $complex['next_actions']);

        // Feedbacks: exactly 2
        $this->assertCount(2, $complex['feedbacks']);

        // Raw numbers 1,5 and 1.5 present in notes or descriptions
        $combinedText = $complex['notes'] . ' ' . $prob1['description'] . ' ' . $prob2['description'];
        $this->assertStringContainsString('1,5', $combinedText);
        $this->assertStringContainsString('1.5', $combinedText);

        // Dummy attachments clearly marked as simulation
        $this->assertNotEmpty($complex['attachments']);
        foreach ($complex['attachments'] as $att) {
            $this->assertTrue($att['is_dummy']);
            $this->assertStringContainsString('[SIMULASI]', $att['caption']);
        }
    }

    public function test_close_and_reopen_progress_preserves_content(): void
    {
        $original = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame('Open', $original['status']);

        // Close manual
        $closed = FakeStore::closeProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame('Closed', $closed['status']);

        // Reopen manual
        $reopened = FakeStore::reopenProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame('Open', $reopened['status']);

        // Preserves all contents, problems, actions, notes
        $this->assertSame($original['notes'], $reopened['notes']);
        $this->assertSame($original['problems'], $reopened['problems']);
        $this->assertSame($original['next_actions'], $reopened['next_actions']);
        $this->assertSame($original['feedbacks'], $reopened['feedbacks']);
    }

    public function test_stats_counts_open_and_closed_excluding_drafts(): void
    {
        $stats = FakeStore::getStats();

        $this->assertSame(3, $stats['total_projects']);
        $this->assertSame(8, $stats['total_progresses']);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $stats['open_count']);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $stats['closed_count']);
        $this->assertSame(8, $stats['open_count'] + $stats['closed_count']);
        $this->assertGreaterThan(0, $stats['draft_count']);
    }

    public function test_draft_lifecycle_and_isolation(): void
    {
        $drafts = FakeStore::getDrafts();
        $this->assertCount(2, $drafts);

        // Save a new draft
        $newDraft = FakeStore::saveDraft([
            'type' => 'new',
            'project_id' => 'proj-001',
            'activity' => 'Trial',
            'notes' => 'Draft test notes',
        ]);

        $this->assertNotEmpty($newDraft['uuid']);
        $found = FakeStore::findDraft($newDraft['uuid']);
        $this->assertNotNull($found);
        $this->assertSame('Draft test notes', $found['notes']);

        // Delete draft
        $deleted = FakeStore::deleteDraft($newDraft['uuid']);
        $this->assertTrue($deleted);
        $this->assertNull(FakeStore::findDraft($newDraft['uuid']));
    }

    public function test_reset_store_restores_initial_fixture_dataset(): void
    {

            'project_id' => 'proj-001',
            'activity' => 'Trial',
            'notes' => 'Temporary mutated progress',
        ]);

    }

    public function test_get_progresses_default_sorting_oldest_first(): void
    {
        $all = FakeStore::getProgresses(['status' => 'all']);

        $this->assertCount(8, $all);
        $this->assertSame('prog-006', $all[0]['id'], 'Oldest progress (2025-08-10) should be first');
        $this->assertSame('prog-008', $all[7]['id'], 'Newest progress (2026-10-10) should be last in oldest-first sort');

        // Test newest sort
        $newest = FakeStore::getProgresses(['status' => 'all', 'sort' => 'newest']);
        $this->assertSame('prog-008', $newest[0]['id'], 'Newest progress (2026-10-10) should be first in newest sort');
    }

    public function test_pic_multi_role_search_returns_unique_progress_records(): void
    {
        // 1. Search PIC in 'customer' role
        $resultsProg = FakeStore::getProgresses(['status' => 'all', 'pic' => 'Bambang Customer', 'pic_role' => 'customer']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $resultsProg);
        $this->assertSame('prog-003', $resultsProg[0]['id']);

        // 2. Search PIC in 'corrective_action' role on complex progress with 2 problems x 2 actions
        $resultsAct = FakeStore::getProgresses(['status' => 'all', 'pic' => 'Budi Santoso', 'pic_role' => 'corrective_action']);
        $this->assertCount(1, $resultsAct, 'Corrective action search should not multiply progress rows');
        $this->assertSame('prog-001', $resultsAct[0]['id']);

        // 3. Search PIC in 'next_action' role
        $resultsNext = FakeStore::getProgresses(['status' => 'all', 'pic' => 'Dewi Lestari', 'pic_role' => 'next_action']);
        // Dewi Lestari is in next_action for prog-001, prog-002, and prog-008
        $this->assertCount(3, $resultsNext);
        $ids = array_column($resultsNext, 'id');
        $this->assertSame(count($ids), count(array_unique($ids)), 'Results must contain unique progress records');

        // 4. Search PIC with 'all' roles
        $resultsAll = FakeStore::getProgresses(['status' => 'all', 'pic' => 'Budi Santoso', 'pic_role' => 'all']);
        // Budi Santoso is in corrective_action in prog-001, pic_progress and next_action in prog-005
        $this->assertCount(2, $resultsAll);
        $allIds = array_column($resultsAll, 'id');
        $this->assertContains('prog-001', $allIds);
        $this->assertContains('prog-005', $allIds);
        $this->assertSame(2, count(array_unique($allIds)), 'Even with multiple roles in prog-005, prog-005 must appear exactly once');
    }

    public function test_save_project_creates_valid_project_preserving_leading_zeros(): void
    {
        $newProject = FakeStore::saveProject([
            'jo_no' => '0099/NM/2026',
            'part_no' => '00888-A999',
            'part_name' => 'BRACKET TEST LEADING ZERO',
            'customer' => 'PT UJI PRESISI',
            'dh' => '115,5 mm',
            'qty' => '500 pcs',
        ]);

        $this->assertNotEmpty($newProject['id']);
        $this->assertSame('0099/NM/2026', $newProject['jo_no']);
        $this->assertSame('00888-A999', $newProject['part_no']);
        $this->assertSame('115,5 mm', $newProject['dh']);
        $this->assertCount(4, FakeStore::getProjects());
    }

    }

        FakeStore::saveProject([
            'jo_no' => '9999/NM/2026',

        ]);
    }

    public function test_at03_updating_master_project_reflects_in_old_progresses(): void
    {
        // prog-001 belongs to proj-001
        $progBefore = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame('BRACKET FRONT LH (FIKTIF)', $progBefore['project']['part_name']);

        // Update Part Name and Customer on proj-001
        FakeStore::saveProject([
            'id' => 'proj-001',
            'jo_no' => '0012/NM/2026',
            'part_no' => '0091-XYZ-01',
            'part_name' => 'BRACKET FRONT LH UPDATED REV 2',
            'customer' => 'PT ASTRA REVISI MOTOR',
        ]);

        // Re-fetch progress: must dynamically reflect updated master identity without modifying progress notes
        $progAfter = FakeStore::findProgress('prog-001');
        $this->assertSame('BRACKET FRONT LH UPDATED REV 2', $progAfter['project']['part_name']);
        $this->assertSame('PT ASTRA REVISI MOTOR', $progAfter['project']['customer']);
        $this->assertSame($progBefore['notes'], $progAfter['notes'], 'Progress notes must remain unchanged');
    }
}

# Arsitektur fondasi Fase 2

## Batas implementasi

Baseline adalah ZIP yang diberikan pengguna, termasuk perubahan Fase 1 yang belum ada pada commit upstream. Baseline disimpan sebagai commit lokal tersendiri sebelum implementasi; tidak ada reset pekerjaan pengguna. PRD tidak diedit. UI ini adalah UI aplikasi sebenarnya, sesuai instruksi terbaru, dan tidak didesain ulang.

| Lokasi | Tanggung jawab |
|---|---|
| `app/Livewire/Prototype`, view yang sama | UI yang diterima; adapter session terisolasi dan guard di setiap boot Livewire |
| `app/Prototype` | Fixture dan simulasi; tidak diakses route operasional |
| `app/Livewire/Forms/ProgressFormData.php` | Jembatan DTO untuk integrasi fase berikutnya |
| `app/Data` | Kontrak project/progress, normalisasi tanggal kosong, validasi bentuk dan ownership |
| `app/Models` | Relasi eksplisit dan cast DATE/raw text |
| `app/Actions` | Satu operasi per kelas: Simpan, Close, Reopen |
| `app/Services` | Kontrak draft, finalisasi attachment, monitoring |
| `app/Policies`, middleware, controller auth | Otorisasi session admin, akses file privat |
| `database/migrations`, factories/seeders | Schema PostgreSQL, constraint dan fixture fiktif |
| `tests/Feature/Foundation`, `tests/Feature/Auth` | Test integritas dan perilaku database/auth |
| `tests/Browser` | Regresi browser terfokus; bukan bukti lulus sebelum benar-benar dijalankan |
| `tools/access-export` | Ruang alat Fase 6; belum ada importer |

`/` menuju login atau `/app`; `/app` hanya halaman kesiapan fondasi. Tidak mengklaim CRUD operasional telah terhubung. Route `/prototype` memerlukan auth/admin serta local/testing + flag. `PreviewComponent::boot()` menjaga initial render dan message/action Livewire langsung, sehingga route gate saja tidak menjadi satu-satunya pelindung.

## Schema dan integritas

`projects` memiliki JO dan Part No unik masing-masing, trim spasi luar dan tipe teks. Keunikan case-sensitive mempertahankan perbedaan casing untuk review, sesuai FR01; tidak menggabungkan identitas impor otomatis. Input final baru wajib JO, Part No, Part Name. `legacy_incomplete=true` memungkinkan nilai sumber null tanpa fakta buatan. `spec` tetap kolom arsip/master sesuai pemetaan, tetapi tidak muncul di form Project.

`progresses` hanya menyimpan project_id untuk identitas. Koreksi master langsung terlihat melalui relasi; tidak ada snapshot Part/Customer/Model/No Doc. Activity diperiksa database terhadap lima label persis. DATE tidak dikonversi ke UTC; timestamp teknis disimpan dengan zona dan UI menampilkan Asia/Jakarta. Raw ukuran/DH/Qty bertipe text, tanpa float atau perhitungan. Tidak ada PIC Progress, Project User, Status Project, atau target date.

Graph: project â†’ progress â†’ problems â†’ corrective_actions; progress â†’ next_actions dan feedbacks. Semua anak memakai stored ID, UUID `client_id`, position, FK RESTRICT, serta unique `(parent_id, client_id)`. Posisi bukan identitas dan dapat sama selama penyusunan ulang; relasi diurutkan position lalu ID. RESTRICT menghalangi orphan/delete parent; tidak menambahkan fitur hapus berantai UI.

Draft memakai UUID primary key, admin_id, progress_id nullable, base_revision, draft_revision, request_sequence, schema_version, JSONB object, state active/applied, applied_progress_id. Partial unique index membatasi satu draft edit active per admin/progress; draft baru boleh lebih dari satu. Applied harus menunjuk progress, dan draft edit tidak dapat diterapkan ke progress lain. JSON payload lama tetap disimpan bila versi tidak didukung DTO; pemulihannya dikerjakan Fase 5.

Attachment memakai **FK eksplisit yang eksklusif**, bukan owner polymorphic tanpa FK:

- Staging: hanya draft_id; owner_kind progress/problem/feedback dan UUID owner_client_id untuk baris anak baru.
- Attached: tepat satu progress_id/problem_id/feedback_id; draft_id dan owner_client_id null.
- CHECK database menegakkan XOR, state, kind, checksum SHA-256, ukuran positif, serta storage key server `attachments/<uuid>`. Checksum dan ukuran byte yang benar tetap harus diverifikasi service Fase 4.
- DTO mengecek uploader, draft admin, owner kind, client_id/stored parent, jenis file foto/dokumen serta penggunaan referensi ganda. FK tidak dapat sendirian membuktikan staging milik client row dalam JSON; pemeriksaan service ini wajib diulang di dalam transaksi final.
- Disk `private` tidak mempunyai URL publik atau signed local serving. Download hanya route terautentikasi + policy, hanya state attached; header download/no-store/nosniff. File kosong/hilang menghasilkan 404, bukan attachment sukses.

`legacy_document_metadata` terpisah, tepat satu progress/feedback sebagai pemilik, source_field, nama dan keterangan nullable. Tidak ada storage_key, route download, atau byte dokumen lama. `import_batches/import_records` ditunda ke Fase 6; lihat pemetaan 65 kolom.

## Kontrak payload

Root: `schema_version=1`, project_id, activity_date, activity, sebelas field teks kegiatan, problems[], next_actions[], feedbacks[], attachment_refs[]. Tiap baris memakai UUID client_id; stored id harus hadir jika baris sudah tersimpan dan client_id tidak boleh berubah. Nama field DTO `description` sesuai database; adapter UI fase berikutnya memetakan `notes` menjadi description, `date` feedback menjadi feedback_date, ID lokal preview menjadi UUID stabil. Jangan membuat UUID baru pada setiap autosave.

Draft parsial tidak wajib JO, tanggal, atau Activity. Final hanya mewajibkan tiga field itu, ditambah pemeriksaan tipe/relasi. PIC/tanggal tanpa uraian dipertahankan. Tanggal `''` menjadi null; string raw koma/titik tidak diubah. Field tidak dikenal ditolak eksplisit (termasuk snapshot master, pic_progress, target_date, status). Daftar/key yang hilang tetap **hilang** dalam DTO, bukan diubah menjadi `[]` dan bukan instruksi delete. Penghapusan record tersimpan bukan cakupan fondasi.

Test DTO ditempatkan di `tests/Feature/Foundation/PayloadTest.php` (bukan Unit), karena rule exists/unique dan ownership harus memeriksa PostgreSQL nyata. Tidak dibuat kelas Rules paralel untuk pemeriksaan yang sudah memakai Validator Laravel dan DTO terpusat.

`ProjectPayload` memvalidasi tiga field wajib master, unique identity (ignore ID terpercaya saat edit), teks opsional, dan tanggal manual. Spec hanya untuk kontrak data/import; UI Project tetap tidak menampilkannya.

## Kontrak hasil dan transaksi

| Operasi | Input | Hasil/kondisi saat ini |
|---|---|---|
| `ProgressDraftService::save` | User admin, draft UUID, input, expectedRevision, requestSequence, progress/base revision optional | Validasi parsial + auth; **501 FeatureNotReady**. Fase 5 mengisi penulisan CAS/sequence |
| `SaveProgress::handle` | User admin, draft UUID, expected draft revision | Lock draft; auth; applied replay mengembalikan progress yang sama; cek revision dan lock progress; validasi final; **501 untuk graph write yang belum diimplementasikan** |
| `CloseProgress::handle` | User admin, progress ID, expected revision | Transaksi + row lock, cek revision, ubah status/revision saja; tanpa syarat kelengkapan; draft/anak tidak diubah |
| `ReopenProgress::handle` | sama | Transaksi yang sama, isi tetap, revision meningkat bila status berubah |
| `AttachmentFinalizer::finalize` | admin, draft, attachment IDs server | **501**; Fase 4 verifikasi byte/checksum/mime lalu promosi |
| `ProgressMonitoring::list` | admin, filters | Kontrak pagination; **501**, query Fase 5 |

`ProgressResult` memuat model, outcome, pesan; sukses yang sudah ada: closed/open/already_applied. Validasi: `ValidationException` (422 + field errors); auth: AuthenticationException/AuthorizationException (redirect login/401 atau 403); not found 404; `VersionConflict` 409; `UploadNotReady` 422; skeleton 501. Jangan tangkap semua exception lalu menampilkan â€œtersimpanâ€.

Batas transaksi final yang harus diisi Fase 5: lock draft â†’ jika applied kembalikan applied_progress_id â†’ cek expected draft revision â†’ lock progress dan cek base_revision + status Open â†’ ulangi validasi ownership â†’ simpan graph secara idempoten dengan mapping client_id â†’ finalisasi referensi staging yang byte-nya sudah terverifikasi â†’ naikkan revision â†’ tandai draft applied + applied_progress_id â†’ commit. Kegagalan anak membatalkan semuanya dan draft tetap active. Tidak memindahkan/menghapus byte di tengah transaksi tanpa mekanisme pemulihan; file immutable privat dapat memakai key yang sama saat metadata ownership dipromosikan. Cleanup fisik setelah commit harus dapat diulang.

AT11â€“AT22: ID silang/validasi parsial/missing lists sudah diuji di DTO; applied replay, rollback database, konflik revision, Close/Reopen dan pelestarian draft diuji. Penulisan graph final, ordering autosave, CAS dua tab, discard staging, reload draft database, dan koordinasi upload belum diimplementasikan dan **belum dianggap lulus acceptance produk**. Test fixture rollback membuktikan batas transaksi PostgreSQL, bukan klaim Simpan final operasional sudah selesai.

# Keputusan implementasi Fase 2 â€” 15 Oktober 2026

1. Instruksi pengguna terbaru menjadi acuan: UI yang ada adalah UI final aplikasi; tidak ada desain prototype baru. Namespace lama dipertahankan sebagai lokasi source, bukan alasan membuat UI baru.
2. PIC Progress di PRD bagian 16 dan fixture lama bertentangan dengan keputusan terbaru. Kolom/DTO/state form operasional PIC Progress tidak dibuat. Sisa fixture preview tetap arsip fiktif untuk regresi; nilainya tidak masuk schema operasional. PRD tidak diedit.
3. Spec dipertahankan di database sesuai pemetaan sumber, tanpa input Spec pada Project. Model merupakan teks kode, bukan gambar/avatar.
4. Catatan penerimaan lama menyebut mengganti adapter pada Fase 2. Task terperinci Fase 2 dan instruksi terbaru membatasi pekerjaan fondasi serta kontrak; integrasi UI CRUD tetap Fase 3, nested/file Fase 4, autosave/final graph Fase 5. Jalur operasional tidak memakai dummy. Kontrak yang belum diisi menolak eksplisit, tidak berpura-pura sukses.
5. PHP minimum diperbaiki dari `^8.3` menjadi `^8.4.1`, mengikuti kebutuhan lockfile yang sudah ada. Tidak ada perubahan versi paket Composer; hanya hash/platform requirement lock yang diselaraskan. Node memakai satu package manager npm. Playwright ditambahkan sebagai dependency development terkunci 1.62.1.
6. PostgreSQL 18, bukan SQLite, menjadi quality gate. Schema memakai CHECK PostgreSQL/partial unique/JSONB; test menolak database yang tidak bernama progress_new_model_test. Environment uji tidak memakai database pengguna atau produksi.
7. FK RESTRICT dipilih agar parent tidak terhapus dan membuat orphan. Tidak ada fitur UI cascade delete. Owner attachment memakai XOR FK + validasi service terhadap draft/client row; metadata dokumen legacy terpisah dari file aktif.
8. Satu admin ditegakkan database dengan boolean slot true+unique, tanpa role tambahan. Command lokal meminta secret; tidak ada seeder akun/registrasi publik. Pemulihan akun sebelum live masih keputusan pemilik aplikasi, bukan endpoint reset publik yang diasumsikan.
9. Close/Reopen foundation action sudah atomik dan revision-aware, tetapi belum diwiring ke UI database. Implementasi kecil ini menjadi bukti kontrak transaksi Fase 2; monitoring/autosave/graph final tetap skeleton fase berikutnya.
10. OP01â€“OP05 tetap terbuka sesuai waktu kebutuhannya. OP03 tidak diganti asumsi batas ukuran preview (2 MB). Tidak ada upload operasional yang dinyalakan sebelum konfigurasinya ditetapkan.
11. Bukti lama â€œ100% paritasâ€ tidak dipakai sebagai hasil test sesi ini. Koreksi R01â€“R04 ditemukan sudah ada pada source upload. R01/R02 diuji ulang melalui PHP/Livewire. R03/R04 sudah ada guard kode dan regresi server yang relevan; browser offline/network race dan paritas visual terbaru belum terverifikasi jika browser terhalang environment.

12. Instalasi dist lockfile mengalami HTTP 404, sehingga dependency segar dipasang dari revisi Git yang sama. Source paket Pint dan Flysystem memuat class yang bertumpuk; exclude-from-classmap membatasi path tersebut tanpa mengedit vendor atau versi dependency. Bootstrap dan test dijalankan pada vendor standar hasil instalasi segar.

# Pengujian Fase 2

## Environment dan proteksi data

Database pengujian wajib PostgreSQL dengan nama tepat `progress_new_model_test`. PHPUnit memaksa DB_CONNECTION=pgsql, DB_DATABASE tersebut, dan mengosongkan DB_URL. `tests/TestCase::createApplication` memeriksa config setelah bootstrap, sebelum trait RefreshDatabase menjalankan migration. Tetap gunakan role terbatas yang tidak mempunyai akses produksi; nama database saja bukan pengganti isolasi role/server.

Gunakan `.env.testing.example` untuk membuat `.env.testing`; isi koneksi dan generate APP_KEY. File actual `.env`/`.env.testing` tidak disertakan source. Database development terpisah: progress_new_model_dev. Seeder development menolak overwrite, tidak membuat user, dan tidak menyentuh database lain.

## Perintah quality gate

```bash
composer install --prefer-dist
composer validate --strict
composer check-platform-reqs
cp .env.testing.example .env.testing
# Sesuaikan host/port/user/password test.
php artisan key:generate --env=testing
php artisan test
npm ci
npm run build
php artisan view:cache
```

Untuk diagnosis constraint dan auth saja:

```bash
php artisan test --filter='SchemaTest|PayloadTest|ServiceContractTest|AdminAccessTest'
php artisan test --filter='UiRecheckRegressionTest|PrototypeUiParityRegressionTest'
```

Migration up/down dapat diperiksa dengan `php artisan migrate`, `php artisan migrate:rollback`, lalu `php artisan migrate` pada **database uji kosong** menggunakan `--env=testing`. Jangan menjalankan rollback/fresh pada development yang berisi data atau pada produksi. Suite RefreshDatabase hanya diperuntukkan database testing terisolasi.

## Cakupan nyata

- Unik JO/Part, nol depan, raw `1,5` versus `1.5`, DATE null legacy, Activity/status/revision CHECK, FK dan RESTRICT.
- Dua problem dengan dua corrective action masing-masing; Next Action mandiri dan feedback berulang; master terkini lewat relasi.
- Satu admin, satu active edit draft, applied target, owner attachment tunggal, metadata-only tanpa download.
- Draft parsial versus final tiga field wajib; tipe/tanggal/field asing; ID anak silang; client ID stabil; referensi attachment lintas draft/baris ditolak.
- Login gagal/sukses/logout/throttle; command admin hash dan penolakan akun kedua; URL anonim dan boot Livewire; policy draft/file/Closed parent dan anak.
- Rollback graph contoh di PostgreSQL; Close/Reopen revision, pelestarian anak/draft; replay applied draft dan skeleton yang tidak mengembalikan sukses palsu.
- Test Fase 1 tetap dipertahankan dan memakai session identity admin fiktif tanpa memasukkan dummy ke database operasional.

Coverage tersebut **bukan** bukti implementasi Fase 3â€“5 sudah selesai: write graph final, sequencing autosave, konflik editor dua tab, staging cleanup dan upload operasional masih kontrak/skeleton.

## Browser terfokus

Playwright 1.62.1 menjadi satu tool browser proyek (`npm run test:browser`). Siapkan browser dan admin pada development terisolasi; tidak menggunakan akun produksi.

```bash
npx playwright install chromium
# Jalankan aplikasi development; PROTOTYPE_ENABLED=true, PROTOTYPE_STORAGE=session.
# Isi BROWSER_TEST_EMAIL dan BROWSER_TEST_PASSWORD sebagai environment lokal, jangan commit.
npm run test:browser
```

`BROWSER_BASE_URL` default http://127.0.0.1:8000. `CHROMIUM_PATH` opsional untuk browser lokal yang kompatibel. File `playwright.config.js` memakai satu worker dan menghasilkan test-results yang tidak masuk source ZIP. Test tidak membuat akun; pakai admin dari command lokal.

Delapan skenario disediakan: auth, lima viewport (1366, 1024, 911, 768, 390), navigasi tanpa ghost draft + pemulihan draft edit setelah reload, serta pengosongan tanggal dan Close/Reopen. Dataset preview tetap 3 project/8 progress/2 draft awal, 5 Open/3 Closed; jangan mengganti count agar menyerupai screenshot referensi lama.

Pada sesi ini Chrome 155.0.8059.79 tersedia tetapi gagal diluncurkan karena environment menolak Unix socket (`socket() failed: Operation not permitted`). Delapan test berhenti **sebelum interaksi halaman**, sehingga tidak ada klaim kelulusan browser/visual. Unduhan Chromium bawaan juga tidak menghasilkan archive valid. Jalankan ulang pada environment dengan browser yang dapat berjalan; tidak melonggarkan kontrol environment.

R03/R04 (offline, promise lampiran gagal, dua navigasi cepat, acknowledgement input baru, sesi berakhir) masih membutuhkan QA browser di environment tersebut. Source guard dari upload dipertahankan. Draft baru belum menambahkan UUID ke URL setelah acknowledgement; pemulihan melalui daftar draft tersedia pada adapter, sedangkan reload langsung URL form baru perlu dirapikan pada integrasi Fase 5. Ini dicatat sebagai sisa integrasi, bukan dianggap lulus oleh test server.

## Reproduksi instalasi dependency

Instalasi ke direktori vendor kosong dengan `--prefer-dist --no-scripts` mengalami HTTP 404 (contoh symfony/console v8.1.8). Fallback `--prefer-source --no-scripts` berhasil memasang 110 paket pada versi/revisi lockfile yang sama. Dependency segar ditempatkan pada path vendor standar, autoload/bootstrap dibuat ulang, platform requirements diperiksa, dan 116 test (708 assertions) lulus kembali. Source checkout memuat class development bawaan paket; `exclude-from-classmap` menghindari duplikasi namespace App dari Pint dan Local adapter Flysystem. Jangan mengganti versi dependency untuk menutupi masalah jaringan. CI ditambahkan di `.github/workflows/quality.yml` tetapi belum dijalankan pada GitHub.

Runtime pengujian sesi ini: PHP 8.4.26, Composer 2.10.3, PostgreSQL 18.6, Node 24.19.0, npm 11.9.0. Container hanya menyediakan satu UID root; server PostgreSQL uji dijalankan pada loopback dengan adapter identitas proses lokal, tanpa perubahan kode engine/SQL, dan socket Unix dimatikan. Adapter, cluster, kredensial dan binary runtime tidak masuk source. Pada mesin pengembang normal gunakan PostgreSQL sebagai user sistem postgres dan role database terbatas; tidak perlu adapter ini.
